sanskrit: taṁ śrīherukābhidhānaṁ praṇamya vasantatilakāṁ vakṣya iti sambandhaḥ kīdṛśam ? samaviṣametyādi | samā upāyasvabhāvāḥ, viṣamāḥ prajñāsvabhāvāḥ, mahāsaukhyāstadadvayarūpiṇo ya ete saptatriṁśadbodhipakṣāḥ pañcamārga saṁgṛhītā [ḥ] kāyānusmṛtyupasthānādārabhya samyaksamādhiparyantāḥ svabhāvā yasya, tenaiva rūpeṇa yaḥ sthitaḥ, tam | tatra samā dvāviṁśatidharmāḥ, laukikamārgasaṁgṛhītatvāt | viṣamāḥ pañcadaśadharmāḥ, lokottaramārga-saṁgṛhītatvāt | athavā samāḥ savyanāḍīprabhavāḥ saṁvidaḥ, viṣamā vāmanāḍīprabhavāḥ | cakṣurādi[ṣaḍ] vijñānānāṁ pratyekamā [tyekaṁ caturā] nandādibhedāśca(cca)tuviṁśatirānandāḥ, cakracatuṣṭaye praveśāditraya [praveśa-sthiti-utthāpana]krameṇānandāditrayabhedād dvādaśānandāḥ, sarvāṅgalayādekaḥ | evaṁ saptatriṁśadbodhipakṣadharmasvabhāvasthito bhagavān sahajaikamūrtiḥ | bahirapi tāvatībhirḍākinībhiru(ryu)ktaḥ |

parallel: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor yang oM AHI U aM ste sa bon lnga rnams bkod pa las khams lnga rnam par dag pa'o/ / de bzhin du ma ning bzhi po spangs pa'i phyi mo bcu gnyis po g.yon dang 'og tu gdong dang / de nyid g.yas su steng du gdong ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams kyis ni ka yig la sogs steng dang 'og gi gdong rnams ma yig gi rang bzhin gyi rjes su nga ro dang bcas pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /

sanskrit: daśabhūmīśvaratvamasya pratipādayitumāha - kāyavākcittabhedasthitānāṁ ca pīṭhādikānāṁ daśānāṁ bhuvāmīśvaram | anyacca kīdṛśaṁ praṇamya vasantatilakāṁ vakṣye- pramuditādi svabhāvā yā etā daśa bodhisattvabhūmayaḥ pīṭhādyā kāyādicakreṣu vilomena bhedena sthitāḥ, śiraādisthāneṣvabhedyādirūpā nāḍyastāsāmīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ, tam | iha bodhisattvabhūmayo daśa, yāsu bodhisattvaḥ kleśajñeyāvaraṇaṁ pradahitvā satyaṁ paśyati | avikalpadhātusākṣātkārāt trikalpā saṁkhyeya prāpyasaṁbodhiśca bhavati,
parallel: 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu ste/ gang rnams su byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa rab tu bsreg pa nyid las bden pa mthong ba ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings mngon sum du mdzad pa las bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis 'thob par bya ba'i byang chub tu 'gyur ba yin te/
sems bskyed pa ni sa rnams la/ / mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /
rnam par smin pa gzhan du 'dod/ / de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: iti vacanāt | iha tu pullīrādisaṁketitadaśabhūmisaṁcārasādhyalayādi svabhāvakāyatrayā dhigamapradhānasvasaṁvedyaśrīmahāsukhāparaparyāyasamyaksaṁbodhirūpaśrīherukatvasākṣātkāra āśutaraṁ ca niṣpadyata ihaiva janmanīti prajñāpāramitādarśanād viśeṣaḥ | ataḥ pīṭhādibhīmīnāṁ dharmakāyādirūpeṇa sahajasyaivādhipatyād daśabhūmīśvaratvaṁ bhagavataḥ pratipāditaṁ bhavati | pīṭhādīnāṁ bhīmīnāṁ ca nirukti sāmānādhikaraṇyaṁ ca uttaratra vyākhyāsyate |
parallel: 'di las na lhan cig skyes pa kho na chos kyi sku la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis gnas la sogs pa'i sa rnams kyi bdag po nyid kyi phyir/ bcom ldan 'das sa bcu'i dbang phyug nyid du rtogs par mdzad pa yin no/ / gnas la sogs pa rnams dang sa rnams kyi nges pa'i tshig ni gzhi mthun pa nyid las phyi nas bshad par bya'o/ /
gzhan yang ji lta bu zhe na/
kun 'gro ste/

sanskrit: anyacca kīdṛśam - sarvagam | skandhādayaḥ sarve, tatra dharmatayā sthitatvāt sarvagaṁ dharmadhātum |
parallel: kun ni phung po la sogs pa rnams yin la/ de la chos nyid kyis gnas pa nyid kyi phyir kun 'gro ste/ chos kyi dbyings so/ /

sanskrit: sarvajantusvahṛnmadhyagamiti | paśupakṣisarīsṛpamanujādayaḥ sarvajantavaḥ, teṣāṁ svahṛnmadhyaga (gaṁ) hṛtpadmasaṁpuṭa sanniviṣṭakarṇikāntarasthitapṛthitapṛthivyādicaturdhāstusvabhāvo-rdhvādhaḥ sūryendumaṇḍalamadhyaga vālāgraśatasahasrabhāgapramāṇasūkṣmātisukṣmadharmadhātusvabhāva sarvacakraḍākinīvīrādya(ti?)bhinnarūpeṇa sthitam | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: sems can kun ni phyugs dang bya dang sbrul dang mi la sogs pa rnams so/ / de rnams kyi rang gi snying gi dbus son te/ snying ga'i pad+ma kha sbyor du zhugs pa ze'u 'bru'i nang du gnas pa'i sa la sogs pa'i khams bzhi'i rang bzhin steng dang 'og tu nyi ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su son pa/

skra rtse brgya stong gi tshad phra zhing shin tu phra ba'i chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin 'khor lor thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo dbyer med pa'i gzugs kyis thig le'i rang bzhin du gnas pa ste/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ / thig le gcig pu yi ge med/ /

sanskrit: taṁ ca bhāvayatāṁ puṁsāṁ jñānamutpadyate param || iti,
parallel: de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la/ / mchog gi ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /
zhes gsungs pa dang / kha sbyor kha sbyor sgom pa na/ / thig le gcig pu snang ba ste/ /

sanskrit: asaṁpuṭapuṭo bhūtvā bindurnirbindutāṁ brajet || iti vacanāt |
parallel: kha sbyor ma yin sbyar gyur na/ / thig le thig le min nyid 'gro/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: anyacca kīdṛśam - vyomarūpaṁ dharmakāyatvāt | pañcavyomarūpaṁ vā trivṛtādināḍīsparśagamyatvāt | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: nam mkha'i rnam pa ste/ chos kyi sku nyid kyi phyir ram nam mkha' lnga'i rnam pa'i sum skor ba la sogs pa'i rtsa rnams su reg cing rtogs pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / yang gsungs pa/
b+ha ga'i dbus su nam mkha' gang / / nam mkha' lnga rnams kyis brgyan pa/ / lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /
'dab ma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /

sanskrit: paraṁ śāntamityādi | pāramārthikabodhicittarūpatvāt param, niṣprapañcatvāt śāntam ||1||
parallel: don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir mchog go/ / spros pa med pa nyid kyi phyir zhi ba'o/ /

sanskrit: śrīherukamityādinā vivṛtisaṁvṛtirūpa bodhicittasvarūpatāṁ samyak pratipādayitumāha - śrīherukam | tantroktacaturvimokṣātmakam | paramanirvṛtitattvaṁ sahajaikadharmakāya, tadrūpaṁ(paḥ) tanmayastam | tathā prodyantī nirmāṇāduttiṣṭhantī yeyaṁ vārāhīsvabhāvā bhāvinā vasantenābhijñādikusumodbhavayogena herukeṇa saṁyojyamānā tilakeva tilakā prakāśamayī jñānāgnijvālā skandhadhātvāyatanendhanadāhikā, tasyā yadetat spharaṇaṁ madhyamārgeṇordhvaṁ tricakrapravṛttiḥ, tenojjvalā tacchāyāsphuritā bhā prabhā
parallel: sprul pas bzhengs pa'o/ / gang 'di phag mo'i rnam pas 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dpyid kyis mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'i me tog 'byung ba'i sbyor bas he ru ka dang yang dag par sbyor bzhin pa ni thig le lta bu ste thig ler snang ba'i rang bzhin can gyi ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched kyi bud shing sreg par byed pa de'i gang yin pa 'di rnams ni spro ba te/

des na 'bar ba ste de'i 'od dang 'od gang gis yin pa de yin no/ / de bzhin du lus dang ngag dang yid de rigs gsum gyi rang bzhin gyi ra sa nA la sogs pa'i rtsa gsum po gang yin pa 'di ni rgyas pa ste/ dbu ma'i lam gyi steng du 'khor lo gsum la 'jug ste/
pul+lI ra la sogs pa'i gnas rnams dang / /

sanskrit: yasya tam | tathā kāyavākcittakulatrayarūpasya rasanādi nāḍītrayasya yo'sau prasaraḥ pullīrādisthāneṣu nirmāṇādiṣu prasaraḥ, tasya yo'sau saṁcayaścaturviṁśati-viṁśatyadhikaśata-ekaviṁśatisahasra-dvāsaptatisahasrasaṁkhyā, tena saṁkhyātaṁ yadetānnāḍīcakramanantavīra (ri)ṇīsvabhāvam, tatra nāthaṁ saṁvṛtibodhicittarūpeṇa prabhum | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: sprul pa la sogs pa rnams su rgyas pa de'o/ / bsags pa gang yin pa 'di ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang nyi shu lhag pa'i brgya dang / stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi grangs can gyi rtsa'i 'khor lo gang yin pa 'di rnams ni mtha' yas pa'i dpa' mo'i rang bzhin te/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rnam pas der mgon po ste khyab bdag go/ /
yang smras pa/ rkang pa gsang ba bshang lam lte snying mgo bo la/ / khams kyi dkyil 'khor du son ri rab rgyab tu 'gro/ /
rtsa rnams dam tshig rdo rje'i pad+mar son pa yi/ / gnyi ga'i sems ni he ru ka ste khyod la 'dud/ /
gsang ba'i ko ka'i chu yi ze'u 'bru'i nang du ni/ / mkha' ste nam mkha' chen po lnga po gnas pa yin/ /
chos kyi dbyings kyi thig le gnyis min gnyis su med/ / lhan skyes bdag nyid he ru ka ste khyod la 'dud/ /
sprin nag brtsegs pa'i nang du 'gyu ba'i glog las ni/ /
lhag pa'i 'od de mchog tu brtsegs pas sems can dang / / snod du bcas pa rab tu sreg par byed pa yi/ / 'gro ba'i ma ste he ru ka ma khyod la 'dud/ /
lte ba'i 'khor lo'i bug pa'i chu yi phung po dang / / rdo rje dang ni chu skyes 'dus pa las byung ba/ /

sanskrit: saudhasārarasa pānalampaṭāṁ tvāṁ namāmi vaḍavānalatviṣam || ityādi |
parallel: bdud rtsi'i ro yi btung ba la ni cher srid pa'i/ / rta gdong gi ni me 'od khyod la phyag bgyi'o/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /

sanskrit: dharmakāyasvarūpaṁ praṇamyetarābhyāmapi namaskartumāha jagataḥ svaparārthasaukhyamiti | jagatastraidhātukasya svasaṁvedyaṁ saukhyaṁ svasaukhyam, kuliśamukhādaspha raṇāvasthāyāṁ saṁbhogakāyasvarūpam | tadanyasyāṁ parārthasaukhyaṁ nirmāṇakāyasvabhāvam | yo'yaṁ jagadutpādaḥ sa eva tathāgatotpādaḥ, tadrūpatvājjagataḥ | uktaṁ ca saṁpuṭatilake -
parallel: rang rig pa'i bde ba ni rang bde ba ste/ rdo rje'i kha las ma 'phos pa'i gnas skabs su longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rang bzhin dang / de las gzhan du gzhan don gyi bde ba ni sprul pa'i sku'i rang bzhin no/ / gang 'dir 'gro ba skyed pa de kho na de bzhin gshegs pa skyed pa ste/
de'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir 'gro ba'o/ /
de kha sbyor thig ler yang gsungs pa/
khrag ni mkha' 'gro kun rang bzhin/ /
pad+mar snang ba sbyor ba las/ / pad+ma gar dbang du ni brjod/ /
steng du spro zhing 'od gsal ba/ / rdo rje nyi ma mchog tu bshad/ /
dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gror yang / /
snang zhing 'bar ba gang yin de/ / thub chen rnam par snang mdzad do/ /
dga' bral mtha' de rta mchog 'di/ / rlung rnams sna tshogs 'byung phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: ata eva vārāhyā samāliṅgitavigraham, pūrvoktenaiva nyāyeneti vākyaśeṣaḥ ||2||
parallel: zhes so/ / 'di nyid las sngon du gsungs pa'i tshul kho nas phag mos yang dag par 'khyud pa'i sku'o/ /

sanskrit: [ śrīherukābhidhānamiti | anāmānamapi bhagavantaṁ saṁvṛtyā śrīheruka ityabhidhānena pratipādyam | hūkāreṇa pratiravasadṛśena nādena ramyaṁ manoharam | yato yā vasantatilakā sa eva nādaḥ, tena dhvaninodghāṭito bindurbhagavānata eva nādabindusaṁghaṭṭa eva tayoḥ samāpatti rutpatti[ḥ], kramātītatvādutpanna kramasvabhāvaṁ praṇamyeti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ ||2|| ]
parallel: dpal he ru ka mngon par brjod pa la ming med kyang kun rdzob kyis shrI he ru ka zhes pa'i mngon par brjod pa las bcom ldan 'das su rtogs par bya'o/ / hUM yig brag ca lta bu'i sgras dga' zhing yid 'phrog pa gang las dpyid kyi thig le gang yin pa de nyid nA da ste/ des sgra byed cing sgrogs pa ni thig le ste bcom ldan 'das so/ /

sanskrit: kīdṛśīṁ vasantatilakāṁ vakṣye-yogapīṭhavinirgatām | catvāri yogapīṭhāni ātma-para-mantra-tattvapīṭhākhyāni yathākramaṁ nābhihṛtkaṇṭhaśirāṁsi, tebhyo vinirgatāṁ gamanāgamanayogena pravṛttām | tadvācikā sādhanopāyikā'pi vasantatilaketyucyate, sītāharaṇakāvyavat | kuta iyaṁ samuddṛtetyāha-śrīcakrasaṁvaraṁ nāma tantram, tatra yo bāhyādhyātmalakṣaṇastadvadutpannā nutpannākhyaḥ kramo mārgastattva(tsva)rūpeṇa vakṣye, iti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ | tathāhyutpattikrame saptatriṁśadātmakaṁ maṇḍalacakram, niṣpannakrame tu mahāsukhe tatsaṁkhyaṁ nāḍīcakram, evamanyadapyūhyam ||3||
parallel: rnal 'byor gyi gnas bzhi po bdag dang gzhan dang sngags dang de kho na nyid du brjod pa bzhin du lte ba dang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang spyi bo rnams las phyung ba ste/ 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i sbyor bas rab tu 'jug pa rnams so/ / de rjod par byed pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga la yang dpyid kyi thig le la zhes brjod par bya ste/
dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / zhes pa la sogs pas dgos pa gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma gang yin pa 'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /
des na rgyud rgyas pa rtogs par bya mi nus pa'i gang zag 'dod pa shin tu chung ba rnams kyis gsal bar khong du chud cing / de ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /

sanskrit: kṛtrimaṁ maṇḍalaṁ tyaktvā kṛtrimaṁ homakarmaṁ ca |
parallel: 'dir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la 'dzegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i dbang pos dkyil 'khor dang sbyin sreg dang bsgom pa dang bzlas pa rnams ji ltar bya zhe na/ ma yin no zhes gsungs pa/

sanskrit: kṛtrimāṁ bhāvanāṁ cāpi kṛtrimaṁ japameva ca ||5||
parallel: bskyed pa'i rim pa'am/

sku gzugs la sogs pa gang yin pa 'di rnams nyid ni thams cad du de btags pa nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / phyi rol gyi yo byad kyis bsgrub par bya ba nyid yin pa'i phyir bcos ma ste byas pa'o/ / 'dus pa ni/ rnam par nyams pa'i chos can te/
des na zhing g.yo ba byed pa byas pa de rnams kyis sam/

sanskrit: prayojanamāha - śrīvajraḍākinītyādi | yeyaṁ bhagavatī vajraḍākinī, vajraṁ saṁvaramanāhatākṣaradvārasthamanāhataṁ khagamukhaikarasaṁ sravatsudhaṁ dugdhābdhi taraṅgabhaṅgān muñcantam, ḍayati gacchatīti vajraḍākinī vidyucchaṭāsahasravad dīpitāṅgī bhagavatī jñānāgniprabhā vārāhī, sā siddhā dharmatārūpatvāt prakṛtyaiva niṣpannā, sarvaireva vedyatvāt | kiṁ bahiḥ sthitā ? netyāha - svadehe skandhādimaye kāye, vyavasthitā tiṣṭhati, prāguktena krameṇa tata eva tasyā upalabdheḥ | tataśca vistaratantramavagāhitumasa(śa)ktānāmatisvalparucīnāṁ pudgalānāṁ spaṣṭāvagamastadavabodho yathā syādityato hetorvakṣye, svalpagranthena paripūrṇaniṣpannakramāvabodhāyetyarthaḥ ||4||
parallel: sgom pa rnams kyis ci bya zhes dgongs so/ /

sanskrit: iha niṣpannakramārūḍho yogīndro maṇḍalahomabhāvanājāpān kiṁ kuryāt ? netyāha - kṛtrime(mami)tyādi | ya ete bahirutpattikrame vā pratimādayaḥ, sarve te kalpitatvād bāhyopakaraṇasādhyatvācca kṛtrimāḥ kṛtakāḥ, sāmagrīvināśād vināśadharmiṇo ghaṭādivat | tataśca kiṁ tairvṛthā vikṣepakāribhiḥ kṛtairbhāvitairveti bhāvaḥ | yadyevaṁ kimiti
parallel: gal te de ltar na de bcom ldan 'das kyis ci ltar bstan zhes dogs na/ bcos ma'i bya ba zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs te/ sngar bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa bcos ma'i bya ba gang yin pa 'di rnams kyang yod pa na de'i rang bzhin te/
dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnams kyi dngos grub kyi ngo bo nyid rtogs shing khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir bstan pa yin gyi/ de nyid 'bras bu'i rang bzhin ni ma yin no/ /

sanskrit: yathā pārārthibhiḥ kaiścit kolo vā suprayujyate |
parallel: 'di rnams nyid kyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dngos grub ste/
'chang bzhin pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa ni de'i rnal 'byor la brten nas thams cad du phyi rol gyi bcos ma kho na'o/ /

sanskrit: bhagavatā tadādiṣṭamityāśaṅkayāha - kṛtrimā prakriyetyādi | prāguktā maṇḍalādiprakriyā kṛtrimāpi satī sā svarūpasya svabhāvasiddhasya maṇḍalādeḥ pratipattaye'vagataye deśitā, na saiva phalarūpā | ata eva svabhāvarūpaṁ sahajasiddhaṁ maṇḍalādi vakṣyamāṇaṁ tadyogamāśritya sarvaṁ bāhyaṁ kṛtrimameva | tena maṇḍalaṁ kāye bhāvanīyaṁ cetyābhiprāyaḥ |
parallel: des na/ dkyil 'khor lus la bsgom par bya/ / zhes kyang dgongs so/ /

sanskrit: maṇḍalādyadhimuktāḥ pravartantāṁ tāvattatkāraṇabhāvanāyāṁ paścāttaddvāreṇaiva te svabhāvasiddhānoti tāni santi svabhāvasiddhāni tānīti bāhyābhiniveśaṁ tyājayitvā'dhyātme-ṣvavatāryanta iti taddeśanā'pi prayojanavatī ||5-6||
parallel: dkyil 'khor la sogs pa la mos pa rnams rab tu gzhug pas re zhig de sgom par byed la/ phyi nas de nyid kyi sgo nas rang bzhin gyi dngos grub sgrub pa de yod de/ de rnams kyi phyi rol du mngon par zhen pa dor nas nang gi bdag nyid rnams la 'jug par byed do zhes pa de bstan pa yang dgos pa dang bcas pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: dṛṣṭāntamāha - yathā pārārthibhirityādinā | yathā samudrādeḥ pāre prāptyarthino naukāyānaṁ taraṇḍamādau prayatnata āśrayante, pāraṁ prāpya tṛṇavat tyajanti, tathaiva bāhyamaṇḍalamāsādyādhyātmikaṁ yadāpnuvanti, tatprāpya bāhyaṁ tyajantītyarthaḥ, "upeye sati ye heyāstānupāyān pracakṣate" iti vacanāt |
parallel: ji ltar rgya mtsho la sogs pa rnams kyi pha rol thob pa don du gnyer ba rnams gzings kyi bzhon pa dang skye ba la sogs pa'i 'bad pa la rten par byed la/ pha rol thob pa na rtswa lta bur 'dor bar byed do/ /

sanskrit: ye ratnapudgalāḥ pūrvābhyastā(sta)kṛtrimamaṇḍalādayaste jhaṭityevākṛtrimamaṇḍalādhimuktikā akṛtrimamāsādayantyeveti viśeṣaḥ | tādṛggotramatidurlabham | niṣpannakrame durabhi grahadvāraścandanādyairnimittaviśeṣaiśca tadgotrako jñāyate,
parallel: rin po che'i gang zag sngon du goms pa de ni bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa de rnams yud tsam kho nas ma bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor du lhag par mos par byed cing bcos ma ma yin par byed pa kho na'o zhes bya ba ni khyad par ro/ / de lta bu'i rigs can ni rnyed par dka' ste/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la yid ches par dka' ba tsan+dan la sogs pa rnams kyis so/ /

sanskrit: dhūmena jñāyate vahniḥ salilaṁ tu balākayā |
parallel: mtshan ma'i khyad par rnams kyis de'i rigs can du shes par bya ste/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / / chu skyar las ni chu yin te/ /
byang chub sems dpa' yi ni rigs/ / blo dang ldan pas mtshan mar shes/ /
zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /
bsgom par bya bzhin pa yod pa ma yin na yang gsal bar 'gyur ro zhes pa/

sanskrit: sarvaṁ sādhu na cāsādhu tatprayuktamapi sphuṭam ||8||
parallel: gsal ba dang mi gsal bas byang chub kyi rgyu dag tu 'gyur zhes dogs pa la gsungs pa/
bcos ma'i bsam pa can brtags pa'i rnal 'byor pa la dkyil 'khor la sogs pa can dang por gsungs te/
bri ba'am yid la bya'o/ /

sanskrit: iha tāvat svarūpaparijñānameva bodhiḥ | bhāvyamā[na]masatyamapi sphuṭībhavatīti sphuṭāsphuṭena bodhihetū bhavata ityāśaṅkayāha- yanmaṇḍalādītyādi | kṛtrimāśayāḥ kalpitayogino yanmaṇḍalādikaṁ prāguktaṁ likhanena manasā vā kurvanti, tatsarvaṁ sādhvasādhu vā bhavatu , tadbhāvyamānaṁ sphuṭaṁ tāvadbhavati, tat tattvamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ |
parallel: de thams cad legs sam/ mi legs kyang rung ste de sgom par byed bzhin pa la re zhig gsal bar 'gyur ba yin gyi/ de de kho na nyid ni ma yin par brjod par bya'o zhes bya ba ni lhag ma ste/
ral pas brgyan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /
phrag par se ral dkar po dang / / spyi blugs thogs shing thal ba yis/ / ra ri can du sbags pa yang / /
'dir ni gang gang yang dang yang / / rmongs chen rnams kyis sgom byed pa/ /
de de'i mdun du snang bar 'gyur/ /
zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: maṇḍalādivat karmaṁprasaro'pi na tattvaṁ syādityāśaṅkyāha - sakarmaprasara ityādi | yadapi bhagavatā nānāprayāsasādhyaṁ karmaprasarayuktaṁ tantraṁ deśitam, na tat tattvābhiprāyeṇāpi tu sadvastuna sahajasya saṁvide'nubhūtaye, yataḥ karmaprasarasādhanārthaṁ te bhāvanāyāṁ pravartamānāstanmukhenaiva tatsaṁskāratiraskārāt svabhāvasiddhadharmatātmakaparamākāśarūpe sahaje praveśyanta ityābhiprāyikī tadvat tattantradeśanā, na tu tadanarthakatvamiti | dṛṣṭāntamāha - śabdajñānāyeti | yathā ṛṣibhirbāhyaiḥ śabdamātraparijñānāya tacchāstraṁ tacchabdaśāstraṁ kriyate, na tu tatkaraṇe kācit tattvāvagatiḥ, tathaiva karmānusāreṇa tadanurūpavarṇasaṁsthānānuguṇe prakriyāṁ naṭagāyanavad vidadhati gotramitraprākpuṇyopacaya -
parallel: sgra shes phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pas dpe gsungs te/ ji ltar phyi rol pa'i drang srong rnams kyis/ sgra tsam shes pa'i slad du de'i bstan bcos te sgra'i bstan bcos byed de/
de byed pa na 'ga' zhig gis de kho na nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba ma yin no/ / de kho na bzhin du las kyi rjes su 'brangs nas te/
de dang mthun pa'i kha dog dang dbyibs bgrang ba na/
rol mo dang glu mkhan la sogs pa bzhin du byed pa yin te/
rigs dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang sngon gyi bsod nams bsags pa dang yang dag pa'i smon lam med pas/

sanskrit: samyak praṇidhānābhāvānna niṣprapañcalābhino bhavanti, ye tu gotrādimantaste tatsākṣātkāriṇa eva syuḥ | yaduktam -
parallel: mi de rnams kyis spros pa med pa rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ / gang zhig rigs la sogs pa dang ldan pa de rnams kyis de mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ba kho na'o/ / de yang gsungs pa/
rgya che'i chos ni thos pa dang / / bshes gnyen bzang po bsten pa dang / /
rigs las kyang ni 'jug pa ste/ / 'di las 'gyod med byed par 'gyur/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: na kevalaṁ tattvaṁ na labhante, yāvat kāyaklamathayogāt svacetovikṣepe bhāvyamānaṁ kṛtrimaṁ tadapi nāsādayantītyubhayabhraṣṭatvāt pratipattimūḍhā vyāmohamāpadyante, "sukhitasya cittaṁ samādhīyate | samāhitacitto tathābhūtaṁ prajānāti" iti vacanāt | śrīguhyasamāje'pi -
parallel: de kho na nyid rnyed par mi 'gyur ba 'ba' zhig ma yin gyi/ ji srid du lus nyon mongs pa'i sbyor ba las rang gi sems rnam par bskyod pa'i sgom pa byed bzhin pa ni bcos ma ste de yang thob par mi 'gyur ro zhes pas gnyi ga nyams pa'i phyir sgrub pa ni rmongs shing cher rmongs pa nyid thob par 'gyur te/ bde ba dang ldan pa'i sems ni ting nge 'dzin du 'gyur la/
dpal gsung ba 'dus par yang / / sngags kyi sku yi rab sbyor gyis/ / byang chub med cing sgom pa med/ /
de ltar rnam dpyad mdor bsdus nas/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rnam par ni/ /
bsgom bya byang chub sbyor ba na/ / ting nge 'dzin ni sngags su brtags/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /
'bad pas nyon mongs ldang ba ste/ / zhes pa la sogs pa ste go sla'o/ / kha cig gis smras pa/ /

de gang gi phyir na de la kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byed pa'i rtog pa med pa'i phyir sangs rgyas nyid kyang de'i rang bzhin kho na'o zhe na/ brjod par bya ste/ rnam par mi rtog pa las sangs rgyas nyid do zhes pa dang / stong pa nyid ni de lta bu'o zhes pa ni snang brnyan gyi rang bzhin/
gzugs dang chad pa'i phyogs te/

sanskrit: kecidāhuḥ - nirvikalpaṁ samādhimāgamya buddhatvamadhigamyate, śūnyatābhāvanāvat | tasyāṁ hi sāṁkleśikavaiyavadānikavikalpābhāvāt | buddhatvaṁ ca tanmayameva | ucyate - nirvikalpānna buddhatvamiti | śūnyatā hi tādṛśī pratibhāsamayarūpocchedapakṣe | ubhayapakṣojjhitaṁ ca buddhatvamiti virodhaḥ | atha candravajrādikramotpannadevatāmūrtistathāgatāhaṅkāreṇa viśiṣṭavikalpasahitabuddhatvaprāptiheturbhaviṣyatīti tannirākaraṇārthamāha - savikalpācca no bhavet | evaṁvidhādākāraviśeṣād bhāvitādapi na buddhatvam, viśiṣṭāviśiṣṭayorvikalpayorbhedābhāve saṁsārahetutvāt | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: phyogs gnyi ga spangs pa ni sangs rgyas nyid do zhes pa dang 'gal ba'o/ / yang zla ba dang rdo rje la sogs pa'i rim pa las skyes pa'i lha'i sku de bzhin gshegs par nga rgyal ba'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa ni sangs rgyas nyid 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro zhe na/ de sel ba'i slad du/

sanskrit: ko hi bhedo vikalpasya śubhe vā'pyaśubhe'pi vā |
parallel: yang gsungs pa/ dge'am mi dge na yang rung / / rtog par bye brag ci zhig yod/ /
rten gyi dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ / mes sreg nyid du bye brag med/ / ces so/ /

sanskrit: ityādi | kutastarhi tat syādityāha - suviśuddhetyādi | skandhādeḥ svabhāvaparijñānāt tad bhavati | yato'mī skandhādayaḥ svabhāvata eva mahāsukhaparyāyasahajaviśuddhāḥ, tata eṣāṁ na kenaciddharmeṇa viyogaḥ saṁyogo vā kartuṁ pāryate | ākāśasyai(sye)va kavyādibhiḥ | svabhāvaparijñānamātrameva ca mukhyaṁ tatkāraṇam, na tvanyaditi tat kathitaṁ bhavati | tacca nirdeṣṭṛgurvadhīnam | samayamātramanyat ||12||
parallel: skyes pa rnam par dag pa rnams so/ / de'i phyir bral ba'am sbyor ba'i chos 'ga' zhig gis ni 'di rnams byed par nus pa ma yin no/ / rtsig pa la sogs pa rnams nam mkha' lta bur rang bzhin yongs su shes pa kho na rgyu'i gtso bo dang / de byed pa yin gyi gzhan ni ma yin no zhes bya ba 'di bshad pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: nanu parijñānaṁ parijñātāraṁ vinā na saṁbhavatītyubhayasmin kathamadvayaṁ tattvaṁ syāditi kriyākārakabhāvaṁ nirākartumāha - svarūpataḥ kriyā nāstītyādi | bhāvānāṁ
parallel: gnyis yin na ji ltar de kho na nyid gnyis su med par 'gyur zhe na/ / bya ba dang byed pa'i dngos po sel bar byed pa/ bya ba rang bzhin las yod min/ /

sanskrit: svarūpataḥ kriyā nāsti kārakaṁ ca svarūpataḥ |
parallel: dngos po rnams kyi 'ong ba dang 'gro ba la sogs pa'i bya ba dang byed pa po rnams su rtogs par dbyer med pa'o zhes pa la phyogs gnyis so/ / dang po byed pa po kho na yin na bya ba mi 'thob la/ gnyis pa la byed pa po ci zhig yin te/
de'i bdag nyid yin na ni dbyer med pa'i phyir sngar bshad pa'i skyon no/ / de las byung ba yin na ni/ bya ba skyes pa na byed pa zhig pa'i phyir gang gi bya ba yin/

sanskrit: gamanāgamanādilakṣaṇā kriyā kārakād ganturabhinnā bhinnā veti pakṣadvayam | ādye kartaiva, kriyā na prāpnoti | dvitīyasmin kartuḥ kim ? kriyā'bhinnatvāt | tayoḥ sambandhastasmin sati cet, tasmin tādātmye bhedābhāvāt prāgukto doṣaḥ | tadutpattau kāryotpāde karaṇavināśāt kasya kriyā | sakartṛkā ca kriyeṣyate | kṣaṇikeṣu bhāveṣu kasya kena sambandhaḥ ? santānakṛtaśca sambandhaḥ kalpito na vāstavaḥ, tasyātītādiṣvasattvāt,
parallel: byed pa po dang bcas par yang ji ltar brjod de/ dngos po rnams ni skad cig ma yin pa'i phyir na su zhig gang la 'brel pa yin/ rgyun la gzhag pa'i 'brel pa yang brtags pa ste/
de'i 'das pa la sogs pa la yod pa nyid kyi phyir te/ shes bya las sngar gal te shes/ / de ni ci la dmigs nas byung / /
shes las gal te shes bya snga/ / de ni ci la dmigs nas byung / /
shes dang shes byas lhan cig na/ / de ni ci la dmigs nas byung / / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: iti vacanāt | kāryakāraṇabhāvakṛto'pi sambandho nopapadyate, hetuphalayorasiddheḥ sāpekṣatvāditi kriyākārakabhāvojjhitaṁ sarvamidaṁ vastu | tataśca parijñātṛparijñānābhāvādadvayameva tattvaṁ siddham | etaccodbhāvanā saṁvṛtyā pratipādyate, svarūpaprakāśaparijñānasyāpi tatraivāstamayāt | tailabhṛrti sumutsṛṣṭamukuraka iva śvāsavātasya | dāhyābhāvādagneriva jvālāpuñjasya prayogaḥ | yo yasmādabhinnaḥ sa tadātmā, guḍamādhuryavat | kriyā ca kartu ranuraktaḥ ||13||
parallel: byed pa po dang bya ba tha mi dad pa'i sbyor ba ni gang zhig gang las tha mi dad pa de ni de'i bdag nyid de bu ram dang mngar ba lta bu'o/ / bya ba'ang byed pa po las tha mi dad pas logs su bya ba med pa ste/ rang bzhin gyi gtan tshigs so/ /
'gal ba dmigs pa 'am rgyu 'gal ba dmigs pa'o/ / 'o na gal te de ltar yin na chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gang yin zhe na/ kun gyi rang bzhin zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/

thog ma las ma skyes pa'i ngo bo yi ge a sprul pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa ste/ chos kyi sku ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i dpe ni rin po che rnams kyi 'byung gnas rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /
re zhig 'jig rten ni gzhan gyi dpes bdag la sogs pa yod pa'i tha snyad dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa ni rang gi sde ba ste/ de ni 'gal ba ni/ bdag la sogs pa med pa'i tha snyad de/

sanskrit: asti vā nāsti vā caiva svarūpaṁ naiva buddyate ||15||
parallel: yod pa'am med pa nyid kyi yang / / zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ bstan pa thams cad la grags pa'i yod pa dang / med pa lta ba dag tshad ma'i stobs kyis 'grub pa ste/
rang bzhin nyid kyi sbyor ba ni/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ phyogs gnyis la ma zhen pa yongs su shes pa 'dis sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro/ /

de bas na rang bzhin yongs su shes pas lhan cig skyes pa rtogs pa yin te/ de nyid lam yin pas mthong ba dang sgom pa la sogs pa ni ma yin no/ / de bas na rang bzhin gyi lam la brten nas thams cad byed pa ni/
dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa/
gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/
rgyas pa bstan pa dang po'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /
de nas gang yang rung zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/

sanskrit: athānya duddeśanirdeśa rūpāditantrātmakasya skandhadhātvāyatanasvarūpasya dehināṁ dehasya yathā svadevatārūpaṁ kathayiṣyāmi ||1||
parallel: de nas zhes bya ba ni bstan pa dang po 'das ma thag pa la'o/ / gzugs can rnams ni rnam pa bzhi'i sems can gyi rigs gnas dgu'i bdag nyid kyi 'khor ba la gnas pa gang yin pa de'i lus kho na phung po la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid du rgyud kyi nang nas ston pa ste/ de nyid lha'i mtshan nyid ni dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du bshad par bya'o/ /

de nyid rnam par mdzes pa'i phyir rnam par snang mdzad ni me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin te/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i phyi rol gyi sku dkar po can ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du tshor ba ni bde ba la sogs pa dang tha mi dad pa'i ngo bo rang byung gi cha gang yin pa de nyid rdo rje nyi ma ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi rin chen 'byung ldan te/

rnam pa dang bcas pa'i sku ser po ni ma yin no/ / de bzhin du 'du shes pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ces bya ba ni/ pad+ma'i nang na gar dbang 'dra ba'i byed pa'i de nyid du dbang byed pas na pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ste/

sanskrit: ya ete kuśalādayaḥ saṁskārā vyaktidvayā preraṇajanitavicitra sattvanirmāṇaḥ (ṇāḥ), sa (ta) eva vajreṣu tathāgateṣu madhye rājanād vajrarāṭ | viramānte paramāśvaḥ kṛtyānuṣṭhānajñānasvabhāvo na tu śyāmaḥ ||1-2||
parallel: gang zhig dge ba la sogs pa 'di rnams 'du byed cing cha gnyis po bskul ba las skyes pa'i sems can gyi sprul pa sna tshogs pa de nyid rdo rje ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbus su gsal ba'i phyir rdo rje rgyal po'o/ / dga' bral gyi mthar rta mchog ste bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin gyi sngo bsangs ni ma yin no/ /

gang rnam par shes pa'i dngos po 'di rnams yongs su gcod par byed pa de nyid rdo rje ltar mi phyed pa'i sems dpa' gang yin pa de ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ snying stobs dang rdul gyi cha gnyis po ro mnyam par byed pa'i mtshan nyid mi bskyod pa dang thugs kyi rdo rje shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin gyi phyi rol gyi kha dog sngon po ni ma yin no/ /
de bzhin du sngar gsungs pa'i lnga po thams cad kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i bdag nyid can te/

sanskrit: yadetad vijñānaṁ vastu paricchedakaṁ sa eva vajravadabhedyaṁ sattvaṁ yasya sa vajrasattvaḥ sattvarajovyaktidvayasamarasīkaraṇalakṣaṇo'kṣobhyaścittavajraḥ suviśuddhadharmadhātujñānasvabhāvo na tu nīlacchavirvāhyaḥ | tathā prāguktānāṁ pañcānāṁ sarveṣāṁ rūpaṁ sahajātmakasyāstīti sarvarūpī vyāpako yaḥ sa śrīheruko bhagavān ṣaṣṭho mahāvajradharaḥ, dharmatāsvabhāvo vijñeya iti śeṣaḥ | uktaṁ śrīguhyasamāje -
parallel: 'di'i yod pa'o zhes pas thams cad kyi gzugs can khyab pa byed pa po bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka gang yin pa ni drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po ste/ chos nyid kyi rang bzhin gyi byang chub tu shes par bya'o zhes pa ni lhag ma'o/ / dpal gsang ba 'dus par yang gsungs pa/
mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ / sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu bsgrags/ /
zhes dang / dgongs pa lung bstan par yang / /

sanskrit: skandhā eva hi sambuddhā bodhyarthaṁ pratyayodbhavāḥ |
parallel: phung po kho na rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / byang chub don phyir rkyen du 'byung / /
de bzhin gshegs pa brjod de rnams/ / gnyis med de bzhin nyid du sbyor/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: paṁcabuddhātmaku sarvajago'yaṁ paśyatu citraku nāṭaku divyam |
parallel: 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas lnga bdag nyid/ / lha yi zlos gar mchog tu bkra ba ltos/ /

sanskrit: yatra hi eku mahāsukhanāmā nṛtyati eku anekarasena || iti |
parallel: gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu ste/ / gcig pu du ma'i nyams kyis gar mdzad do/ /
zhes so/ / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du yang /
mi bskyod nyid ni 'gro zhes bya/ / 'dod chags thams cad rnam par spangs/ /
rtag pa yi ni khrir gsungs te/ / rdor mtshan rdo rje can bye ba/ /
dpag med tshe dpag med par bshad/ / nam mkha' ji srid bdun gyi rgyal/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /
de bzhin du kha sbyor du yang /
ma las skyes pa gsum dang ni/ / pha las skyes pa'i cha gsum nyid/ /
lus kyi cha drug 'di rnams ni/ / de bzhin gshegs pa'i lus can drug / ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /
skye mched rnams dpa' bo rnams su sbyar ba'i phyir/ mig la gti mug rdo rjer bshad/ / ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/
mig gnyis po gti mug rdo rje ste/
gzugs kyi yul la sred pa med pa nyid kyis de sdud pa'i phyir na yul gzhan la rab tu 'jug pa ni gti mug ste/ 'od gsal ba'o/ / rdo rje ni mi phyed pa ste/
sku'i 'khor lo las stobs po cher bshad pa'o/ /

sanskrit: āyatanāni vīrairniyojayitumāha - netre tu mohavajrākhye ityādi | netradvayaṁ mohavajro rūpaviṣayaṁ pratyalampaṭatvena tadāharaṇena viṣayāntarakaraḥ pravṛttermohaḥ prabhāsvarastatra vajro'bhedyaḥ kāyacakrānmahābalaḥ | śrutiḥ śrotrendriyaṁ dveṣavajraścittacakrāt khaṇḍakapāliḥ, śabdagrahaṇe sāmarasyād vikalpāntaravidveṣāt ||3||
parallel: rna ba'i dbang po ni zhe sdang rdo rje ste thugs kyi 'khor lo las khaN+Da ka pA la'o/ / sgra 'dzin pa na ro gcig pa nyid kyi phyir na rnam par rtog pa gzhan la sdang ba'i phyir ro/ / sna'i dbang po ni phrag dog rdo rje ste gsung gi 'khor lo las mig mi bzang ngo / /

sanskrit: ghrāṇendriyamīrṣyāvajro vākcakrād birūpākṣaḥ | ahameva sarvātmanā sarvagandhopabhoktā, nānyaḥ kaścidasti, vyāpakatvāt | mukhaṁ mukhasthaṁ jihvendriyaṁ rāgavajro vākcakrādādyo'ṅkurikaḥ | sparśa iti kāyendriyaṁ mātsaryavajraḥ kāyacakrāntād vajrasattvo vīro vyāpakatvāt | sarvamudrāpadmasparśasukhaṁ mayaivānubhūtaṁ nānyeneti mātsaryam ||4||
parallel: dang po myu gu can no/ / reg pa lus kyi dbang po ni ser sna rdo rje 'khor lo'i mtha' las rdo rje sems dpa'o/ / dbang po thams cad kyi khyab par byed pa yin pa'i phyir na phyag rgya ma thams cad kyi pad+mar reg pa'i bde ba'i rang bzhin kho na myong zhing gzhan du ma yin pas na ser sna'o/ /

sanskrit: sarvāyatanaṁ mana indriyam | herukaścittacakrāntād vajradehaḥ sarvendriyavyāpako jñeyaḥ | ṣaṭ cakravartina ityeke -
parallel: skye mched thams cad ni yid kyi dbang po he ru ka ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mtha' las rdo rje'i lus so/ / dbang po thams cad la khyab par byed pa nyid du shes par bya ste/ / 'khor los sgyur ba drug pa'o zhes kha cig ste/

yang na sa'i snying po dang phyag na rdo rje dang nam mkha'i snying po dang 'jig rten dbang phyug dang sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang dpal ldan kun du bzang po ste 'di rnams mig la sogs pa'i 'du shes de rnams la'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /
gtso bos ni bde ba chen pos phug pa nyid kyi phyir 'di rnams ni dpa' bo'i zol gyis rnyed par 'gyur gyi/
rdo rje dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ni ma yin te/
brtag pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: iti vacanāt | mukhyatastu mahāsukhānuviddhatvādetāni vīravyapadeśaṁ labhante, na tu vajravajraghaṇṭādharāḥ, kalpitatvāt | śrīsamāje'pi -
parallel: dpal gsang ba 'dus par yang / /
rdo rje'i skye mched nyid kyang ni/ / byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /
ces pa'i tshul gyis so/ /

sanskrit: dhātutattvamāha - pātanītyādi | yo'yaṁ pṛthivīdhāturasthimāṁsādinirmāṇacakraṁ vā samāpattau kāṭhinyasparśo vā, sā pātanī ḍākinī tadabhiniveśavikalpanirdalanī śūnyatā-ānanda-maitrī-upāyasvabhāvā jñeyā | yo'yamabdhātu rjalāsṛgādi dharmacakraṁ vā samāpattau dravasparśo vā, sā māraṇī lāmā tadabhiniveśakṣayakarī animitta-paramakaruṇā-praṇidhisvabhāvā jñeyā | yo'yaṁ tejodhāturgātreṣūṣmā saṁbhogacakraṁ vā samāpattāvahimasparśo vā jñānāgnijvālā vā sā''karṣaṇī tadabhiniveśavidhvaṁsikā khaṇḍarohā apraṇihita-viramamuditābalasvabhāvā jñeyā | tathā yo'yaṁ vāyudhāturgamanāgamanākuñcanaprasāraṇalakṣaṇo mahāsukhacakraṁ vā samāpattau spharaṇaṁ vā praveśanirgamo(mau) vā praveśosthiti vyutthānaṁ vā divāniśaṁ dvayayutaṣoḍaśaśatasvā(śvā)sasaṁcāro vā sā narteśvarī nṛtyasya sarvāṅgasādhyasya karmaṇa īśvarī rūpiṇī abhisaṁskāra sahajānandā-upekṣā-jñānasvabhāvā vijñeyā |
parallel: snyoms par zhugs pa'i dus su sra ba'i reg pa gang yin pa ste de ni ltung byed ma dang mkha' 'gro ma'o/ / der mngon par zhen pa'i rnam par rtog pa bcom pa stong pa nyid dang / dga' ba dang / byams pa dang / thabs kyi rang bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / gang 'dir chu'i khams ni chu dang khrag la sogs pa'am/

sanskrit: etā eva karma-dharma-samaya-mahāmudrā eva mayā saṁketitāśca draṣṭavyāḥ | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: de rnams e baM ma yA'i brdas bstan pa yin no/ / yang gsungs pa/ 'di rnams nyid las dang / chos dang / dam tshig dang / phyag rgya chen po ste/
sa ni spyan mar brjod pa ste/ chu khams gsod byed ma ru dran/ /
me ni gos dkar mo yin te/ / rlung ni sgrol mar rab tu grags/ /
zhes pa dang / gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal bar yang /

sanskrit: "ekāraḥ pṛthivī jñeyā karmamudrā tu locanā" ityādi |

de bzhin du/
kye'i rdo rje las/ bol+la kak+ko la sbyor bas/ / sa ni de la skye bar 'gyur/ /
de bzhin du nam mkha'i khams ni rtsa thams cad kyi bug pa'am/

sanskrit: sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ tathā karma kleśādikamupetya vaiv|
parallel: dbang po'i sgo rnams kyi bug pa'am/
ba spu'i bu ga'i nam mkha' yang rung ste/
de ni pad+ma'i dra ba can ma zhes bya ba phag mo'o/ /
pad+ma'i rtsa 'dra ba'i rje mo ste/ /
de ni chags pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos pa/

sanskrit: tathā yo'yamākāśadhātuḥ sarvanāḍīsauśīryamindriyadvārasauśīrya vā romakūpavyoma vā sā padmajvālinī nāma vārāhī padmāntarnāḍījālasya svāminī taduparāgapaṅkairaliptā grāhyagrāhakavikalpottīrṇaprāguktadhātucatuṣṭayavyāpinī vijñeyeti | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa las grol ba/ sngar bshad pa'i khams bzhi po la khyab pa mor rnam par shes par bya'o/ / yang gsungs pa/
nam mkha'i khams kyi gzugs su gnas/ / de nyid mkha' spyod ma ru dran/ / zhes so/ /
rdo rje gur du yang /
khams rnams kun gyi dbus su gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / nam mkha'i gcig pu'i rang bzhin gyis/ / thub pa chen po 'dir bzhugs so/ /
zhes dgongs pa lung ston pa las gsungs pa las so/ / 'di ltar zhes pa la sogs pas nye bar bsdu ba gsungs te/

sanskrit: upasaṁhāramāha - ityevamityādi | anena nyāyena sarvadehināṁ traidhātukasthitānāṁ dehaḥ skandhāgrayo devatātmako vijñeyaḥ, na bāhyo mukhabhujādiyuktaḥ | tasmād ya ete skandhakaraṇḍakāntargatāḥ sukhaduḥkhakleśakarmotpādabhaṅgādayaḥ, sarve te tadabhedād devatātmakā eva | ata eva yaḥ saṁsāraḥ sa eva nirvāṇam, na tayoḥ kaścid bheda iti ||7||
parallel: phung po'i za ma tog gi nang du son pa'i bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang / nyon mongs pa dang / las dang / skye ba dang / 'jig pa la sogs pa gang yin pa 'di rnams thams cad du de dang dbyer med pa'i phyir lha'i bdag nyid can kho na'o/ / 'khor ba gang yin pa 'di nyid mya ngan las 'das pa yang de kho na yin te/
de dag gi dbye ba ni 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin no zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/
rgyas par bstan pa gnyis pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

sanskrit: athānyatamasya tathāgatakāyasya kāyavākcitta gatādhamamadhyamottama prabhedena dvārabheda kathayiṣyāmi ||1||
parallel: de'i don ni go sla'o/ / ka ba gcig ces bya ba la sogs pas rgyas par bstan pa gsungs te/ lus can thams cad kyi lus ni re zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid can no zhes le'u gnyis pas rtogs par byas pa de rnams kyi gang las 'jug pa dang 'byung bar gyur pa de rnams kyi tha ma dang / 'bring dang / mchog gi dbye bas sgo rnams rtogs par bya ba'i phyir de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas mdor bstan pa la 'jug ste/
gang 'di rnams thams cad lha'i sku can te/ der ka ba gcig ni sgras tshigs kyi sgras brjod par bya ba rgyab kyi phyogs su/
bshang lam dang / ltag pa dag gi bar las brtsams te/ /

sanskrit: sarvadehitāṁ dehastāvat tathāgatātmaka iti dvitīyapaṭalena pratipādya teṣāṁ yaiḥ praveśanirgamau bhavatastānyadhamamadhyamottamabhedena dvārāṇi pratipādayitumathetyādinā'vatārya stā(tā)nyuddiṣṭavān | tadarthastu sugamaḥ ||1||
parallel: de ji srid du arbu da'i mthil du khyab par gnas pa ka ba lta bu'o/ /

sanskrit: nirdeśamāha - ekastambhamityādinā | yadetat sarvadaivataṁ śarīraṁ tadekastambhaṁ kaṅkālaśabdavācyaṁ pṛṣṭhābhāge kaṭikūrparamadhyādārabhya tadyāvadarbudatalaṁ vyāpya sthitaṁ sthūṇāprāyaṁ yasya, vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoścatuviṁśativīraprāyāḥ pārśvasthitakarṇikāvīra-yoginīsvabhāvāstricakrasaṁgṛhītā vidyante yasmiṁśca, teṣāṁ madhye vartamānastadādhāro daṇḍo bhūrbhuvaḥsvarādhāraḥ śrīherukarūpeṇa mahākaṅkālavyapadeśabhāk | tādṛgekaḥ stambho yasya | saṁpuṭe'pyuktam -
parallel: gang gi g.yon dang g.yas kyi logs dag tu dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi lta bu dang / logs su gnas pa'i thigs pa dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin/ 'khor lo gsum gyis bsdus par rig par bya ste/ gang du de rnams kyi dbus su 'jug bzhin pa de'i rten gyi dbyug pas 'og dang / lha'i gnas su he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi keng rus chen mo'i zol gyis phye ba de lta bu gang gi yin pa ni ka ba gcig pa'o/ /
kha sbyor du yang gsungs pa/ logs kyi rtsib ma bcu gnyis dag/ / nyis 'gyur du ni gyur pa las/ /
dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kyis/ / kun nas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /
sgal tshigs dbyug pa'i rnam pa 'di/ / mchog gi he ru ka yi rten/ /
phung po khams sogs sangs rgyas kyis/ /
ka ba zhes ni mngon brjod bya/ /

sanskrit: aparaṁ caturvidhaṁ dvāraṁ vācikaṁ madhyamaṁ smṛtam ||3||
parallel: zhes pa dang / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gror yang / /
zhes pa dang / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gror yang / /

sanskrit: yathā stambhena mahatā dhriyate līlayā gṛham |
parallel: ji ltar ka ba chen po yis/ / rol pa'i khyim ni gzung bya ba/ /
de bzhin sgo dgu can gyi lus/ / sgal tshigs nyid kyis gzung bar bya/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: athavā - ekastambha iva stambho'vadhūtī, sarvasya nāḍīcakrasya dhāraṇe, etadyukta -tvādekastambham |
parallel: yang na ka ba gcig lta bu'i ka ba ste a ba d+hU tI'o/ / rtsa thams cad kyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa la 'di rnams ni brjod pa kho na las rtsa rnams kyi dbus su ka ba gcig ste/
lte ba'i dbus na 'khor lo che/ / skud pa bcu drug dang ldan pa/ /
yi ge a dang yang dag ldan/ / kha sbyor byed pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /
thams cad bzhi yi ngo bo nyid/ / de yi dbus su gnas pa gang / / ka bar gyur pa rgyal mo che/ /
ka bar gyur pa rnams kyi rgyal po chen mo de ni a ba d+hU tIr rab tu bsgrags so/ / gzhan yang ji lta bu zhe na/ rgyun dgu zhes bya ba la sogs pas/

sanskrit: navadvāramityādyuddeśaḥ | nirdeśamāha - anyacca kīdṛśaṁ navaśro(sro)ta ityādi | nava śro(sro)tāṁsi cakṣurdvaya-śrotradvaya-ghrāṇadvaya-vaktra-guhya-gudākhyāni yasmin tattathā | ekaikaṁ ca dvāraṁ navadhā parikīrtitam | tathāhi- cakṣurindriyasya pṛthivyaptejovāyvākāśa-
parallel: gsang ba dang / bshang lam du brjod pa gang yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / re re la yang sgo rnam pa dgur rab tu bsgrags te/ de ltar mig gi dbang po ni sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa dang / dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / gnyi ga'i sems las byung ba'i chos dang ldan pa nyid la sa dgur rab tu dbye ste/

sanskrit: vijñānakuśalākuśalobhayacaitasikadharmayuktatvānnava prabhedāḥ | evamanyatrāpyūhyam | te ca pañcabuddhacaturyoginīsvabhāvāḥ | evaṁ dvāraṁ dvāraṁ navātmakamaṇḍalacakramu (yu)ktamiti jñātavyam | evaṁ ca navanave(nava)tidvāramapi śarīramekāśītidvāraṁ jāyate | yat (ye) tebhyo niṣpandāste'pi tathāgatā eveti boddhavyam ||2||
parallel: yang de bzhin du sgo yang dgu phrag dgu'o zhes pas/ lus la sgo brgyad cu rtsa gcig tu shes par bya ste/ de rnams las 'dzag pa gang yin pa de rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa nyid do zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: tadarthamāha - adhamaṁ kāyikaṁ dvāraṁ sthūlaṁ daivatanirmitamiti | yadetat kāyikaṁ dvāraṁ navadhā saparicchadaṁ tadeva pratibhāvapratibhāsamānarūpatvādadharma (mam), bahīrūpeṇa prakāśanād(t | a)dharma(ma)śca svaniṣpandavahanānna punarhīnatvāt | ata
parallel: de'i don ni/ lus can gyi ni tha ma'i sgo/ / rigs pa'i lha ru sprul pa

sanskrit: vāgdvāramāha - aparam, ityādyuddeśaḥ | kāyacittayormadhye vartamānatvād madhyaṁ vāgdvāraṁ caturvidhaṁ jñeyam ||3||
parallel: gzhan zhes bya ba la sogs pas ngag gi sgo mdor bstan pa gsungs te/ lus dang sems dag gi bar du 'jug bzhin pa nyid kyi phyir 'bring po ste/ ngag gi sgo ni rnam pa bzhir shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: nirdeśamāha - āgneyamityādi | iha catvāryagnivāyumāhendravāruṇākhyāni yathākramaṁ kaṇṭhanābhiguhyahṛdayasthāni padmanarteśaparamāśvaratnasaṁbhavākṣobhyarūpāṇi, khaṇḍarohārūpinīlāmāḍākinīsvabhāvāni dakṣiṇavāmobhaya stacca(taśca) mandapracārāṇi raktaharitapītaśuklavarṇāni pradhānaguṇabhedena parasparaṁ tu caturthasaṁkhyāni divāniśaṁ caturviśatisañcārapraveśādinā ṣoḍaśaśatādhikadvayayutaśvāsavāhīni sarvadehisvasaṁvedyāni nāḍīcakrāṇi vidyante | yeṣu vāyuvāhanasya vijñānasya pratikṣaṇaṁ saṁcāraḥ pravṛttirgamanāgamanayogenānubhūyate | tānyeva vācikadvārāṇi | tebhya eva vāmadakṣiṇamadhyanāḍīrandhrayuktebhyo bhagavatī varṇamātṛkodeti | hetuphalayorabhedānmukhāṁ tasyā vyaktisthānameva | te ca praveśādayo vahnayādīnām | kathamityāha - ūrdetyādi | yathākramamūrdhve'gnimaṇḍalaṁ pravartate, havirbhujāmūrdhvato jvalanāt | vāyumaṇḍaladvāraṁ pārśvābhyāṁ vahati, vāyoḥ kuṭilagamanāt | māhendramṛju spaṣṭaṁ vahati, tasya samatvāt | vāruṇamadho vahati, apāmadha eva prayāṇam | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: me dang / rlung dang / dbang chen dang / chur bshad pa rnams te/ go rims bzhin du mgrin pa dang / lte ba dang / gsang ba dang / snying gar gnas pa pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / rta mchog dang / rin chen 'byung ldan dang / mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin can dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can ma dang / lA ma dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin te/ g.yas dang / g.yon dang / gnyi ga dang / rengs shing dal bar rgyu ba can dmar po dang / ljang gu dang / ser po dang / dkar po'i kha dog can rnams so/ /
ci ltar zhe na/ steng du zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ bzhin du me'i dkyil 'khor ni steng du rab tu 'jug ste/
byin za gyen du 'bar ba'i phyir ro/ /
rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni logs kyi sgo dag las 'bab ste/

sanskrit: praveśā nnirgamā ccaiva dvāraṁ caivottamaṁ bhavet ||5||
parallel: dbang chen ni drang por reg cing 'bab ste/
chu ni 'og tu 'bab ste/ chu rnams ni thur kho nar 'bab pa'i phyir ro/ / yang gsungs pa/
'di ni kha dog dmar por gsal/ /
'di la pad+ma mgon po lha/ / dung dang kun+da lta bur dkar/ / rengs shing dal bar rgyu ba yang / /

sanskrit: maṇḍalaṁ vāruṇaṁ hyetad vajranātho'tra devatā || iti |
parallel: 'di ni chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ / 'di la rdo rje mgon po lha/ / zhes so/ /
ji skad du/ sgron ma bzhi par yang /
'gro ba bzhi ni steng dang ni/ / logs dang drang po 'og tu yang / / zhes so/ /
kha sbyor du yang /

sanskrit: āgneye caiva vāyavye māhendre vāruṇe tathā |
parallel: me dang nges par rlung dang ni/ / de bzhin dbang chen dang ni chu/ /
'khor lor sems kyi rgyu ba las/ / steng logs drang po 'og tu 'gro/ /
zhes pa dang / dgongs pa lung ston las kyang /
'khor lo sems kyi rgyu ba las/ / steng logs drang po 'og tu 'gro/ /

sanskrit: tāsāṁ madhye svadaivatyaṁ turyayogaḥ parasparam || iti ||4||
parallel: de rnams dbus su rang lha nyid/ / phan tshun du ni bzhi pa sbyor/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: cittadvāramāha - tṛtīyaṁ kāyavāgdvārāpekṣayā | mānasamiti manomātragamyam | katham ? candrasūryaprabhedata iti | candrasūyau vāmadakṣiṇābhyāṁ nāḍībhyāṁ dvābhyāṁ bhedābhyāṁ vahataḥ | ūrdhvaṁ vāyukrameṇādho dravyakrameṇa prāṇā pānaṁ(na)-śukra raktavahanāt | ataḥ sūkṣmayogagamyatvādevottamaṁ dvāram | tathā cāha-praveśānnirgamācceti | ūrdhva prāṇāpānayoḥ, adha iti dravyayoḥ praveśanirgamābhyām | athavā adha iti praveśāt, ūrdhvaṁ nirgamāt | etaduttamaṁ dvāram | kena dvāreṇa kasya pravṛttirityāha - adhodvāreṇetyādi |
parallel: zla ba nyi ma ni g.yon dang g.yas kyi rtsa ste/ / gnyis po'i dbye bas 'bab pa las dang / steng du rlung gi rim pas srog dang rtsol ba dang / 'og tu rdzas kyi rim pas khu ba dang khrag 'bab pa las so/ / 'di las na phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyis rtogs par bya ba kho na yin pa'i phyir mchog gi sgo'o/ /
de bzhin du yang /
steng du srog dang rtsol ba dag gi dang / 'og tu rdzas dag gi 'jug pa dang 'byung ba dag las so/ / yang na 'og gi 'jug pa las dang / steng ni 'byung ba las so/ /

sanskrit: adhodvāreṇa lalalnāmārgeṇa viśiṣṭaṁ jñānaṁ vijñānaṁ mahāsukhākhyaṁ pravartate, vyaktidvayasyādhaḥ pravṛttau sahajodayād vasantakālaprādurbhāvāt | ūrdhvadvāreṇa rasanākhyena dhātavaḥ pṛthivyādisvabhāvāścakṣurādimalāḥ prādurbhavanti, klinnagandhādiśmaśānarūpatvāt | athavā adhodvāreṇa vijñānādiskandhapañcakaṁ dehināṁ dehe prādurbhavati, skandhapañcakasyāntarmukhatvāt | ūrdhvadvāreṇa dhātavaḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ pañcamahābhūtāni jāyante, bahirmukhatvāt | ||5-6||
parallel: yang na 'og gi sgo nas rnam par shes pa la sogs pa'i phung po lnga po lus can rnams kyi lus la snang bar 'gyur te/ phung po lnga po ni nang gi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / steng gi sgo nas sa la sogs pa'i khams 'byung ba lnga po skye bar 'gyur te/

sanskrit: tathā ya ete cakṣurādiṣaṭpravṛttivijñānakāyā vairocanādibuddhasvabhāvā rūpādiviṣayaṣaṭakagrahaṇāyordhvadvāreṇa calāḥ pravartamānāsteṣāṁ viṣayadevatā nirviśyāghrodvāreṇa paripūrṇecchānāṁ sthitiḥ praveśo 'nubhūyate | antaḥpraviṣṭānāṁ teṣāṁ punarūrdhvadvāreṇa visṛjyante, svadevatopabhogārthamiti śeṣaḥ | athavā mahāsukhacakrādvijñānaṁ viśiṣṭajñānaṁ samanvāgataḥ(tam) | adhodvāreṇa lalanādimārgeṇa padmakośaṁ prāpnoti yogabalāttadevordhvamārgeṇākṛṣṭaṁ dhātavaścaturviṁśatidhātvatipuṣṭikaraṁ caturṣvādipīṭheṣu jāyate | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: 'jug bzhin pa de rnams kyi yul lhar mngon par zhen pa'i sgo nas 'dod pa rdzogs pa rnams gnas pa ni 'jug par rig par bya'o/ / nang du rab tu 'jug pa de rnams slar yang steng gi sgo nas gtong bar byed de rang gi lha la nye bar longs spyod pa'i slad du'o/ / yang na bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo las rnam par shes pa ste khyad par du 'phags pa'i shes pa dang ldan pa 'og gi sgo nas la la nA'i lam gyis pad+ma'i nang du thob par 'gyur ro/ /
yang smras pa/ nyi ma rnam par rgyas pa'i 'od kyis mdzes ma ni/ / stobs chen sgra yi gos kyis mdzes pa'i ze'u 'bru las/ /
mgo bo'i rtse mor sgeg cing legs par yongs gang ba'i/ / 'od kyis mtshan pa'i ri bong can ni sar pa 'char/ /
sna tshogs me tog ro yis myos pa'i rig pa yang / / myur dang dal ba bar ma la ni klung gi sgra/ /
bung ba nyer lhags mtshan phyed dga' ston chen por ni/ / 'dzin par byed cing der son blo ni ngo mtshar ro/ /
'char ba'i nub pa nyer 'ongs mtshan mor byed pa slar/ / 'di las kyang ni g.yo med cod pan la ni 'char/ /

sanskrit: ubhayakoṭi kalāpinirīkṣaṇe na ca śaśī na vibhāti divākaraḥ ||
parallel: mtha' gnyis pa yi cha zad skad cig la/ / zla ba nyi ma snang bar 'gyur ma yin/ /
rgya mtsho'i chu yi dbus su nyi ma 'char ba ste/ /

sanskrit: vrajati cordhvamasau pralayānalo gilati rāhuradhaḥ śaśibhāskarau ||
parallel: rtse mo las kyang zla ba nub par 'gyur ba yin/ /
song ba'i steng gi sgra gcan 'jig dus me 'dis ni/ /
'og gi bsil zer byed pa dag ni khyur mid byed/ /
pad+ma can ni pad+ma'i bzhin te spyan ma ru/ /
rab tu gsal te yul dang yul can 'dres pa yin/ /
dang por mi shes 'di ni de las gzhan du na/ /
rdo rje chu skyes gnyis po 'dres pa 'di ru'o/ /
skad cig sgrub pa po ni sa bon nyed pa las/ /
sdom pa gsum po thob par 'gyur te bzhi pa can/ /
lhan skyes mi zad gnas kyi cha shas phreng ba ni/ / blangs pa'i dus su brjod pa dang bral lhag pa'o/ /
gal te legs par bslab pa'i rdo rje sgeg mo dang / / bla ma yi ni zhal nas rtogs shing thob 'gyur ba/ /

sanskrit: bhavati yasya tadottamamadhyamādhamaviniścayameti sa tattvavit || iti ||7||
parallel: gang gi yin pa de tshe mchog 'bring sgrub pa ni/ / rnam par nges pa thob 'gyur de ni de nyid rig / ces so/ /

sanskrit: ata evāha - āvāhanetyādi | anenordhvādhodvārabhedena ye gatyāgatirūpe visarjanāhvāne tena rūpeṇa traiyadhvikāḥ sarvabuddhāstricakrasthā dhāturūpāścaturviṁśatirvīrāḥ śrīherukaḥ pañcaviṁśatitamaḥ, tathā ḍākinyo'ṣṭāviṁśatirjñānacittavākkāyacakrasthā abhedyādināḍī madhye yogamātaraścakṣurādidvāreṇa nāḍīsvabhāvāḥ | siddhā vīrāḥ
parallel: 'dis ni steng dang 'og gi sgo'i dbye bas 'gro ba dang 'ong ba'i tshul de gshegs su gsol ba dang / spyan drang ba'i tshul gang dag yin pa de dag gi dus gsum pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad de 'khor lo gsum du gnas pa'i dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams dang / nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dpal he ru ka'o/ / de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ ye shes dang / thugs dang / gsung dang / sku'i 'khor lor gnas pa mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa'i yi nang du'o/ /

sanskrit: sahajayoginyaḥ sthitāḥ | athavā sahajasiddhāḥ svabhāvasiddhā evaitā vyavasthitāḥ, na tu kalpitā iti bhedaṁ darśayati | katham ? pravṛttinivṛttī utpādabhaṅgau vyutthānapraveśau samādhānasamādhāne ca, guṇadoṣau śubhāśubhau saṁkleśavyavadānau ca sukhaṁ duḥkhaṁ ca sātāsātādirūpaṁ saṁskārātmakam, tatsarvaṁ dvāratrayena(ṇa) [pra]vartamānaṁ sahajasiddhaṁ vīrayoginīsvabhāvaṁ vijñeyam ||8-9||
parallel: yang na lhan cig skyes grub de rang bzhin gyis grub pa kho na 'dir rnam par gzhag pa yin gyi brtags pa ni ma yin no/ / dbye ba ji lta bu yin pa ston par byed de/ 'jug pa dang ldog pa dang / skye ba dang 'jig pa dang / ldang ba dang / 'jug pa dang / mnyam par gzhag pa dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa dang / yon tan dang skyon dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang / bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / bde ba dang mi bde ba la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'dus byas kyi bdag nyid can sgo gsum nas 'jug bzhin pa de thams cad ni lhan cig skyes grub ste/

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du shes par bya'o zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las rgyas par bstan pa gsum pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /
sgo gsum po'i gnas lha'i 'khor lor rtogs par bya ba de'i gnas la sogs pa sa bcu'i rim pas gnas par bstan par bya'o/ / de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/
sgo rgyas par bstan pa'i de ma thag tu gsungs pas na/
de nas so/ / gang yang rung zhes pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa gang yang rung ba'i ste/
sems can thams cad kyi thun mong ba yin gyi/
bdag nyid kho na'i ma yin pa'o/ /
gnas la sogs pa ni gnas te/
rgyun dgu zhes bya ba la sogs pas de gsungs te/

sanskrit: dvāratrayasthaṁ devatācakraṁ pratipādya tasya pīṭhādidaśabhūmikrameṇa sthitiṁ darśayitumāha - athetyādinā | dvāranirdeśānantaramityartha uktaḥ | anyatamasyeti yasya kasyacit tathāgatakāyasya sarvasattvasādhāraṇasya, na madīyasyaiva | pīṭhādisthānaṁ darśayiṣyāmīti sambandhaḥ ||1||
parallel: sngar gsungs pa'i sku'i sgo rnams gang yin pa ni rgyun dgu'o/ /

sanskrit: tadāha - navaśro(sro)togatami(tā i)tyādi | prāguktāni yāni kāyadvārāṇi nava śro(sro)tāṁsu, teṣu sthitā yā nāḍyaḥ sārvadaivatā nava, tathā śirasa ārabhya bhagamadhyagā'vadhūtīdaśamāstā eva daśabuddhabodhisattvabhūmaya ucyante | satyadarśanādya(da)dhyātmani tadanubhavo dṛṣṭastadā kiṁ bahuprayatnasādhyena dṛṅmārgādineti bhāvaḥ ||2||
parallel: de rnams su gnas pa ni rtsa rnams gang yin pa ste thams cad kyi lha dgu'o/ / de bzhin du mgo bo nas brtsams te b+ha ga'i dbus su son pa'i a ba d+hU tI'i cha shas bcu po kho na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sa bcur brjod par bya'o/ / bden pa mthong ba las nang du de myong zhing mthong ba de'i tshe 'bad pa mang pos bsgrub par bya ba'i mthong ba'i lam la sogs pas ci zhig bya zhes bya bar dgongs so/ /

sanskrit: bhūmīruktvā bhūmisthā[nā]nyāha - lalāṭetyādi | ihāsmin kāye lalāṭasthānaṁ mahāsukhacakramārabhya nāḍīcakrasya nirṇayo niścayo jñātavyaḥ | tathāi tadgatā[ḥ]
parallel: 'dir lus 'di las dpral ba'i gnas bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo nas brtsams te/ rtsa'i 'khor lo'i nges pa ste gtan la phab pa shes par bya'o/ /

don de byang chub sems ni zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/ 'di rnams phyi rol du sku'i sgo la sogs pa rnams dang / rnag gi dri la sogs pa'i rnam grangs rnams dang / gtum drag la sogs pa rnams su'o/ / nang du ni spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnas pa rnams kyi yul gyi ming dzA lan+d+ha ra la sogs pa rnams su'o/ /
mkha' spyod ces bya ba la sogs pas de'i rnam par dbye ba gsungs te/ pul+lI ra nas brtsams te mA la wa'i bar gyi rtsa gang yin pa de rnams ni mkha' spyod ma'o/ /
kA ma rU pa nas brtsams te/ hi ma la ya'i bar ni sa spyod ma'o/ / pre ta pu ri nas brtsams te ku lu ta'i bar gyi sa 'og na gnas pa rnams te/
lus kyi steng dang bar dang tha ma'i dbye ba las so/ /
mkha' spyod ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams ni sa bcur rab tu gnas pa rnams so/ /
khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa rnams ni de'i cha shas sgo rnams su rnam par gnas pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: dvātriṁśadeva saṁbhogādau prasṛtāḥ, kāyavṛkṣasya uṣṇīṣacakramūla(ka)tvāt | ata evādhaḥ - śākhaḥ kāyavṛkṣaḥ | api ca, hastāpādacatuṣṭayaṁ niṁśatiradhomukhāḥ | pārśvapṛṣṭheṣu tisraḥ | hṛdi cakre ca ṣat | śṛṅkhalābandhanāḍyastisraścatuścakrastūpasya | evaṁ lalāṭādāveva nāḍīcakrasya nirṇayaḥ | dvātriṁśat tā yoginyaḥ, yadbodhicittāni tattulyāni vahanti | ta eva vīrāḥ khaṇḍakapālādayaḥ, vajracaṇḍādayo mahāvīrāḥ, vajramaṇḍalaḥ śrīherukaśca | tadarthamāha - śra(sra)vantya ityādi ||3||
parallel: 'di nyid sku gsung thugs zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/

sanskrit: etā bāhyeṣu kāyadvāreṣu pūtigandhādiparyāyeṣu candogrādiṣva(a)bhyāntareṣu ca śraādicaturviṁśatipīṭheṣu sthitānāṁ deśānāṁ jālandharādīnām | tadvibhāgamāha - khecarya ityādi | pullīrādārabhya mālavāntaṁ yā nāḍyastāḥ khecaryaḥ, kāmarūpādārabhya himālayāntaṁ bhūcaryaḥ, pretapurīmārabhya kulatāntaṁ pātālavāsinyaḥ | kāyasyordhvamadhyaparyantabhedād etāścaturviṁśatiḥ khecaryādayo daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitāḥ | tadavayaveṣu dvāreṣu ca kākāsyādisvabhāvā nāḍyo vyavasthitāḥ ||4-412||
parallel: spyi bo la sogs par phye ba de la brten nas gnas pa rnams so zhes pa ni tshig gi lhag ma'o/ / 'di nyid ni gnas la sogs pa gang yin pa de nyid brten pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa rnams ni mkha' 'gro ma ste/
'di rnams nyid ni rab dga' sogs/ / sa rnams su ni yang dag bshad/ / ces pa ni/
'di nyid rab tu dga' ba ste/ de la spyi bo dang / spyi gtsug dang / rna ba g.yas pa dang rgyab rnams ni gnas te byang chub kyi sems gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /
mchan khung dang nu ma ni zhing ste/
rdul dang 'o ma'i zol gyis byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / 'di nyid ni 'od byed pa ste/

sanskrit: etadāha - kāyavākcittetyādi | sthānāntaraprabhedaḥ śiraādiprabhedastamāśritya, sthitā iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | ata eva ya ete pīṭhādayaścatuviṁśatirādheyarūpanāḍyo ḍākinyastathā tadādhārabhūtā daśanāḍyo bhūmirūpāstāḥ | yathāsthānasvarūpeṇeti | sthānamanatikramya yathāsthānam, yasyā yasyā yoginyā yadyat sthānaṁ tasyāstasyāstatra tatra sthāne sahajasthitirbhavati, na kalpitā ||5-6||
parallel: kha dang mgrin pa ni 'dun pa ste ro la nye bar longs spyod pas 'dod pa ldog pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: etā eva pramuditādidaśabhūmayo mayā proktā iti | tatra śiraḥśikhādakṣiṇakarṇa pṛṣṭhāni pīṭhaṁ bodhicittāspadaṁ saiva pramuditā, layādikrameṇānandatrayajananāt | vāmakarṇa bhrūmadhyacakṣurbāhumūlamupapīṭham, pīṭhasamīpam | saiva vimalā, jñānāgninā vikalpamaladāhāt | kakṣastanau kṣetram, svadakṣīravyājena bodhicittaprasecanāt | saiva prabhākarī, tadavalokanānmana ānandaprabhotpatteḥ | nābhināsāgre upakṣetram, bindusiṅghānavāhitvāt | saivārciṣmatī, jñānāgniprakāśakatvāt | mukhakaṇṭhau chandohau haḥ), rasopabhoge chandavṛtteḥ | saiva sudurjayā, rasānnivartayitumaśakyatvāt | hṛdayameḍhre upachandihaḥ, arthāvagatau bhojyapāke tadvaimukhyāt | saivābhimukhī, tadavadhau pāke cābhimukhyāt | guhyagudau melāpakam, prajñopāyayoḥ samāpattau tanmīlanānnāḍyaikyācca | saiva dūraṅgamā, tannāḍīsauśīryasta dūratvāt | ūrūjaṅghe upamelāpakam, pūrvoktayorapi mīlanāt | saivācalā, tadyogasyānivāryatvāt aṅgulīpādapṛṣṭheśmaśānam, sarvapīṭhātma-tvādavikalpapadānubhūteśca | saiva sādhumatī, sādhuno nairātmyasya tatra vidyamānatvāt |
parallel: 'di nyid ni rgyal bar dka' ba ste/ ro las ldog par mi nus pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / snying ga dang chu so ni nye ba'i 'dun pa ste/
smin pa na mngon du gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /
de'i rtsa'i bug pa de ni ring ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ / brla dang byin pa ni nye ba'i 'du ba ste/

sanskrit: svadehe caiva buddhatvaṁ sthitaṁ nānyatra kutracit |
parallel: 'di nyid ni mi g.yo ba ste/
'di nyid ni legs pa'i blo gros te/ bdag med pa nyid ni legs pa yin la/ de der rig bzhin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: aṅguṣṭhajānunī upaśmaśānam, pūrvavat | saiva dharmameghā, dharmasyādhāraṇe sthirasya majjottarasyordhvaśro(sro)tasā meghavadvarṣaṇe nīrujo vā vṛṣṭiyogānta[ḥ] | iti daśabhūmisaṁgṛhītāni caturviṁśatipīṭhāni | tānyeva daśabhūmayo layādikrameṇa jñānasyottarottarakrameṇa vṛddhau |
parallel: 'di nyid ni chos kyi sprin te/ spyi bo nas sprin gyi char bab pa bzhin du byang chub kyi sems kun du ru lhung ba'i phyir ro/ / sa bcus yang dag par bsdus pa'i gnas la sogs pa de rnams nyid sa bcu po ste/

sanskrit: kasya tā daśabhūmaya ityāha - ālaya ityādi | ya ete cakṣurādiṣaḍindriyasvabhāvā bodhisattvāḥ, tathā ye rūpādiskandharūpiṇo buddhāḥ prāk pratipāditāḥ, teṣāṁ tā bhūmayo bhavanti, svabhāvena vartante buddhabodhisattvā āsviti bhūmayaḥ | ata eva na kevalamāryāṇāṁ buddhatvāvāhikā yāvat pṛthagjanānāmapi ye skandhendriyasvabhāvā buddhabodhisattvāsteṣāmapi buddhatvāvāhikā bhavanti, tattvatastathāgatapṛthagjanayorabhedāt ||7-8||
parallel: ji tsam du so so'i skye bo rnams kyi phung po dang dbang po gang yin pa rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyid yin pa las/ de rnams kyang sangs rgyas nyid thob par byed par 'gyur te/ de kho na nyid du de bzhin gshegs pa dang so so'i skye bo dag dbyer med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: nanu trikalpāsaṁkhyeyaṁ(ya)prāpya[a] bodhistatkathaṁ skandhādayo'bhisaṁbudhyante, ityāśaṅkayāha - dvātriṁśadityādi | dvātriṁśato bodhicittānāṁ yadā dambholimukhe payojakroḍe vā pūrṇatvamanubhūyate, tadā buddhatvaṁ teṣāṁ nikaṭe samīpe vartate | na kālāpekṣayeti viśeṣaḥ ||9||
parallel: 'o na bskal pa grangs med pa gsum gyis byang chub 'thob pa yin te/ de ji ltar na phung po la sogs pa sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du shes pa tsam gyis thob par 'gyur zhe na/ byang sems zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/

sanskrit: nanu ca manuṣyabhāve vartamānā vayam, buddhāstu buddhakṣetreṣvabhiratyādiṣu jñānamaṇḍalarūpeṇa tiṣṭhantīti kuto bodhirnikaṭetyāśaṅkāṁ nirākartumāha - svadeha evetyādi | svarūpāvabodhād buddhastasya bhāvo buddhatvam, tat svadeha eva sthitaṁ vyavasthitam | ata eva tadeva buddhakṣetram, atraiva prakṛtisiddhasya sahajabuddhasyāvasthānāt | nānyatrai(tre)tyabhiratyādau | tasmāddehādanyatra bāhyeṣu sthāneṣu buddhatvaṁ prākṛtaiḥ, prakṛtyāṁ bhavāḥ prākṛtā
parallel: rang gi rang bzhin khong du chud pa las sad pa de'i srid pa ni sangs rgyas nyid de/ de ni rang gi lus nyid la gnas pa de rnam par gzhag pa yin no/ / 'di nyid las na de nyid sangs rgyas kyi zhing ste/
de'i phyir lus las gzhan du ni phyi rol gyi gnas rnams su'o/ /
rang bzhin te ji ltar skyes pa de nyid kyis gnas pa yin gyi khyad par du byas pa ni ma yin no/ / 'dod pa ni gang de rnams la 'dod cing re ba'o/ /
lung du ma bstan pa'i rnam par rtog pa yang spangs pa yin no/ /
dpal kye'i rdo rje las/

sanskrit: iti śrīvasantatilakāyāṁ tathāgata kāyagatanavasrotobhagamadhyagata-nāḍīdaśa pīṭhādibhūmi svarūpākhyānanirdeśaścaturthaḥ ||4||
parallel: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / slob dpon phyag na rdo rjes kyang / /

sanskrit: yathaiva jātāstathaiva sthitā na tu vyutpannamatayastaiḥ, matamiṣṭam | niṣpannakramādhigama-vidbhistu buddhatvaṁ svabhāvasiddhatveneṣyate, "paṁñcabuddhātmaku sarvajago'yam" iti vacanāt | "bhavati tathāgataḥ paraṁmaraṇāt" ityavyākṛtavitarkī(rkā)śca pratyākhyātā bhavanti, "abuddho nāsti sattvaikaḥ saṁbuddho'stvasya svasya ca" (2473) iti hevajravacanāt | ācāryavajrapāṇirapi - "narā vajradharākārā yoṣito vajrayoṣitaḥ" ityāha | tathāgataguhyasūtre'pi - "sarvasattvānāṁ kāyavākcittavyavahārā strikulaguhyam" iti | jñānapādairapi - "evaṁvidhaiśca cetasi yatkiñcitkāyavāṅmanaskarmamudrā-mantrākāraṁ gaditaṁ sarvabuddhaiḥ" ityuktam ||10||
parallel: bud med rdo rje btsun mo'o/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba'i mdor yang / sems can thams cad kyi lus dang ngag dang sems kyi tha snyad ni rigs gsum gyi gsang ba'o/ /

sanskrit: prāguktānāṁ daśabhūmīnāṁ nāmānyāha - pīṭhopapīṭhetyādi | eṣāṁ niruktiḥ prāguktā ||11 12||
parallel: ye shes zhabs kyis kyang / de ltar sems las byung ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis gang yang rung ba'i lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ni phyag rgya dang sngags kyi rnam par sangs rgyas rnams kyis rtogs so zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni sngar gsungs pa'i sa bcu po rnams kyi ming gsungs te/

sanskrit: iti vasantatilakāyāṁ niṣpannakramasādhanopāyikāyāṁ ṭīkāyāṁ rahasyadīpikāyāṁ caturthanirdeśe vistaravyākhyā ||4||
parallel: 'di rnams kyi nges pa'i tshig ni sngon du bshad pa'o zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las rgyas par bstan pa bzhi pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /
de rnams kyi mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gsungs te/ de nas zhes pa nas/

sanskrit: athānyatamasya tathāgatakāyasya navasrotobhagamadhya gatā(ta)nāḍīsvarūpapīṭhādidaśa bhūmipāramitākāyavākcittacakragata sthānāntarabhedena deśabhedaṁ kathayiṣyāmi ||1||
parallel: spyi bo ma la ya yi yul/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pas ni rgyas par bshad pa gsum pa yin no/ / bshad par bya'o zhes pa'i bar du ni mdor bstan pa ste go sla'o/ /
de lta bur gyur pa'i yul ni ma la ya'i yul lo/ / spyi bo de nyid du ste/ der 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /
rna ba g.yas pa'i lam nas gtum mos 'phur bar brjod de/ mkha' la rgyu zhing 'jug pas na 'gro ba'o/ / phyi rol du 'byung ba ni der o Di ya na ste rna ba g.yas pa'o/ /

sanskrit: athānyatamasyetyādinā prāguktacaturviṁśatipīṭhānāṁ śiraādidisasā)mānādhikaraṇyena nāmāni tatra sthitanāḍīnāṁ khecaryādisvabhāvatāmuddeśa nirdeśakrameṇāha - athetyādi | kathayiṣyāmītyantamuddeśaḥ sugamaḥ ||1||
parallel: dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi pho nya mo 'di dag gis phyag rgya gsum po snyoms par zhugs pa las/

sanskrit: śiro malayadeśa ityādinā nirdeśamāha | tatra malaya iti mahāsukhasvabhāvaṁ saṁvṛtiparamārthābhinnabodhicittaṁ liyate yatra sa malayaḥ, tathābhūto deśo malayadeśaḥ śiraḥ, tatraiva tasya bhāvāt | nāḍījālasya mūlaṁ tadvā(dvā)raṇe jālandharaṁ śikhā | savyakarṇamārgeṇa caṇḍālyā oḍayākhye khecaravṛttyā yānaṁ bahirnirgamanaṁ tatra uḍḍiyānaṁ ca dakṣiṇakarṇaḥ | ābhyāṁ svaravyañjanadūtībhyāṁ mudrātrayasamāpattyā karmamāruteśvaradaṇḍabhedādavikalpasukhānubhava (vo) budhyata ityarbuda[ḥ] pṛṣṭhaṁ śirasaḥ, pṛṣodarāditvāddhasya daḥ |
parallel: las kyi rlung dbang phyug gi dbyug pas phye ba'i phyir rnam par mi rtog pa'i bde ba myong bar rtogs par bya'o zhes pas arbud ste/ mgo bo'i rgyab po/ / pri Sho d+ha ra la sogs pa nyid las ha'i da'o/ /
sngar gsungs pa'i tshul gyis bzhi po 'di rnams ni gnas kyi ming can du shes par bya'o/ / de la brten pa'i rtsa bzhi po ni mkha' spyod ma ste/

go ste sa'i rang bzhin sprul pa'i 'khor lor sbyin par byed do zhes pas go dA ni a ba d+hU tI'i ste/ des 'dzin par byed cing khebs par byed do zhes pas go dA ba rI ni rna ba g.yon pa ste/ des de la khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: rāmeśvara stathā khyāto bhrūmadhye tvatha cakṣuṣī |
parallel: la la nA dang ra sa nA'i rang bzhin smin ma dag go/ / de dag gi dbus su dbang phyug ste/ gang gi ye shes kyi me de'i dbus su'o zhes pa mdzod spu'i nang du'o/ /

sanskrit: devīkoṭṭa stathā cānyo bāhumūlaṁ tu mālavaḥ ||4||
parallel: lha mo de nyid kyi rdzong ni 'dir ko Ta ste/ mig gnyis ni de wI ko Ta'o/ / de dang de la brten pa ste/
de bzhin du dpung pa dag gi bar ni lag pa dag gi ste/ gang 'di rnams kyi rtsa ba gnyis po ste/
so sor skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i phreng ba 'jig cing gcod par byed pa'i phyir mA la bar brjod par bya ste/

sanskrit: ete pūrvoktena nyāyena catvāraḥ pīṭhasaṁjñakā jñeyāḥ, tatratyānāṁ ca nāḍīnāṁ catasṛṇāṁ khecarīṇāṁ pracaṇḍādināmadheyānāṁ gocarā viṣayā ādhārasvabhāvā ūṣmādisādharme(rmye)ṇa catuṣprakārā vikalpasukhānubhavena viśiṣṭamodānubhavā muditā bhūrapīti ||2-212 ||
parallel: thim pa myong ba'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: gāṁ bhuvabhūva(bhuvaṁ bhū)svabhāvaṁ nirmāṇacakraṁ varata iti godā'vadhūtī, tayā vriyate cchādyata iti godāvarī vāmakarṇaḥ, tayā tasya vyāpteḥ | rāmā ca rāmā ca te rāme lalanārasanāsvabhāve bhruvau, tayormadhye īśvaratvaṁ yasya jñānārciṣastad bhrūmadhyamityūrṇākoṣam | devyāstasyā eva koṭṭa iha(va) koṭṭo devīkoṭṭaḥ, tadāśraye netradvayam(ye) tatprāpteḥ | tathā bāhvorantarbhujayoryadetanmūladvayaṁ skandhadvayaṁ tatraiva mālavam | mālānāṁ vijātīyavikalpānāṁ lavanāt chedanād mālava ityucyate, tathānubhavāt | ete upapīṭhāstatratyānāṁ nāḍīnāṁ vīramatī-kharvarī-laṅkeśvarī-drumacchāyā-svarūpāṇāṁ khecarīṇāṁ gocarā viṣayā jñātavyāḥ | iti cittacakram ||3-5||
parallel: 'di rnams ni nye ba'i gnas te/ de la brten pa'i rtsa rnams dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang / mi 'u thung ma dang / lang+ka'i dbang phyug ma dang / shing grib ma rnams kyi rang bzhin te/ mkha' spyod ma rnams kyi spyod yul dang yul du shes par bya'o zhes pa thugs kyi 'khor lo la'o/ /

mchan khung gnyis ni kA ma rU pa ste/ mngon par 'dod par bya zhing mthong ba gang gi yin pa de'i ni 'dod pa'i gzugs te mchan khung gnyis so/ / o ni steng du 'gro bas len cing khas len par byed pa ni gtum mo'o zhes pas nu ma gnyis ni o tre'o/ /
gnyis po 'di rnams ni sngar gsungs pa'i tshul gyi zhing ngo / / lte ba dang sna rtse gnyis po dag ni/ / tri sha ku ne dang / ka sha la ste/
de bzhin du sna'i rtse mo ni ko sha la ste/ ngar snabs 'gro ba gang gi phyir/ de ni ko sa la'o/ /
kha dang mgrin pa ni ka ling+ga dang laM pA ka dag go/ / kaM ni bde ba yin la/ li ni 'gro bar byed pa'o/ /
mgrin pa ni laM pA ka ste/ de dag ni sngar gsungs pa'i rnam par bshad pa las 'dun pa zhes brjod par bya'o/ / snying ga dang chu so yang kAny+tsi dang hi mA la ya dag ste de ltar ni/
chu so ni hi mA la yar brjod par bya'o/ / de dag ni nye ba'i 'dun pa ste sngar bzhin no/ / de ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni/

sanskrit: kakṣadvayaṁ stanadvayaṁ yathākramam, kāmaṁ rūpamabhilaṣaṇīyaṁ darśanaṁ yasya sa kāmarūpaḥ kakṣadvayam, oḍayordhvagamanena rāti svīkaroti caṇḍālīti oḍraṁ stanadvayam, etad dvayaṁ pūrvoktena nyāyena kṣetram | nābhirnāsikāgraṁ ca dve triśakunikośalau | trayaḥ śakunayaḥ pakṣisadṛśāḥ khagamukhākārāḥ kāyavākcittanāḍyo yatra tat triśakunirnābhisthānam, vajragranthirūpatvāt | tathā kośalaṁ siṅghānaṁ sa(śa)lati vahati yasmāt tatkośalaṁ nāsikāgram | ete pūrvoktakrameṇopakṣetre vijñeye ||6-612||
parallel: sa la spyod pa 'di rnams kyi gnas rnams shes par bya'o/ / lus kyi dbus su gnas pa nyid kyi phyir sa spyod ma'o/ / de bzhin du mtshan ma 'di rnam pa gnyis te/

sanskrit: mukhakaṇṭhe kaliṅgalampākau | kaṁ sukhaṁ liṅgayati gamayatīti kaliṅgam, sevākāle taddarśanādevānandotpatteḥ | tathā lambikā'dharā'mṛtāsvādanalampaṭā rasanā, tadyogāt lampākaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ | tau pūrvoktavyākhyayā cchandoha ityucyete | hṛdayaṁ meḍhraśca
parallel: bud med kyi mtshan ma'o/ / de kho na bzhin du bshang lam yang ste/ / de dag ni bzhin du ste pre ta pu rI dang / gri ha de ba tAr shes par bya'o/ /
de ltar ni pre ta ni nam mkha'o/ /
grong khyer lta bu'i nam mkha' lnga rnams ni grong khyer te/
de yi rgyal mtshan zung ni pre ta pu rI'o/ / bshang lam gyi sgo ni/ gri ha de ba tA ste khyim ni lus yin la/
par snang mdzad yin pa ni khyim gyi lha ste/

sanskrit: kāñcīhimālayau | tathā hi - kaṁ sukhamañcati gacchati dhāvati, kadalīpuṣpasaṁkāśaṁ(śa) lambamānādhomukhīsravadamṛtabindūhūkārākāramāradārikānālikāsama nvāgatatvāt | himavarṇaṁ bodhicittam, tasyāspadatvād himālayo meḍhra ityucyate | upachandohaḥ pūrvavat | ityevamityādinā tatratyānāṁ nāḍonām airāvatī-mahābhairavā-vāyuvegā-surābhakṣī-śyāmā-devo-subhadrā-hayakarṇā-khagānanānāṁ bhūcarīṇāmetāni sthānāni jñeyānīti | bhūcaryaḥ, kāyasya madhye sthitatvāt || 7-9||
parallel: de bshang ba'i khams kyi gnas nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ / de rnams ni bzhin du 'du ba'i ming can du shes par bya ste/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus su/

sanskrit: tathā liṅgaṁ dvidhā - strīliṅgaṁ pulliṅgaṁ ca | gude'pi tathaiva | tau yathākramaṁ preta-purī-gṛhadevate jñeye | tathāhi - pretānāṁ pañcānāmākāśānāṁ purī iva purī pretapurī sā dhvajayugalī | gṛhasya śarīrasya devatā vairocano gṛhadevatā viḍdhātuḥ, tadādhāratvād gṛhadevatā gudadvāram | te yathākramaṁ melāpakasaṁjñake jñeye, dhvajadvayasyāpānamārgasya ca samāpattikāle samāyogāt |
parallel: rgyal mtshan gnyis po'i thur ser gyi lam gnyis po sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du brla gnyis po dang byin pa gnyis po yang sau rASh+Ta dang su war+Na dwI par shes par bya'o/ / de ltar ni/

sanskrit: tathā ūrudvayaṁ jaṅghādvayaṁ ca saurāṣṭraṁ suvarṇadvīpaṁ ca vijñeyam | tathāhi - saukhyasya rāṣṭram, viśiṣṭakāladarśane ca ūrudvayamevānyonyam | tathā suvarṇasya susitatviṣaścittasya dvīpamiva dvīpaṁ jaṅghādvayamevaitat pūrvavadupamelāpakaṁ vijñeyam |
parallel: de bzhin du 'od shin tu dkar ba'i sems ni mdog bzang ste/ de'i gling lta bu yin pa'i phyir byin pa gnyis po ni gling ngo / / brla gnyis po nyid phan tshun khyad par du 'phags pa'i dus dang / khyad par du 'phags pa mthong pa ni sau rASh+Ta'o/ /

sanskrit: tathā pādāṅgulyo'ṣṭau pādapṛṣṭhaṁ ca nagaraṁ sindhuśca jñātavyau | na gacchantīti nagā aṅgulyaḥ, ataḥ paramaprasaraṇānnagaram | pādapṛṣṭhādaṅguṣṭhe bodhicittasya spandanāt sindhuḥ pādapṛṣṭham | etad dvayaṁ pūrvoktena nyāyena śmaśānam |
parallel: de rnams ni sngar bzhin du nye ba'i 'du bar shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du rkang pa'i sor mo brgyad dang / rkang pa'i rgyab kyi gnas ni na ga ra dang sin+d+hur shes par bya ste/ sor mo ni 'gro bar mi byed do zhes pas na gang yin la/
de la mchog tu rgyas par byed pa'i phyir ra ste na ga ra'o/ /
rkang pa'i rgyab las mthe bong la byang chub kyi sems 'dzag par byed pa'i phyir rkang pa'i rgyab ni sin+d+hu'o/ /
gnyis po 'di ni sngar gsungs pa'i tshul gyis dur khrod do/ /
rkang pa'i mthe bong dang pus mo ni/ / ma ru dang ku lu tAr shes par bya ste/ ma ni bde ba chen po yin la/
gnyis pa 'di ni bzhin du snga ma ltar nye ba'i dur khrod du brjod par bya'o/ / sa bcu 'di rnams gnas la sogs/ / zhes pa ni/
gnas la sogs pa'i brdas brtan pa yin no/ / rang lus skyes zhes pa ni/ zla ba bcu'i rim pas skyes pa'i rang gi lus dang lhan cig tu skyes pa rnams te/ /
de nyid phyi rol gyi sgo rnams dang lhan cig tu nang gi dgu po las gcig bzung ste sa bcur brjod par bya'o/ / de rnams su'i sa yin zhe na/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhes pa ste/
gzugs la sogs pa phung po'i rang bzhin ye shes gcig pu'i bdag nyid can rnams so/ /

sanskrit: pādāṅguṣṭhe jānunī ca marukulate vijñeye | masya mahāsukhasya ravanād nadanād maruḥ | kuvikalpānāṁ lavanāt kulatā | te dve yathākramaṁ pūrvavadupaśmaśāne ityucyete | etā daśabhūmayaḥ pīṭhādyā iti pīṭhādisaṁketitāḥ ||10-1212||
parallel: yang na/

sanskrit: svadahejā iti daśamāsakramajāḥ svadehena saha jātāḥ, na tu dṛṅmārgakrameṇa prāpyā iti | tāḥ punaḥ sthānabhedenoktaprāyeṇa bhidyante | ata eva bāhyadvāraiḥ saha navabhirābhyantaryā caikayā saṁkalayya daśabhūmaya ucyante | kasya tā bhūmayaḥ ? buddhānāmiti rūpaskandhādirūpiṇāṁ jñānaikātmanām | athavā buddhāścaturviṁśatidhāturūpā vīrāḥ | buddhāścābhedyādayaścaturviṁśatināḍyaḥ | ekaśeṣe sati vīrayoginīnāṁ sahajā etā daśa bhūmayaḥ, na tu kalpitāḥ sādhyā veti bhāvaḥ || 13 -13 1/2||
parallel: sangs rgyas rnams ni khams kyi rang bzhin gyis dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams sam/ mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams kyang sangs rgyas rnams so/ / gcig lhag pa las dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma 'di rnams ni lhan cig skyes pa'i sa bcu'am/

sanskrit: naitāṁ āryāṇāmeva bhūmayaḥ, api tu pṛthagjanānāmapīti darśayitumāha - cittavākkāyacakreṣvityādi | prāguktakramaiśca dehasthitacittādicakreṣu caturviṁśatisthānabheda -
parallel: brtags pa ma yin pa'i bsgrub par bya ba yang yin no zhes dgongs so/ / 'phags pa rnams kho na'i sa ma yin gyi so so'i skye bo rnams kyi yang yin no zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /
sngar gsungs pa'i rim pa rnams kyis lus la gnas pa'i thugs la sogs pa'i 'khor lo gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbye bas phye ba rnams su/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/
rkang med dang / rkang gnyis dang / rkang bzhi dang / rkang lus can thams cad la yang rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi sa 'di rnams ni gnas bcu po ste/

de kho na nyid kyis sems can thams cad ni sa'i dbang phyug yin pa nyid kyi phyir ro zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/
rgyas par bstan pa lnga pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /

sanskrit: bhinneṣu sarvadehināmapadadvipadacatuṣpadabahupadānāmapi nāḍīrūpeṇaitā bhūmayo daśa sthitā iti, tattvataḥ sarveṣāmeva sattvānāṁ bhūmīśvaratvāt ||14-15||
parallel: da ni rang gi lus la gnas pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo rnams kho na 'khor lo thams cad du gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin de'i gtso bo ni/
rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i sngags kyi bdag nyid de/
de rnams rtogs pa bya ba'i slad du/ rgyas par bstan pa drug pa la 'jug pa'i phyir/
de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/
gang yang rung zhes pa ni/
sems can gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ste/
snga ma bzhin du phung po la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las lha'i ngo bo nyid kyi'o/ /
gnas ji lta ba bzhin du ni/
gnas la ma 'das par byas nas/

sanskrit: idānīṁ svadehasthitanāḍīcakrameva sarvacakrasthitaḍākinīsvabhāvaṁ tadadhipateśca svabhāvasiddhamantrātmatāṁ pratipādayituṁ ṣaṣṭhanirdeśamavatārayitumathetyādyāha | anyatamasyeti sarvasattvadhātugatasya | tathāgatakāyasyeti pūrvavat | skandhādisvabhāvād vā navatidevātāmayasya | yathāsthānaṁ sthānamanatikramya | nāḍīcakrameva yoginīgaṇam | sūcayiṣyāmaḥ kathayiṣyāma ityuddeśaḥ ||1||
parallel: rtsa'i 'khor lo kho na rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs su mtshon par bya ste/ bshad par bya'o zhes bya ba ni mdor bstan pa'o/ /

sanskrit: tatrādhipatermantra rūpeṇa sthitimāha - hṛnmadhyagatamityādi | iha sarvadehināṁ hṛdaye dharmacakrakarṇikākeśarānvitāṣṭadalaṁ nāḍīcakraṁ praharāṣṭakaviśuddhisvabhāvaṁ vidyate | tasya madhye tailavahnisvarūpiṇyadhomukhī kadalīpuṣpasadṛśī trivṛtānāmnī yā, tanmadhye ravikiraṇanikaravigalita prābhātikāvaśyāyakaṇa sadṛśabindūn puñcan sūkṣmasarṣapapramāṇo hūkāra uccārayitumaśakyatvādanāhataḥ sarvavikalpabhayebhyo nirgatatvādvīraḥ, sa eva
parallel: snying gi dbus son zhes bya ba la sogs pas/
der gtso bo sngags kyi rang bzhin gyis gnas par gsungs pa ste/
'dir lus can thams cad kyi snying ga ni/
chos kyi 'khor lo ze'u 'bru dang ge sar dang bcas shing thun tshod brgyad rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo'o/ /
de'i dbus su ste/ til gyi mar me'i rang bzhin can chu shing gi me tog ltar 'og gi gdong ma sum skor ma zhes bya ba gang yin pa de'i dbus su/

nyi ma'i 'od zer gyi tshogs lhung ba'i snga dro'i ba mo'i zil pa lta bu'i thig le 'dzag bzhin pa yungs kar phra mo'i tshad tsam gyi hUM gi yi ge ni brjod par mi nus pa nyid kyis na gzhom du med pa ste/
rnam par rtog pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi 'jigs pa med pa nyid kyi phyir dpa' bo'o/ /

sanskrit: sarvadehināṁ hṛdayānandajanakatvād vasanta iva vasanto bhagavān śrīheruka iti jñātavyaḥ | na tu caturvaktro dvādaśabhujaḥ ||2-4||
parallel: de nyid lus can thams cad kyi snying dga' bar byed pa nyid kyi dpyid lta bu yin pa'i phyir na dpyid de/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka'o zhes shes par bya ba yin gyi/ zhal bzhi pa phyag bcu gnyis pa ni ma yin no/ /

sanskrit: yeyaṁ vāḍavāgnisadṛśī jñānāgnirmantha manthanasaṁyogalakṣaṇakarmamārutodbodhitā nābhideśājjvalantī ūrdhvamārgaṇa gatvā taṁ vīraṁ hṛdayasthaṁ tadamṛtanirjharadhārāsāreṇa tathaiva drāvitena spṛṣṭā, ata evādvayayogāt samāpattyā'vasthitā vasantatilaketyucyate || 5-5 1/2||
parallel: rta gdong gi me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me gang yin pa 'di ni bsrub par bya ba dang srub par byed pa yang dag par sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid las kyi rlung gis steng du bskul ba las lte ba'i gnas nas 'bar ba steng gi lam du song nas/ de la snying gang gnas pa'i dpa' bo de'i bdud rtsi'i bkod ma'i rgyun ltung bas de nyid du zhu bas reg pa 'di nyid gnyis su med par sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir snyoms par zhugs pa ste/ dpyid kyi thig le zhes brjod par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: ata evāha- eṣa śrītyādi | yo'yaṁ hūkāraḥ prāguktalakṣaṇa uktaḥ, sa eva śrīherukaḥ | jñajvālā tu vajravārāhī tilaketyucyate | saiva sacarācare sthāvarajaṅmātmake jagati prāguktaṁ yoginīrūpaṁ raktavarṇamādāya sthitā | tathā saiva bhagacatī kāyādibhedabhinnā'dhamamadhyamottamadvāratrayeṇābhidya pañcadaśabhedena gamanāgamanasthitīḥ karoti | na ca saivāpi tu sarvadehe vyavasthitetyarthaḥ ||6-7 1/2||
parallel: de nyid 'di ni he ru ka zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ hUM gi yi ge gang yin pa 'di ni sngar gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid kyis brjod pa de nyid dpal he ru ka ste/ ye shes 'bar ba'i phyir na rdo rje phag mo ni thig ler brjod par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: maṇḍalādhimateścatuścakravyāptiṁ darśayitumāha - nābhāvityārabhya krīḍatīha yathāsukhamityantena | tatra nirmāṇacakra(kre) nābhau sa eva vasanto akāro hrasvarūpaḥ | hṛdi dharmacakre nādabinduyuktahūkārākāraḥ | saṁbhogacakre kaṇṭhe sa eva trimātraḥ plutaḥ
parallel: de nyid rgyu ba dang bcas pa'i mi rgyu ba ste/
gnas pa dang 'gro ba'i bdag nyid kyi 'gro ba la sngar gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs te/ kha dog dmar po blangs nas gnas pa'o/ /
de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ma de nyid lus la sogs pa'i dbye bas dbye bar 'gyur ba'i dman pa dang 'bring dang dam pa'i sgo gsum gyi dbye bas/
'gro ba dang song ba dang gnas pa rnams mdzad pa yin no/ / de kho na'i yin gyi/ lus can thams cad la yang rnam par gnas so zhes pa'i don to/ /
lte bar zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/

zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa gsungs te/ de la lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la dpyid de nyid a yig thung ngu'i gzugs so/ / snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor ni nA da dang thig le dang ldan pa'i hUM yig gi rnam pa'o/ /
mgrin par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'khor lor ni cha gsum pa shin tu ring po'i oM yig gi gzugs te/

sanskrit: praṇavarūpaḥ | nāḍīkauṭilyāttasya triparivartaścāṇḍālyāḥ praveśānnirgamā cceti kṛtvā | lalāṭe mahāsukhacakre vindunādabhūṣito'nāhatākṣaro haṁkāraḥ | tadeva vilomena śiraḥ- kaṇṭhahṛdayanābhirūpaḥ śrīheruko mantramūrtiḥ | tadādhāramāha - pṛthivyādisvabhāvāni yāni catvāri cakrāṇi tāni tasya buddhakṣetram | ahorātre catasraḥ sandhyā madhyāhna-pradiṣārdharātrapratyūṣalakṣaṇā ścakravāhinyaścatuḥpañcāśacchataśvāsasaṁkhyāḥ, ta eva tasya prajñāsanāthasya catvāro mukhāḥ | ya ete vicitrādayaścatvāra ānandopalakṣaṇabhūtāḥ
parallel: rtsa khyog po nyid las de la lan gsum du bskor bas gtum mo'i 'jug pa dang 'byung ba'o zhes byas nas so/ /

dpral bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor ni nA da dang thig les brgyan pa gzhom du med cing 'gyur ba med pa ha'i yi ge'o/ / de nyid lugs las ldog pa dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga dang / lte ba rnams su dpal he ru ka sngags kyi sku'i gzugs so/ /
sa sogs 'byung ba zhes bya ba la sogs pas de'i rten gsungs te/ de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni sa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo bzhi po rnams so/ /
nyin dang mtshan mo dang gung dang / phyi dro dang mtshan phyed dang snga dro'i mtshan nyid kyis thun bzhi po 'khor lo bzhir 'bab pa can/ brgya phrag lnga bcu rtsa bzhi dbugs kyi grangs te/
