de nyid ni/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyi zhal bzhi yin no/ / rnam pa sna tshogs pa la sogs pa la dga' ba nye bar mtshon pa'i skad cig bzhi dang / dga' ba la sogs pa bzhi dang / myur ba dang / rlangs pa dang / rnam par bcings pa dang / sna tshogs byed pa'i sbyor ba bzhi po rnams gang yin pa 'di rnams so sor bshad pa las/

de nyid de'i phyag bcu gnyis po rnams dang de nyid steng du rab tu 'jug pa las ni spyan bcu gnyis dang / de nyid dbus su rab tu 'jug pa las ni mtshon cha bcu gnyis po rnams so/ / 'di nyid bya ba dang byed pa po dag gi ste/

dpal thig le rdo rje sems dpa' dpyid de'i gzugs so/ / des ji ltar bde bar te/ / dga' ba bzhi'i rang bzhin nyid la brten nas rol zhing lus can thams cad kyi lus la dga' bar byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ /
de ltar dbus kyi gtso bo shes rab dang bcas pa'i zhal dang / phyag dang / sku mdog dang / dbyibs dang / mtshan ma ni nang gi gzugs su gsal bar byas nas/
'dab ma bzhi po dag ni yang / / zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ rtsa lnga rnams ni rnam par gnas/ /

sanskrit: kṣaṇā ānandādayaśca catvārastvaritabāṣpavibandhakaviśvastakāścatvāro yogāḥ pratyākhyātāsta eva tasya dvādaśabhujāsta eva cordhvapravṛttā dvādaśa netrāṇi ta eva madhyavartino dvādaśāyudhāni | ata eva kriyākārakayordāhikā''pyā yikayorbhāvena sāmarasyena śrīstilakā, vajrasattvo vasantastayo rūpam, tena yathāsukhaṁ caturānandarūpatvamāśritya krīḍati, sarvadehināṁ dehe ramata ityarthaḥ ||8-12||
parallel: zhes pa'i mthar thug pa'i gzhung ni/ /

sanskrit: evaṁ madhyanāyakaṁ saprajñaṁ mukhabhujavarṇasaṁsthānacihnamadhyātmarūpaṁ prakāśya jñānacakraḍākinī pūjākalaśacatuṣṭayaṁ ca pratipādayitumāha - dalānāṁ tu catuṣṭayamityārabhya pañcanāḍyo vyavasthitā ityantena granthena | tatra dharmacakrasya pūrvottarapaścimadakṣiṇa-digbhāgasthitāścatasra dhāraṇasrāvaṇa tejanapreraṇalakṣaṇāstā eva cittavajrasya
parallel: ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi po dang mchod pa'i bum pa bzhi po yang rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa yin te/ de la chos kyi 'khor lo'i shar dang / byang dang / nub dang / lho ste phyogs kyi char gnas pa bzhi po ni 'dzin pa dang / gsher ba dang / dro ba dang / g.yo ba'i mtshan nyid de/ thugs kyi rdo rje dpal he ru ka'i gnas ye shes kyi 'khor lor gnas shing son pa de rnams nyid ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs te/

sanskrit: ḍākinī ca tathā lāmā khaṇḍarohā ca rūpiṇī |
parallel: mkha' 'gro ma dang / lA ma dang / dum skyes ma dang / gzugs can mar shes par bya'o/ / de las nam mkha' la thim pa las mkha' 'gro ma dang / chu nam mkha' la rol pas na mA la ste/ sdeb sbyor las yi ge bzlog pa'o/ /
me nam mkha' dum bur byed cing 'gro bar byed do zhes pas dum bu ste/
de rnam par dag pa las/
gzugs can ma'o/ /
phyogs bral du gnas pa'i bum pa rnams/
phyogs bral gnas pa'i zhes bya ba la sogs pas gsungs te/

sanskrit: śrīherukasya pade jñānacakre sthitā yāstā eva ḍākinyādayo ḍākinī-lāmā-khaṇḍarohārūpiṇyo vijñeyāḥ | tatra pṛthivyākāśe ḍayanād ḍākinī | abdhātvākāśe lasanāt lāmā | chāndaso varṇavyatyayaḥ | tejaākāśaḥ śe ) khaṇḍayati gacchatīti khaṇḍam, tadviśuddhayā tatraiva rohatīti khaṇḍarohā | tataḥ samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ | vāyvākāśaṁ rūpayati viśodhayatīti rūpiṇī | digḍādinīruktvā vidikṣu pūjākalaśānāha - vidikṣu vyavasthitā iti | tatraiva jñānacakre hṛdi yāḥ pañcāmṛtavāhinyaḥ koṇasthā nāḍyastā eva kalaśākṛtayastadbhūtaśuṣira kapālamālāsthitasudhātmānaścatasraḥ pūjā jñātavyāḥ | upasaṁhāramāha - iti dehasyetyādi | evamuktena nyāyena śarīramadhye pañcanāḍyastrivṛtādyā jñānapadmaḍākinyaścatuḥpūjābhiḥ saha jñeyāḥ | na tu bāhyāḥ kalpitāḥ, anubhavanādarūpatvāt ||13-151/2||
parallel: ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i snying ga de nyid du bdud rtsi lnga 'bab cing mtshams su gnas pa'i rtsa gang yin pa de nyid ni bum pa'i rnam pa ste/ de las byung ba'i bug pa thod pa'i phreng bar gnas pa de rnams su bdud rtsi'i bdag nyid kyi mchod pa bzhi po shes par bya'o zhes lus kyi zhes bya ba la sogs pas nye bar bsdu ba gsungs te/

sanskrit: tricakranāḍīrūpā yoginīrāha - kāyavākcittetyādi | cittavākkāyeti vaktavye vilomapāṭho'bhavyeṣu gopanārthaḥ | tataśca cittādicakre śiraādicaturviṁśatipīṭhādyātmake pracaṇḍādyāścaturviṁśatināḍīrūpeṇaiva sthāne sthāne iti pīṭhopapīṭhādike upaśmaśānaparyante jñānudvayānte svabhāvasiddhā eva vyavasthitāḥ, mūlatantre'pi - "yoginyaḥ
parallel: de ltar bshad pa'i tshul gyis lus kyi dbus su rtsa lnga ste/
sum skor ma ye shes kyi pad+ma'i mchod pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang bcas pa rnams so zhes shes par bya'i/
nA da'i gzugs su myong ba nyid kyi phyir phyi rol rnams dang rtag pa ni ma yin no/ /
sku gsung thugs zhes bya ba la sogs pas/
'khor lo gsum gyi rtsa rnams rnal 'byor mar gsungs te/
thugs gsung sku zhes brjod par bya ba yin na yang /
lugs las bzlog pas klog pa ni/ /
skal ba med pa rnams la sba ba'i don to/ /
de'i phyir thugs la sogs pa'i 'khor lo dang / spyi bo la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid kyi gnas su/
rab gtum ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rtsa'i gzugs kho nas gnas dang gnas su ste/

sanskrit: mahorusthā tu yā nāḍī godāvaryāṁ vyavasthitā ||21||
parallel: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas nas nye ba'i dur khrod kyi mthar thug pa ste/
mthar thug pa rang bzhin gyis grub pa kho nas rnam par gnas te/

sanskrit: rāmeśvare tu yā nāḍī prasiddhā kharvarīti sā ||22||
parallel: rtsa ba'i rgyud du yang /

sanskrit: sahajā[ḥ] siddhā[ḥ]" iti vacanāt | tā evāha - śirasastu samudbhūtā nāḍyaḥ śirasijāḥ smṛtā iti | iha mahāsukhacakrād dvātriṁśannāḍyaḥ prādurbhavanti, himavatta iva saritaḥ ||16-17||
parallel: lhan cig skyes grub mkha' 'gro rnams/ /
zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: devīkoṭe tu yā nāḍī mṛdvī laṅkeśvarī matā ||23||
parallel: spyi bor yang dag byung ba yi/ /

sanskrit: bukkaṁ vahati yā nityaṁ sarvadehā dhivāsinī |
parallel: rtsa rnams spyi bo skyes zhes dran/ /
zhes bya bas de nyid gsungs te/
'dir bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo las rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur te/
gang dang ldan pa lta bu byung ba de rnams las khu ba dang / khrag dang / gnyi ga 'dzin par byed pa/

sanskrit: tāsāṁ ca śukraraktatadubhayasaṁgrahakāriṇyo lalanārasanāvadhūtikāḥ sakalatraidhātu-kotpattibhūtāḥ sattvarajastamomayyaḥ kāyavākcittātmikā boddhavyāḥ | tatra dvātriṁśato nāḍīnāṁ nāmāni śrīhevajre -
parallel: la la nA dang ra sa nA dang a wa d+hU tI rnams ni khams gsum po ma lus par skyed par byed pa ste/ snying stobs dang rdul dang mun pa'i rang bzhin lus dang ngag dang sems kyi bdag nyid can du khong du chud par bya'o/ / de la rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming ni/ /

sanskrit: abhedyā sūkṣmarūpā ca divyā vāmā ca vāminī |
parallel: dpal kye'i rdo rjer/ mi phyed ma dang phra gzugs ma/ / mdzes ma g.yon ma lus thung ma/ /

sanskrit: kūrmajā bhāvikī sekā doṣā viṣṭhā ca mātarī ||
parallel: rus sbal skyes ma sgom pa ma/ / dbang ma skyon ma bshang ba ma/ /
ma dang mtshan mo gsal sbyin drod/ / kun 'dar ro ma dang / /
gzhol ma rangs pa'i gdong ma dang / /
spyi ma rgyu sbyin sbyor bral ma/ / sdug ma grub ma me ma dang / / de bzhin yid bzang sum skor ma/ /
'dod ma khyim ma gtum mo dang / / bdud dral kA t+ya'i bu mo dang / / zhes pa'o/ /
sum skor ma la sogs pa dang / /

sanskrit: etā dvātriṁśat sandhyānāḍīcatuṣṭayena saha ṣaṭtriṁśat | trivṛttā(tā)dyā avadhūtyādyāścāṣṭau varjayitvā pariśiṣṭā abhedyādyāścaturviṁśati[ḥ] pracaṇḍādyā vijñeyāḥ |
parallel: a wa d+hU tI la sogs pa brgyad dor nas/ / lhag ma mi phyed ma la sogs pa ni rab gtum ma la sogs pa nyi shu rtsa bzhir shes par bya la/ 'di rnams kyi so dang sen mo la sogs pa'i khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/
de la rtsa gnyis dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi nges pa'i tshig ni/
phra gzugs ma ste spyi gtsug tu'o/ / pags pa'i dri ma phyi rol tu snang bzhin pas 'bab pa'i phyir/ mdzes ma ste rna ba g.yas pa la'o/ /
g.yon nyid du gang ba'i sha 'bab pa'i phyir ram/ g.yon gyi rnam pa'i snying stobs kyi khams 'byung ba'i phyir te/
gnyi ga las g.yon pa ma ste rgyab tu'o/ /
chu rgyus 'bab pa las sam/
zos pa skyugs pa las te/

sanskrit: āsāṁ tu nakhadantādayaścaturviṁśatidhātavaḥ khaṇḍakapālādayo jñātavyāḥ | tatra nāḍīpīṭhaḍākinīnāṁ niruktiḥ -
parallel: gnyi ga las thung ngu ma ni rna ba g.yon pa la'o/ / rus sbal gyi rgyab lta bur mi phyed pa'i rus pa'i phreng ba 'bab pa'i phyir/ rus sbal skyes ma ste smin ma'i dbus su'o/ /

sanskrit: nakhadantānāmabhedyānāṁ prasavanādabhedyā śirasi | keśaromṇāṁ susūkṣmāṇāṁ vahanāt sūkṣmarūpā śikhāyām | tvaṅmalasya bahirdyotamānasya vahanād divyā savyakarṇe | vāmanasyaiva pūrṇasya māṁsasya vahanād vāmā pṛṣṭhe | tadudaye vā vāmanākāre sattvadhātūtpādāt snānūnāṁ vahanād vāmanī, tadudaye vā bhuktasya vamanād vāmakarṇe | kūrmapṛṣṭhamivābhedyami-tyasthimālāvahanāt kūrmajā bhrūmadhye | vakkaṁ bhāvayatīti sravatīti bhāvikī cakṣurdvaye | siñcati hṛdayān sudhāraseneti sekā bāhumūladvaye | etāḥ pīṭhopapīṭheṣvaṣṭau nāḍyaḥ khecaryaḥ sopāyāścittacakre |
parallel: snying las bdud rtsi'i ro gtor bar byed pa'i phyir/ dbang ma ste dpung pa'i rtsa ba gnyis la'o/ / gnas dang nye ba'i gnas su rtsa brgyad po 'di rnams ni mkha' spyod ma ste/

sanskrit: duṣyate yā svaviṣayena(ṇa) vikriyata iti doṣā cakṣurdhātuvahā kakṣayoḥ, kakṣadarśanānmanovikṛteḥ, mameyamiti dveṣodayācca | dveṣo doṣa iti paryāyau | pittākhyaṁ viṣṭhaṁ vahatīti viṣṭhā stanadvaye | viḍdhātuḥ preraṇe | ūrdhvaṁ phuphphusavahanānmāteva
parallel: mkhris par brjod pa'i bshang ba 'bab bar byed do zhes pas bshang ba ma ste/ nu ma gnyis la'o/ / bshang ba'i khams bskul ba na steng du glo ba 'bab pa'i phyir ma lta bu yin pas ma'am/ /
rgyu ma'i phreng ba rnams su bde ba chen por nyal ba'i phyir ri khrod ma'o/ / mtshan mo'i rnam par rtog pa skyed pa'i phyir/
gnye ma dang tshil bu'i tshogs kyis rgyu ma la yongs su bskor nas gnas so/ / de 'bab par byed pa'i phyir dkar sbyin ma yin pa'am/ mtshan ma ma ste sna rtse la'o/ /
des bsil sbyin ma ste kha la'o/ / lto bar bkres pa'i me ste/ de 'bab par byed pa nyid kyi phyir/
drod ma ste mgrin pa la'o/ /

sanskrit: hayakarṇā tu kāñcīsthā viṣṭhāṁ vahati sarvadā |
parallel: bshang ba 'bab pa nyid kyi phyir/
gzhol ma ste yi ge bzlog pa las pra la bA'o/ /
rnam par snang mdzad 'bab ma snying ga la'o/ /

sanskrit: vākcakre saṁsthitā nāḍayo bhūcaryā dūtayaḥ sthitāḥ ||32||
parallel: mtshams mtha'i snod kyi nang du de 'bab pa nyid las rangs pa'i gdong ma ste/

sanskrit: mātarā, mātaraṁ pratyabhilāṣajananācca jagajjananācca nābhau | antramālāsu mahāsukhasya svāpanāccharvaro, rātrirvikalpajananācca nāsāgre | guṇavartimedojālikayā'ntrāṇi parivartya tiṣṭhati, tadvāhinī śītadā, tasyāṁ śītasparśadāyitvānmukhe | udare jaṭharāgne stadvāhitvādūṣmā kaṇṭhe | purīṣavāhitvāt pravaṇā, varṇavyatyayāt praṇavā, vairocanapravāhinī hṛdaye | sīmanto varaṭakamadhya [s]tadvāhitvād hṛṣṭavandanāt kara sparśāt prajñopāyayoḥ sānandanandanatvānmeḍhre | etat kṣetropakṣetrachandohopachandohākhyeṣvaṣṭau nāḍyo bhūcaryo vākcakre |
parallel: de'i reg pa las thabs dang shes rab dag gi dga' ba nyid kyi phyir chu so la'o/ / gsung gi 'khor lo la/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing dang / 'dun pa dang nye ba'i 'dun pa 'di rnams su rtsa brgyad po ni sa spyod ma rnams so/ /
khams mnyam pa nyid kyi bad kan 'bab pa'i phyir spyi ma ste gsang ba la'o/ / phal cher sha za ba'i phyir ram/ mi sbyor ba'i rnam par rtog pa skyed par byed pa'i phyir/
sbyor bral ma ste bshang lam la'o/ /
khrag 'bab pa las dpyid kyi me tog rnams kyi dga' ba skyed par byed pa'i phyir sdu gu ma ste brla dag la'o/ /
snyoms par 'jug pa na rdul skye ba ni thams cad la grub ste/

sanskrit: saurāṣṭre lohitākhyā tu śauṇḍinī ḍākinī matā |
parallel: de 'bab par byed pa nyid kyi phyir grub ma ste byin pa la'o/ /
grub pa'i mtshan ma skye ba'i rten yin pa'am/ de gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na lus rgyas pa la tshil bu nyid rgyu yin la/ de 'bab pa'i phyir rgyu sbyin ma ste/

sanskrit: dhātusāmyasya śleṣmaṇo vahanāt guhye | prāyeṇa māṁsabhakṣaṇād viyogā vikalpajananādvā gude | lohitavahanādvasantapuṣpaiḥ premotpādanāt premaṇī ūrvoḥ | svedotpāda samāpattau sarvatra siddhaḥ, tadvāhitvāt siddhā jaṅghayoḥ, siddhinimittotpādanaṁ prati vā tadadhikārāt | gātrapuṣṭau meda eva hetustadvahanāddhetudāyikā pādāṅgulīṣu | aśruṇā mukhasya śokasya vā jvalanāt pāvakī pādapṛṣṭhe | kheṭena yogināṁ somanasyajananāt sumanāḥ pādapṛṣṭhe | siṅghāṇakasyātyayanādyāvat kātyāyanī jānudvaye | iti melāpakopamelāpakaśmaśānopaśmaśānākhyeṣvaṣṭau nāḍyaḥ pātālavāsinyaḥ kāyacakre |
parallel: pa'i phyir me ma ste rkang pa'i rgyab la'o/ / lud pa dor bas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dga' ba skyed par byed pa'i phyir yid ma ste rkang pa'i mthe bo la'o/ / ji srid du ngar snabs kyi skyon byed pa'i phyir kA t+ya ya na ste pus mo gnyis la'o zhes pa sku'i 'khor lo la 'du ba dang / nye ba'i 'du ba dang / dur khrod dang / nye ba'i dur khrod du brjod pa rnams su rtsa brgyad po rnams ni sa 'og na gnas pa rnams so/ /

sanskrit: samayacakranāḍīniruktiṁ dūramapasṛtyāha - pūrvasmin vācike dvāra(6/40) iti | vāgdvārāt pūrvaṁ kāyadvāram, tasmiṁścakṣurādināḍyo'ṣṭau dakṣiṇeṣu cakṣuḥśrotraghrāṇeṣu vāmeṣu ca, vaktragudayośca tannāmnā prasiddhā eva samayacakrasthā jñātavyāḥ, viṣayopabhoga-lakṣaṇasamayasyānuṣṭhānāt | iti nāḍīniruktiḥ |
parallel: ngag gi snga ma'i sgo zhes bya ba la sogs pas dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i rtsa'i nges pa'i tshig rgyas par gsungs te/ ngag gi sgo las/ snga ma ni lus kyi sgo de rnams su'o/ /

sanskrit: pīṭhaniruktiḥ prāguktā | ḍākinīniruktirucyate | iha sarvā eva ḍākinyo vārāhīkulasaṁbhavā iti bahuśaḥ pratipāditam | tadabhinnatayaiva tā nirucyante | tatra praśāntaṁ caṇḍatvaṁ yasyāḥ sā pracaṇḍā, mahāsukhasthānamāsādyeti yāvat | caṇḍe tīkṣṇe dāhake vāmetare nāḍyau asyā iti caṇḍākṣī, madhyamayā dvayoḥ prakāśanāt | agnivarṇa -
parallel: 'dir g.yas kho na'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni phag mo'i rigs las yang dag par byung ba yin no zhes lan mang du khong du chud par byas pa yin no/ / de dang mi phyed pa'i gzugs nyid kyis de rnams kyi brjod par bya ste/ de la rab tu ma zhi ba dang gtum pa nyid gang gi yin pa de ni rab tu gtum ma'o/ /

g.yon dang cig shos kyi rtsa dag bde ba chen po'i gnas su son pa ji srid par gtum zhing rno ba'i sreg par byed pa ni 'di'i yin no zhes pas gtum mig ma'o/ / gnyis po dag dbu mar rab tu gsal ba las me'i kha dog gi 'od dang ldan pa nyid kyi phyir 'od ldan ma dang / gsang ba dang / snying ga dang / gdong gi sna rtse chen po rnams gang gi yin pa de ni sna chen ma ste/ /
gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni don ji lta ba bzhin no/ /
dpa' bo skyed par byed pa nyid kyis yod par byed pa gang yin pa de ni dpa' bo'i blo can ma ste/ lte ba'i dbus nas dpa' bo ni/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /
rnon po yang 'di yin la 'khor lo gsum sreg par byed
mi'u thung ma'o/ / lang+ka ni lus kyi grong ste/

sanskrit: kheṭaṁ vahati yā śuṣkā marau tu cakravartinī ||38||
parallel: de'i dbang phyug ma'am rje mo ni lang+ka'i dbang phyug ma'o/ / shing gi grib ma lta bur bsil ba 'phel bar byed pa'i phyir/

sanskrit: prabhāyuktatvāt prabhāvatī | mahatyo guhyahṛnmukheṣu nāsikā yasyāḥ sā mahānāsā | pīṭhaḍākinyo yathā'nvarthāḥ | vīro janakatvena vidyate yasyāḥ sā vīramato, "nābhimadhye sthito vīraḥ" iti vacanāt | kharā cāsau tricakradāhād varā cāsau punastadāpyāyanā diti kharvarī | laṅkā śarīrapurī tasyāmīśvarī svāminī laṅkeśvarī | drumacchāyeva śīlalā''pyāyanād drumacchāyā | ityupapīṭhaḍākinīnāmanvarthāḥ | iti cittacakrasya khecaryaḥ |
parallel: shing grib ma'o zhes pa nye ba'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin te/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i mkha' la spyod pa rnams so/ / sa srung lta bu'i shugs 'bab pa ni sa srung ma'o/ /

sanskrit: airāvatī airāvata iva vegavāhinī | tṛtīyaulau granthibhedānmahābhairavā | vāyuvadadha ūrdhvaṁ daśa dikṣu ca vego javo yasyāḥ sā vāyuvegā, olidvaye'pi | surāṁ sudhāṁ bhakṣayatīti surābhakṣī, jñānolau | iti kṣetropakṣetraḍākinyaḥ sānvarthāḥ |
parallel: rlung lta bur steng dang 'og dang phyogs bcu rnams su yang mgyogs pa'i shugs gang gi yin pa de ni rlung shugs ma'o/ / sgron ma gnyis par yang chang ni bdud rtsi ste 'thung bar byed do zhes pas chang 'thung ma ste/ ye shes kyi sgron ma'o zhes pa zhing dang nye ba'i zhing gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin no/ /

sanskrit: premodgamācchayāmā cāsau sarvacakreṣu krīḍanāddevīti śyāmādevī | śobhanaṁ tarpaṇaṁ bhadraṁ kalyāṇaṁ yasyāḥ sā subhadrā | hayavaddakṣiṇakarṇena nirgacchatīti hayakarṇā |
parallel: rab tu dga' ba ldang ba'i phyir sngo bsangs kyang 'di yin la/ 'khor lo thams cad du rol pa las lha mo yang yin pa ni lha mo sngo bsangs ma'o/ / legs pa ni me long yin la/
bzang ba ni dge ba ste/
de gang gi yin pa de ni shin tu bzang mo'o/ /
rta lta bur rna ba g.yas nas 'byung bar byed pa ni rta rna ma'o/ /
bya'i gdong gi rnam pa nyid kyi phyir mkha' 'gro bya gdong ma ste/

sanskrit: khagamukhākāratvāt khagānanā | iti chandohopacchandohaḍākinīnāmānvarthāḥ | vākcakre bhūcaryaḥ |
parallel: 'dun pa dang nye ba'i 'dun pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du'o zhes pa gsung gi 'khor lo las sa spyod ma rnams so/ / 'khor lo lta bur 'khor lo rnams su 'di'i shugs kyis 'gro zhing 'ong bas na 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ / de bzhin gshegs pa dang spyan ma la sogs pa rnams dang por dum bur byed cing /

sanskrit: cakravaccakreṣu vego'syā gamanāgamana iti cakravegā | ādau tathāgatalocanādīn khaṇḍayati punarārohayati janayatīti khaṇḍarohā | surāsavakṣābatvāt śauṇḍinī | cakrāṇyeva varma sannāho'syāḥ sā cakravarmiṇī | iti melāpakopamelāpakaḍākinyaḥ sānvarthāḥ |
parallel: slar yang 'jug par byed cing skyed par byed pa'i phyir dum skyes ma'o/ / myos par byed pa'i chang 'thung ba'i phyir chang 'thung ma'o/ / 'di'i go cha 'khor lo lta bu yin pa de ni/

sanskrit: suṣṭhu vīrādakārāt prabhavatīti suvīrā | gamanāgamanayormahadbalaṁ yasyāḥ sā mahābalā | cakreṣu vartituṁ śīlaṁ yasyāḥ sā cakravartinī | mahadvoryamutthāne yasyāḥ sā mahāvīryā | iti śmaśānopaśmaśānaḍākinīnāmanvarthāḥ |
parallel: 'gro ba dang 'ong ba dag gi stobs chen mo gang gi yin pa de ni stobs chen mo'o/ / 'khor lo rnams su 'jug pa'i ngang tshul gang yin pa de ni 'khor los sgyur ma'o/ / ldang ba na brtson 'grus chen mo gang gi yin pa de ni/

sanskrit: vīraniruktirucyate | khaṇḍaṁ śiraḥsthaṁ bodhicittaṁ nakhadaśanarūpeṇa kā(ka)layati prerayatīti khaṇḍakapālī | mahāntaṁ kaṁ śikhāsthitaṁ sattvadeva keśaroma kālayatīti mahākaṅkālaḥ | karṇamūlaṁ prāpya tvaṅmalaṁ prerayatīti kaṅkālaḥ | vikaṭā māṁsamayī daṁṣṭrā pṛṣṭhe yasya sa tathā [ vikaṭadaṁṣṭraḥ ] | pīṭhavīraniruktiḥ |
parallel: skra dang ba spu len par byed pa'i phyir keng rus chen po'o/ / rna ba'i rtsa bar son nas pags pa'i dri ma skul bar byed pa'i phyir keng rus so/ / rgyab tu sha'i rang bzhin gyi mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa gang gi yin pa de la de skad ces bya ste/

sanskrit: surāṇāṁ snāyūnāma(m) vairī vāmakarṇāt pravartakaḥ surāvairī | bhrūmadhye sthitvā'para(ri)mitāsthimālāpravartakatvāttanmayo'mitābhaḥ | vajraratnavat prabhā yasya, tasya cakṣuṣi sthitvā vukkasya pravartakatvād vajraprabhaḥ | vajravad dṛḍho deho yasya bāhumūlād hṛdayapravartako vajradehaḥ | upapīṭhaniruktiḥ |
parallel: smin ma'i dbus su gnas nas dpag tu med pa'i rus pa'i phreng ba rab tu 'jug par byed pa nyid las byung ba ni 'od dpag med do/ / rdo rje rin chen lta bu'i 'od mig gang gi yin pa de las mchin pa rab tu 'jug par byed pa'i phyir rdo rje 'od do/ / gang gi lus rdo rje lta bur brtan pa'i dpung pa'i rtsa ba las snying rab tu 'jug par byed pa'i phyir rdo rje lus te/
nye ba'i gnas kyi dpa' bo'i tshig go/ /
mchan khung dag las mig gi myu gu skye ba'i phyir myu gu can no/ /
nu ma dag las rdo rje'i ral pa lta bu'i mkhris pa'i khams skyed par byed pa'i phyir rdo rje ral pa can no/ /

sanskrit: koṇeṣu yamadāḍhī ca yamadūtī tathaiva ca ||42||
parallel: lte bar rdo rje chen po yang 'jig par byed pa glo ba rab tu 'jug pa las dpa' bo chen po'o/ /

sanskrit: kakṣābhyāṁ cakṣuraṅkurajananādaṅkurikaḥ | stanābhyāṁ vajrajaṭilarūpasya pittadhātorjananād vajrajaṭilaḥ | nābhervajrāṇāṁ mahatāmapi bhayaṅkaraphuphphusapravartakatvānmahāvīraḥ | nāsāgrādantradvārapravartakatvād vajrahūkāraḥ | iti kṣetropakṣetravīra niruktiḥ |
parallel: sna rtse las rgyu ma'i sgo rab tu 'jug par byed pa nyid kyi phyir/ rdo rje hUM mdzad do zhes pa zhing dang nye ba'i zhing gi dpa' bo'i nges pa'i tshig go/ /

sanskrit: sukhādāpyāyikāguṇavartipravartakatvāt subhadraḥ | kaṇṭhādudarapravartakatvād vajra bhadraḥ, kaṇṭhodarābhyāmādimadhyāntakalyāṇavajramayadharmacakrapravartakatvāt | hṛdayāt kātarajanatrāsakapurīṣapravartakatvād vajrabhairavaḥ | meḍhrāt sīmāntasya trinetrasya pravartakatvād virūpākṣaḥ | iti chandohopachandohavīraniruktiḥ |
parallel: rdo rje bzang po'o/ / yang na mgrin pa dang lto ba dag las thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba las kyang ngo / / skye bo sdar ma'i snying la skrag par byed pa bshang ba rab tu 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir rdo rje 'jigs byed do/ /

sanskrit: guhyāccharīradhāraṇasamarthasya śleṣmano(ṇo) vahanānmahābalaḥ | guhyāt pītavarṇasya pūyasya pravartanād ratnavajraḥ | ūrubhyāṁ balavato raktasya pravartanād hayagrīvaḥ | jaṅghābhyāṁ romakūpaśuṣiravyāpakasvedapravartakatvād ākāśagarbhaḥ | iti melāpakopamelāpakavīraniruktiḥ |
parallel: bshang lam las kha dog ser po'i rnag rab tu 'jug par byed pa'i phyir rin chen rdo rje'o/ / brla dag las stobs dang ldan pa'i khrag rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir rta mgrin no/ / byin pa dag las ba spu'i bu ga'i nang khyab par byed pa'i rdul rab tu 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir nam mkha'i snying po'o zhes pa 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba'i dpa' bo'i nges pa'i tshig go/ /

sanskrit: pādāṅgulibhyo'bhedyahūkārarūpasya medasaḥ pravartakatvāt śrīherukaḥ | pādapṛṣṭhāt padmanarteśvarasya bodhicittasyā śravarūpasya pravartanāt padmanarteśvaraḥ | aṅguṣṭhābhyāṁ śvetavarṇasya kheṭasya pravartakatvādvairocanaḥ | jānubhyāṁ candragaurasya siṅghāṇasya pravartakatvādvajrasattvaḥ | iti śmaśānopaśmaśānavīraniruktiḥ |
parallel: rkang pa'i rgyab las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug byang chub kyi sems mchi ma'i rang bzhin rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ / mthe bo dag las kha dog dkar po'i lud pa rab tu 'jug par byed pa nyid kyi phyir rnam par snang mdzad do/ / pus mo dag la zla ba dkar po'i ngar snabs rab tu 'jug par byed pa nyid kyi phyir rdo rje sems dpa'o zhes pa dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod kyi dpa' bo'i nges pa'i tshig go/ /

g.yon dang g.yas su 'bab pa las rab tu 'jug bzhin pa 'di rnams kyi sngon du nges par byas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / don ji lta ba bzhin gyi nye ba'i gnas na gnas pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thim pa dang / longs spyod dang / dbang byed pa las bdun cu rtsa gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: caturthāpi ca vikhyātā bhīmā yamamathanī matā ||43||
parallel: don 'di ni/
sku
gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ / nyi shu rtsa bzhir yang dag brjod/ / ces bya ba nas brtsams te/
shes rab pha rol phyin 'di rnams/ / lus la yang dag rnam par gnas/ / zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i gzhung gis rtogs par byas pa yin no/ /
'di rnams kyi tshig gi don gyi nges par sbyor ba ni go sla'o zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/
rgyas par bstan pa drug pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /

sanskrit: eṣāṁ vāmadakṣiṇavāhābhyāṁ pravartamānānāṁ prāṅnirūpitaḍākinīsahitānāṁ yathārthānāmupapīṭhasthitānāṁ yoginīnāṁ layabhogādhikārād dvāsaptatirjñātavyāḥ | ayamarthaḥ - "kāyavākcittacakre ta caturviśatyudāhṛtāḥ" ( 6/16) ityārabhya "prajñāpāramitārūpāḥ svaśarīre vyavasthitāḥ" ( 6/44) ityantena granthena pratipāditāḥ (taḥ) | etatpadārthaniyojanā sugamā ||18-44||
parallel: rtsa'i rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rang bzhin du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/

sanskrit: iti vasantatilakāyāṁ niṣpannakramasādhanopāyikāyāṁ rahasyadīpikāyāṁ ṭīkāyāṁ ṣaṣṭhanirdeśe vistarabyākhyā ||6||
parallel: de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyas par bstan pa bdun pa gsungs te/ gang yang zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/
dang por rig par bya ba ni/

sanskrit: athānyatamasya tathāgatakāyasya nāḍīcakra saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣika dharmaviśuddhiṁ kathayiṣyāmi ||1||
parallel: mgo bo la sogs pa'i lus kyi sgo 'di rnams su mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa rnams byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos kyi ngo bo nyid du yang 'gyur ro zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ / 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ lam lngas bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la ji lta ba bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: kāyānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ ḍākinī | vedanānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ lāmā | dharmānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ khaṇḍarohā | cittānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ rūpiṇī ||2||
parallel: chos bcu gnyis rnams so/ / bcu gang zhe na/ dran par nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rnams so/ /

sanskrit: athetyādinā nāḍīrūpāṇāṁ yoginīnāṁ bodhipākṣikadharmasvarūpatāṁ pratipādayituṁ saptamanirdeśamāha - anyatamasyetyādi prāgvat ||1||
parallel: chos bdun rnams so/ / bdun gang zhe na/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun rnams so/ /

sanskrit: yā etā hṛdayādiśiraādikāyadvāreṣu ḍākinyādisvabhāvā nāḍayastā bodhipākṣikadharmasvabhāvā api bhavantīti pratipādyate - kāyānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ ḍākinītyādigranthena | iha bodhisattvena mahāsattvenānuttarāṁ samyaksaṁbodhimabhisaṁboddhukāmena pañcamārgasaṁgṛhīteṣu saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣikeṣu dharmeṣu yathāvacchikṣitavyam | tatra katame pañcamārgāḥ ? saṁbhāramārgaḥ, prayogamārgaḥ, darśanamārgaḥ, bhāvanāmārgaḥ, aśaikṣamārgaśceti | tatra saṁbhāramārgaḥ katamaḥ ? dvādaśa dharmāḥ | katame dvādaśa ? catvāri smṛtyupasthānāni, catvāri samyakprahāṇāni, catvāri(ra) ṛddhipādāśceti | tatra katamaḥ prayogamārgaḥ ? daśa dharmāḥ | katame daśa ? pañcendriyāṇi pañcabalāni ceti | tatra katamo darśanamārgaḥ ? sapta dharmāḥ | katame sapta ? saptabodhyaṅgāni | tatra katamo bhāvanāmārgaḥ ? mārgāṅgāni | kati mārgāṅgāni ? āryāṣṭāṅgo mārgaḥ | katamo'śaikṣamārga ? mārgajñānānāmantyasyāntyaḥ kṣaṇaḥ |
parallel: mi slob pa'i lam gang zhe na/ lam shes pa'i mtha' las mtha'i skad cig go/ / ci skad du de rnams byang chub kyi phyogs yin/

sanskrit: kimarthametāni bodhipakṣāṇi? kuto vā dharmā ? katamā bodhiḥ ? āha - buddhayantyanayā sarvamātma svarūpamiti bodhiḥ | sā kiṁ prādeśikī, uta vyāpiketi ? āha -
parallel: smras pa/ 'dis thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi ngo bo nyid rtogs par bya'o zhes pas byang chub bo/ / ci de khyab pa yin zhe na/

sanskrit: vyāpikā prādeśikī ca | tathā pudgalanairātmyalakṣaṇā bodhiḥ śrāvakabodhiḥ prādeśikī, dharmāṇāṁ dravyatvenābhyupagamāt | tathā vimucyamānāḥ śrāvakabodhau nipateyuḥ, sā bodhi [ḥ] svārthamātrapādhānyādaviśuddhatvāt prādeśikītyucyate | ubhayanairātmyalakṣaṇā tu bodhiḥ samyaksaṁbodhirvyāpakatvād vyāpikā, dharmāṇāṁ tattvabhāvenāvasthānāt | tasyāvabodheraṅgānyupāyā bodhyaṅgāni | aṅgānyupāyāḥ pakṣyā abhivyaktikaraṇānīti paryāyāḥ |
parallel: yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni khyab par byed pa po nyid yin pa'i phyir na nyi tshe ba ma yin te/ chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid kyi dngos pos rnam par gzhag pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i mtshams kyi yan lag rnams ni thabs te/

sanskrit: dharmāśca kuta iti ? dhriyante bodhisattvairmārgasthaiścetasi vyavasthāpyanta iti dharmāḥ kuśalapakṣasaṁgṛhītāḥ, anāśravatvāt, mārgasattvasyaikāntakuśalatvāt | mārgabhedāttu kuśalasāśravatvaṁ pratipatturapekṣayā | eṣāṁ pañcānāṁ mārgāṇāṁ dvābhyāṁ saṁgraho veditavyaḥ |
parallel: byang chub sems dpa' lam la gnas pa rnams kyi sems las byung ba rnam par gzhag par bya ba rnams te/ dge ba'i phyogs kyis bsdus pa rnams so/ / zag pa med pa nyid kyi phyir lam gyi bden pa ni mtha' gcig tu dge ba'i phyir/

sanskrit: katamābhyāṁ dvābhyām ? laukikamārgeṇa lokottaramārgeṇa ceti | tatra kaukikamārge kati dharmāḥ ? dvāviṁśatidharmāḥ | katame ? smṛtyupasthāna-samyakprahāṇa-ṛddhipāda-indriyabalākhyāni | tatra lokottaramārgaḥ(rge) kati dharmāḥ ? pañcadaśa | katame ? saptabodhyaṅgāni, āryāṣṭāṅgamārgaśceti |
parallel: de la 'jig rten las las 'das pa'i lam gyi chos rnams gang zhe na/ bco lnga rnams so/ / gang zhe na byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad po rnams so/ /

sanskrit: nusmṛtyupasthānam, cittānusmṛtyupasthānam, dharmānusmṛtyupasthānam | tatra kāyānusmṛtyupasthānam - iha sarveṇa sarvakāyo'yaṁ svaparasantānavartī yāvattraidhātukīyaḥ | sa pravicintyamāna ekastāvanna bhavati, avayavino 'siddhatvāt, tadasiddhiśca pākāpākarāgārāgādidoṣadarśa-nāt, ekatvāsiddhāvanekatvānupapatteḥ paramāṇuśo bhidyamānatvāt paramāṇoḥ saṁhatatvānupa-patteḥ, tadabhyupagame vā viśvasya paramāṇutāpatteḥ | tasmādubhayadharmarahitatvācchūnyo'yaṁ kāya iti yo yā)'nusmṛtistasyā upa samīpe cittasya sthāpanaṁ kāyānusmṛtyupasthānam | evaṁ ca vedanāpi sātādyātmikā ṣaḍvijñānakāyā tadāśritatvādaṣṭādaśadhā | sāpi sātādī-nāmatītādibhedenāsattvāt śūnyeti smṛterupasthānaṁ svacetasīti vedanānusmṛtyupasthānam | evaṁ jñeyāt pūrvaṁ paścāt sahabhāvitvāsiddheścittaṁ śūnyamiti yaḥ smṛterupasthānaṁ cittānusmṛtyupasthānam | evaṁ kuśalākuśala vyākṛtādibhedabhinnānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ pūrvavacchūnyatvād yaḥsmṛterupasthānaṁ taddarmānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ bodhisattvamārgaḥ, yataḥ pañcātmakaṁ traidhātukam | tatra
parallel: de la lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni/ 'dir thams cad kyis thams cad du/ rang dang gzhan gyi lus 'di ni ji srid du rgyun gyis 'jug pa na khams gsum por gang zhig snang ba de nyid/

sanskrit: chandaddharyutpāda[ḥ] pracaṇḍā | vīryaddharyutpādaścaṇḍākṣī | mīmāṁsaddharyutpādaḥ prabhāvatī | cittaddharyutpādo mahānāsā ||3||
parallel: bar ma gnyis pos/ tshor ba dang rnam par shes pa gnyis dag gi mtha' las 'du shes dang 'du byed dag ste/

sanskrit: kāyānusmṛtyupasthānena rūpaskandha samyaganubodhena madhye dvābhyāṁ vedanāvijñānayorantyena saṁjñāsaṁskārayoḥ, dharmaśabdasāmānyād bhājanalokasyeti | śrāvakadarśane tu nityasukhaśuci-sātmakacaturviparyāsapratipakṣānityāśuciduḥkhānātmalakṣaṇāni catvāri smṛtyupasthānānīti viśeṣaḥ | mantradarśane tu svasaṁvidrūpā ḍākinyaḥ kāyādīnāṁ dharmatārūpā jñeyāḥ | tadarthamāha - kāyānusmṛtyupasthānaṁ ḍākinītyādi ||2||
parallel: mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / mi gtsang ba dang / bdag med pa'i mtshan nyid kyi dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ / sngags kyi lta ba la ni rang rig pa'i rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni lus la sogs pa rnams te/ chos nyid kyi gzugs su shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: tatra kati ṛddhipādā iti kiñcidapasṛtyāha - catvāra ṛddhipādāḥ | chanda-ṛddhipādaḥ, vīrya-ṛddhipādaḥ, mīmāṁsā-ṛddhipādaḥ, citta-ṛddhipādaḥ | vīrya-samādhiprahāṇeyaḥ saṁskārasamanvita ṛddhipādaḥ mīmāṁsāsamādhiprahāṇeyaḥ saṁskārasamanvita ṛddhipādaḥ | cittasamādhiprahāṇeyaḥ saṁskārasamanvita ṛddhipādaḥ |
parallel: 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ / de la 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa la sogs pa gang zhe na/ / 'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /

sanskrit: eṣāṁ sūtrāṇāmayamarthaḥ - iha sarvasyaiva samādheḥ ṣaḍdoṣā bhavanti | tadyathā - "kauśīdyamālambanasaṁpramoṣaḥ layastadauddhatyamayatnād" iti | eṣāṁ layo(yaṁ) dvābhyāmekīkṛtya pañca doṣā bhavanti | tatprahāṇārthamaṣṭau prahāṇasaṁskārāḥ | katame āṣṭau ?
parallel: 'di las bying ba dang / rgod pa gcig tu byas nas skyon lngar 'gyur ro/ / de rnams spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad do/ / brgyad gang zhe na/

btang snyoms te brgyad do/ / de la dang po ni le lo'i gnyen po ste/ dad pa dang / 'dun pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / shin tu sbyangs pa ste bzhi dang / dran pa dang / shes bzhin dang / sems pa dang / /
dran pas ni dmigs pa brjed pa spong bar byed la/ shes bzhin gyis ni bying ba dang rgod pa ste/ 'di dag ni brtson 'grus dang dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dag go/ /

sanskrit: tatra kauśīdya syādyaḥ pratipakṣa śraddhayā kuśalakarmapravṛttiḥ | chandena teṣāmāśaya-sahagatatvam | vīryeṇa kauśīdya prahāṇam | prasrabdhyā prahāṇasākṣātkriyā | sa eṣa chanda ṛddhipāda ucyate | smṛtyā''lambanasaṁpramoṣaṁ prajahāti | saṁprajanyena layauddhatyam | etau vīryamīmāṛddhipādau | cetanopekṣābhyāṁ yadāyattayatnayoḥ prahāṇaṁ sa cittaṛddhipāda ityucyate | ata evaitau catvāri vīryāṇi bhaṇyante | ata evāha samādhirājasūtre -
parallel: gang gi tshe sems dang btang snyoms dag gis gang zhig 'bad pas spong ba de ni sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang par brjod par bya'o/ / de nyid kyi phyir de dag ni brtson 'grus bzhir brjod bar bya'o/ / de nyid ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor gsungs te/

sanskrit: śraddhendriyaṁ vīramatī | vīryendriyaṁ kharvarī | smṛtīndriyaṁ laṅkeśvarī | samādhīndriyaṁ drumacchāyā | prajñendriyamairāvatī ||4||
parallel: dben pa la gnas pa/

sanskrit: 'vivekaniśrito virārgānaśrito nirodhaniśrito vyavasargapariṇataśca saṁskṛtavastu visaṁyogā[d] dravyasargatatprahāṇe samanvāgata ṛddhipāda iti pañcāṅgaḥ | saṁpiṇḍya viṁśatiprakārāścatvāra ṛddhipādāḥ |" [iti]
parallel: rnam par spong bas yongs su bsgyur ba/ 'dus byas kyi dmigs pa la sbyor ba dang bral ba'i phyir rdzas spong ba de ni spong ba dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa zhes pa ste/ yan lag lnga po bsdu bar byas na rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi po ni rnam pa nyi shu rnams so/ /

sanskrit: ṛddhirnāma katamā ? arddhanamṛddhiḥ, 'ṛdhu vṛddhau' iti dhātupārāyaṇe pāṭhāt | tataśca sarva eva daśabalavaiśāradyādayo buddhāguṇā yasyāṁ vṛddhimupayānti sirddhiḥ samyaksaṁbodhiḥ, tasyāḥ pādā iva pādāḥ prāptihetava iti ṛddhipādāḥ | sādhāraṇe'pi mārgasyopāyatve eṣāmevarddhipādadvitvam, samādhidoṣapratipakṣasya prakarṣatvāt | etatsva-bhāvāḥḥ pracaṇḍā-caṇḍākṣī-prabhāvatī-mahānāsāḥ pīṭhaḍākinyaścittacakre ||3||
parallel: 'di kho na'i rkang pa gnyis nyid ni ting nge 'dzin gyi skyon gyi gnyen po shin du ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ / 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin ni rab gtum ma dang / gtum mig ma dang / 'od ldan ma dang / sna chen ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ / de la dbang po rnams ni du zhe na/

sanskrit: tatra katīndriyāṇi ? pañca | katame pañca ? śraddhāvīryasmṛtisamādhiprajñāśceti | tatra prayogamārge catvāro nirvedhabhāgīyā dharmāḥ - ūṣmagatāḥ mūrdhagatāḥ, kṣāntigatāḥ, laukikāgradharmāśceti | tatra nirāśravān samādhīn bodhisattvasyāmukhīkurvato vahniriva pūrvaliṅgādūṣmā prādurbhavati | cetaso jñānāgnerudbhūtā (taḥ) sa ucyate ūṣmagataḥ | sa eva prakarṣagato'dhyaśayasahagato mūrdhā | tadeva cittaṁ sahate tādātmyeneti kṣāntiḥ | tameva kṣānteranantaraṁ(na ?) nirgata iti laukikāgradharmaḥ, upacārādayaṁ saṁprayogaḥ | tatra prathamayornirvedhabhāgīyayorarthe śraddhādayastāni pañcendriyāṇītyucyante | tatra śraddhā bhāvini lokottaramārge satvatya)ratnatrayādau vā cetasa[ḥ] saṁpratyayastacchraddhendriyam | średdhendriyodānitān dharmān utsāhayati tadvīryendriyam | tacca catuṣprakāra[m] ārambhavīryam, [a] parikramavīryam, pratyavekṣāvīryam, pratipattivīryaṁ ceti | vīryendriyodānitān dharmān yena punaḥ punarāmukhīkriyante na vismaryante tat smṛtīndriyam | smṛtīndriyodānitān dharmān yanmanā(nasi) sarvasārāntaraparihāreṇa sthāpayati tat samādhīndriyam | samādhīndriyodānitān dharmān bhūtapratyavekṣayā yadvicāra yati tatprajñe -
parallel: de la sbyor ba'i lam du nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa'i chos bzhi po dro bar gyur pa dang / rtse mor gyur pa dang / bzod par gyur pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi mchog rnams so/ / lnga gang zhe na/ dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab po/ /

sanskrit: śraddhābalaṁ mahābhairavī | vīryabalaṁ vāyuvegā | smṛtibalaṁ surābhakṣī | samādhibalaṁ śyāmādevī | prajñābalaṁ subhadrā ||5||
parallel: de la dad pa ni yod pa nyid dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam dang / bden pa dang dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa la sems kyi yid ches pa de ni dad pa'i dbang po'o/ / dad pa'i dbang pos bskyed pa'i chos rnams la 'bad par byed pa de ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang po'o/ / de yang rnam pa bzhi ste/

sanskrit: samādhisaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ hayakarṇā | vīryasaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ khagānanā | prītisaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ cakravegā | praśrabdhisaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ khaṇḍarohā | dharmapravicaya saṁbodhyaṅgaṁ śauṇḍinī | smṛtisaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ cakravarmiṇī | upekṣāsaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ suvīrā ||6||
parallel: sngon du 'gro ba'i brtson 'grus dang / mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / so sor rtog pa'i brtson 'grus dang / sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus so/ / brtson 'grus kyis bskyed pa'i chos rnams la yang dang yang du sngon du phyogs par byas nas brjod pa med pa de ni dran pa'i dbang po'o/ / dran pa'i dbang pos bskyed pa'i chos rnams yid la byed pa ni tha snyad gzhan thams cad yongs su dor nas gnas par byed pa de ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po'o/ /

sanskrit: ndriyam | kasmādindriyam ? kuśaladharmeṣu prabhavatvādindriyam, pañcaskandhānāṁ saṁkleśavyavadānayo ratyutpādakaḥ (kam) | prajñendriyaṁ vihāya vīramatī-kharvarī-laṅkeśvarī-druma-cchāyāścatasro ḍākinyaḥ śraddhāvīryasmṛtisamādhiviśuddhayo jñeyāḥ ||4||
parallel: dge ba'i chos rnams rab tu 'byung ba nyid kyi phyir dbang po ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba'i phung po lnga rnams kyi shin tu skyed par byed pa'o/ / shes rab kyi dbang po dor nas dpa' bo'i blo can ma dang / mi'u thung ma dang / lang+ka'i dbang phyug ma dang / shing grim ma ste mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rnams ni dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams rnam par dag par shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: tatra kati balāni ? pañca | katame ? prāguktā eva śraddhādayaḥ | kimindriyabalānāṁ nānākaraṇam ? āha - vivartante hi śraddhādayo yadā tadi(de)ndriyavyapadeśa bhājino bhavanti, yadā vipakṣenā(ṇā) śraddhākauśīdyavismṛtivikṣepā yoniśo manasikāraparyāyadauṣprajñairna nivartante, pañcabalāni bhavantīti nānākaraṇam | prāguktaprajñendriyeṇa vākcakre airāvatīmahābhairavā-vāyuvegā-surābhakṣī-śyāmādevī-subhadrā viśuddhāni jñeyāni ||5||
parallel: gang gi tshe mi mthun pa'i phyogs ma dad pa dang / / le lo dang / brjed nges pa dang / rnam par g.yengs shing skye ba'i gnas yid la byed pa dang / shes rab 'chal bas mi brdzi ba ni stobs su 'gyur ro zhes pas byed pa tha dad pa'o/ / sngar gsungs pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po dang bcas gsung gi 'khor lo'i sa srung ma dang / 'jigs byed chen po dang / rlung shugs ma dang / chang 'thung ma dang / lha mo sngo bsangs ma dang / shin tu bzang mo rnams rnam par dag par shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: tatra kati bodhyaṅgāni ? sapta | katame sapta ? samādhisaṁbodhyaṅgam, vīryasaṁbodhyaṅgam, prītisaṁbodhyaṅgam, prasrabdhisaṁbodhyaṅgam, dharmapravicayasaṁbodhyaṅgam, smṛtisaṁbodhyaṅgam, upekṣāsaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ ceti | darśanamārge etānyaṅgāni bodheḥ | nirāvaraṇaṁ jñānaṁ bodhiḥ | yena satyadarśanaṁ cetasi samādhīyate, tat samādhisaṁbodhyaṅgam | yena tatraivotsāhaḥ, tadvīryasaṁbodhyaṅgam | yena tatraiva cittaṁ niḥsaṁśayaṁ karoti, tat prītisaṁbodhyaṅgam | tayaiva prītyā kāyavākcittakarmaṇyataḥ kleśoṣmaprahāṇādatiśītalā bhavati, tat prasrabdhisaṁbodhyaṅgam | samyagbhāvasvarūpaparijñānaṁ taddharmapravicayasaṁbodhyaṅga -
parallel: ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ / yan lag 'di rnams ni mthong ba'i lam du byang chub kyi yin te/

sanskrit: samyagdṛṣṭirmahābalā | samyaksaṁkalpaścakravartinī | samyagvāg mahāvīryā | samyakkarmāntaḥ kākāsyā | samyagājīva ulūkāsyā | samyagvyāyāmaḥ śvānāsyā | samyaksmṛtiḥ śūkarāsyā | samyaksamādhirbhagavān śrīherukaḥ ||7||
parallel: gang gis bden pa mthong ba'i sems la ting nge 'dzin du byed pa de ni ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ / gang gis de kho na la 'bad par byed pa de ni brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ /

sanskrit: [m] | tatraiva caitasyasaṁpramoṣaḥ smṛtisaṁbodhyaṅgam | samādhāvāsaktyanāsaktayo(ktyo)rudāsīna topekṣāsaṁbodhyaṅgam | eṣāṁ madhyāt samādhivīryasaṁbodhyaṅgasvabhāve hayakarṇakhagānane vijñeye | iti vākcakravīrāṇāṁ viśuddhiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ pañcabhiḥ prītyādibhi-ścakravegā-khaṇḍarohā-śauṇḍinī-cakravarmiṇī-suvīrā viśuddha(ddhaya)nta iti ||6||
parallel: rta rna ma dang / mkha' 'gro gdong mar shes par bya'o zhes pa gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' mo rnam par dag pa'o/ / ting nge 'dzin la mi bzod pa dang / zhen pa med pa dor ba de ni btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag go/ / 'di rnams kyi nang nas ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag gi rang bzhin ni/

sanskrit: kleśāvaraṇapratipakṣe darśanamārgamuktvā jñeyāvaraṇapratipakṣaṁ bhāvanāmārgamāha- sa cāryāṣṭāṅgo mārgaḥ | katame'ṣṭau ? samyagdṛṣṭiḥ, samyaksaṁkalpaḥ, samyagvāk, samyakkarmāntaḥ, samyagājīvaḥ, samyagavyāyāmaḥ, samyaksmṛtiḥ, samyaksamādhiśceti | tatra bhāvanāmārge jñeyāvaraṇa(ṇaṁ) niḥsvabhāvamiti yā dhīḥ sā samyagdṛṣṭiḥ, paralokāstitvadṛṣṭiśca | tad dṛṣṭayalabdho'pi nairātmyālambanaḥ samyaksaṁkalpaḥ | svadṛṣṭārthaprakāśikā sattvebhyo deśanā samyagvāk | ekāntaśubhaṁ kāyakarmāntaḥ uhyā(ṛddhyā)dibhirvinayanārthaṁ pareṣāṁ trāsanaṁ vā samyakkarmāntaḥ | dhyānāhāritvamātrayā cīvarādyanveṣaṇaṁ samyagājīvaḥ | sarveryāpatheṣu svacuttakāyavākcittavyāpāraniyojanaṁ samyagvyāyāmaḥ | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: brgyad gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ / de la sgom pa'i lam du shes bya'i sgrib pa rang bzhin med pa'o zhes pa'i blo gang yin pa de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ste/
yang gsungs pa/ spyod pa la zhugs rgyal sras dbang po yi/ / yul du sna tshogs ji lta ji ltar 'jug / /

sanskrit: tathā tathā yuktasamānatāpadairhitāya sattveṣvabhisaṁskaroti tat || iti |
parallel: zhes so/ / de lta de ltar rig pa mthu tshig gis/ / sems can phan phyir mngon par 'du byed do/ /

sanskrit: bhāvanāmārge ālambanāsaṁpramoṣaḥ samyaksmṛtiḥ | tadekāgra cittamacalitavajropamasamādhiḥ | samantapratibhāsāyā bhūmeryadantaraṁ prādurbhavati, tatrādyaistribhirmahābala[lā-cakra]-vartinī-mahāvīryā viśuddhayante | iti kāyacakrasya viśuddhiḥ | samyakkarmāntaḥ kākāsyā | samyagājīva ulūkāsyāḥ, samyagvyāyāma śvānāsyā | samyaksmṛtiḥ sūkarāsyā |
parallel: stobs chen ma dang / 'khor los sgyur ma dang / brtson 'grus chen mo rnams rnam par dag pa'o zhes sku'i 'khor lo'i rnam par dag pa'o/ / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ / yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /

sanskrit: anutpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmutpādanaṁ yamadāḍhī | utpannānāṁ kuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ saṁrakṣaṇaṁ yamadūtī | utpannānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāṁ prhāṇaṁ yadadaṁṣṭriṇī | anutpannānāmakuśalānāṁ dharmāṇāmanutpādanaṁ yamamathanī ceti ||8||
parallel: yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o zhes pa ni sgo skyong ma rnam par dag pa'o/ / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje ste ye shes kyi pad+ma'i lte ba rnam par dag pa'o/ / dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams skyed pa'i phyir la sogs pa ni gshin rje brtan ma la sogs so zhes pa ni/

sanskrit: iti saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣikadharmaviśuddhāḥ śarīragatāḥ sarvā nāḍayo devatāvarṇabhujasaṁsthānamāśritya saṁsthitāḥ ||9||
parallel: dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi lha mo rnam par dag pa'o/ / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po 'di rnams kyi rab tu dbye ba ni/ rdzas su na/
de rnams dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga'i gnas skabs kyis bsdus shing 'gyur ba yin te/
dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dran pa'i stobs sam/
dran pa'i dbang po'o/ /

sanskrit: anutpannānāṁ kuśaladharmo(rmāṇāmu)tpādinī yamadāḍhī | utpannakuśaladharmarakṣikā yamadūtī | utpannānām[a]kuśaladharmāṇāmutpādikā(ṇāṁ prahāṇaṁ) yamadaṁṣṭrī | anutpannānām [a]kuśaladharmāṇāmu(manu)tpādikā yamamathanī ceti samayamaṇḍalasya koṇadevīviśuddhiḥ ||8||
parallel: yang dag par spong ba rnams ni brtson 'grus su'o/ / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag tu'o/ /

sanskrit: ete saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣikā dharmāḥ prabhedaśaḥ | dravyatastu daśāgrāṇi pañcendriyāṇi pañcabaleṣu saṁgrahaṁ gacchanti | smṛtyupasthānāni smṛtibale prajñābale vā | ṛddhipādāḥ prajñābale vīrye vā | samyakprahāṇāni vīrye | samādhibalaṁ samādhisaṁbodhyaṅge | vīryabalaṁ vīryāṅge | pravicayasaṁbodhyaṅge prajñābalam | smṛtibalaṁ smṛtisaṁbodhyaṅge | śraddhābalaṁ
parallel: shes rab kyi stobs ni chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa byang chub kyi yan lag tu'o/ / dran pa'i stobs ni dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag tu'o/ / dad pa'i stobs ni brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag tu'o/ /

sanskrit: vīryasaṁbodhyaṅge | bodhyaṅgānāmaṣṭāṅgamārge saṁgrahaḥ | tadyathā - samyaksmṛtisamādhyoḥ(dhī) smṛtisamādhisaṁbodhyaṅge saṁgrahamupayātaḥ | vīryasaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ samyagvyāyāme | dharmapravicaya-saṁbodhyaṅgaṁ samyagdṛṣṭau | samyagvāksamyakkarmāntājīvā[ḥ] śuddhaśīlasamudācārāstrayaḥ | tathā samyagdṛṣṭiḥ, samyaksaṁkalpaḥ, samyagvyāyāmaḥ, samyaksmṛtiḥ samyaksamādhiśceti pañcabodhyaṅgebhyaḥ prastrabdhisaṁbodhyaṅgam upekṣāsaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ ceti saṁgṛhya daśavastūni bhavanti | te ca tritaye śīlasamādhiprajñābala(le) saṁgrahamupayānti | tatra samyagvākkarmāntājīvā[ḥ] śuddhiśīlasamudācārāstrayaḥ samyagvyāyāmaśuddhiśīlasamudācāraphalaṁ śīlaskandhaṁḥ, samyagdṛṣṭiḥ samyaksaṁkalpaḥ prasrabdhisaṁbodhyaṅgamupekṣāsaṁbodhyaṅgaṁ catvāraḥ prajñāskandhaḥ, samyaksmṛti[ḥ] samyaksamādhiskandha iti | śīlasamādhī ca prajñāyāmantarbhavataḥ, prajñaiva boddhrī dharmāṇāmiti nyāyāt | evaṁ saptatriṁśato daśabhirdaśānāṁ tribhistrayāṇāmekena saṁgraho veditavyaḥ |
parallel: shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ yang dag par bsdus na dngos po bcur 'gyur ba yin no/ / de rnams kyang tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi stobs te gsum po rnams su bsdus pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: etaduktaṁ bhavati - iha saptatriṁśat prāguktasaṁvidrūpā ḍākinīrūpā nāḍyaḥ śira-ādijānuparyantaṁ sthitā nābhicakrāntāścatasro dvārāṣṭake cāṣṭau madhye'vadhūtīrūpā kāyadvārasanniśritā navanāḍīmadhyanāḍīṣu daśasu saṁgrahaṁ yānti | tā daśāpi lalanāditraye, tadapi madhyanāḍayāmiti | evaṁ vajravārāhīsvabhāvā(va)yā madhyanāḍyā'vadhūtyā evaṁ sarvo'yaṁ nāḍīsaṁcayaḥ prādurbhūya tatraiva samavaśaraṇaṁ gacchati | etena saṁvṛtiparamārthadvayībhāvaḥ prakāśito bhavati | sa eva ca yuganaddhamārgasaṁcitaḥ | yathoktam -
parallel: 'dir sngar gsungs pa'i yang dag par rig pa'i rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i rnam pa'i rtsa spyi bo la sogs pa nas pus mo'i gnas kyi mthar thug pa dang lte ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi bzhi ste/ sum cu rtsa bdun te/ sgo brgyad po rnams dang / brgyad po'i dbus kyi a wa d+hU tI'i rang bzhin gyi lus kyi gnas rnams la yang dag par brten pa'i rtsa dgu dang / dbus kyi rtsa bcu rnams su yang bsdus shing son pa yin la/
ji skad du gsungs pa/ ji ltar chu 'dzin du ma ni/ / dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs can/ /

sanskrit: udbhūtā gaganābhogāt layaṁ gacchanti tatra vai ||
parallel: nam mkha'i khongs su byung nas ni/ / de nyid du ni thim 'gyur ba/
de ltar snang ba gsum po yi/ / rgyu can rang bzhin thams cad yin/ /

sanskrit: niviśya viṣayān kṛtsnaṁ praviśanti prabhāsvaram || iti |
parallel: yul rnams kun la zhugs nas kyang / / 'od gsal bar ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /

sanskrit: tathā "rūpameva śūnyatā, śūnyataiva rūpam" ityādivacanāt, "saṁvṛtivyatirekena(ṇa) paramārthasya kā kathā" iti vacanāt | etena sa(śā)ntabrahmāsāṁkhyapuruṣādivāda(di)parayūthyāḥ, nirākāravijñaptivāda(di)prabhṛtayaśca svayūthyā[ḥ] pratyākhyātā bhavanti, saṁvṛtiparamārthayorbhedaṁ prati sābhiniveśatvāt | ityalamatiprasaṅgena |
parallel: mngon par zhen pa nyid las/ zhi ba dang / tshangs pa dang / grangs can gyi skyes bu la sogs par smra ba'i gzhan gyi sde pa dang / rnam pa med par khas len zhing smra ba la sogs pa'i rang gi sde pa yang sel bar byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa spros pas chog go/ /

sanskrit: prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ | evametā nāḍīrūpā adhyātmani | bāhye tu mukhasaṁsthānāyu dhādidhāriṇyaḥ sattvāśayaviśeṣamāśritya maṇḍalacakre vyavasthitāḥ, pullīrādipīṭheṣu ca
parallel: dkyus ma brjod par bya ste/ de ltar 'di rnams nang du rtsa'i rang bzhin dang / phyi rol du ni zhal dang sku mdog dang / phyag dang / dbyibs dang / mtshon cha la sogs pa 'dzin pa ste/ sems can gyi bsam pa'i dbang la brten nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor rnam par gzhag pa dang / pul+lI ra la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/

sanskrit: kṣetrajārūpeṇānugrahaṁ kurvantyaḥ krīḍanti ramante pravicārayantīti | tathā''dhyātmanyapi tāsāṁ mukhādi vidyate | sarvā eva nāḍayo mahāsukhacakrādudbhūya vajravārijaparyante mukhāni prakaṭayanti | tadaṅkurāṇi pratyekaṁ bahūni bhujā dhātūparañjanādvarṇavatyaḥ | tathāhi nakhadantaṁ śi(si)tam, keśaroma kṛṣṇam | tvaṅmalaṁ kṛṣṇaraktam | māṁsaṁ raktavarṇam | snāyavaḥ sitāḥ | asthimālā sitā | bukkaṁ kṛṣṇam | hṛdayaṁ sitaraktam | akṣiṇī śi(si)tāśi(si)te | pittaṁ pītam | phuphphusaṁ raktam | antrāṇi cāguṇavartiśvetā[ni] | udaraṁ śyāmam | purīṣaṁ pītam | sīmantaṁ raktasitam | śleṣmā sitaḥ | pūyaṁ candragauram | lohitaṁ lohitameva | prasveda āgneyavarṇaḥ | medaḥ śi(si)tam | aśru muktāphaladhavalaḥ kheṭaḥ kṛṣṇaśi(si)taḥ | siṅghānakaṁ pītaṁ sitamiti varṇabhedaḥ | saṁsthānamāsāṁ kuṭilarūpatayā vāmadakṣiṇapracāreṇa sthitamālīḍhādirūpeṇa svabhāvasiddhaḥ (ddham) | āyudhamāsāṁ kartikapālaviśuddhayā vikalpamalabhedakasahaja svabhāvaṁ vijñeyam | atra ślokāḥ -
parallel: mkhris pa ni ser po dang / glo ba ni dmar po dang / rgyu ma dang gnye ma ni dkar po dang / lto ba ni sngo bsangs dang / bshang ba ni ser po dang / mtshams mtha' ni dmar dkar dang / bad kan ni dkar po dang / rnag ni zla ba ltar dkar ser dang / khrag ni dmar po dang / rdul ni me'i kha dog dang / tshil bu ni dkar po dang / mchi ma ni mu tig gi 'bras bu ltar dkar ba dang / mchil ma ni gnag cing dkar ba dang / ngar snabs ni ser po dang dkar po'o zhes pa ni kha dog gi dbye ba'o/ / 'di rnams kyi dbyibs ni/ 'khyog po'i gzugs nyid kyis g.yon dang g.yas su rab tu rgyu bas gnas pa ste/
bcad pa/ rnam rtog dri ma rnam gcod pa'i/ / yang dag myong pa'i bdag nyid thob/ /
gzung dang 'dzin las nges par grol/ / lhan cig skyes dkar nges pa'o/ /
reg pa tsam gyis 'jig rten la/ / sangs rgyas 'bras bu nyid sbyin byed/ /
mkha' 'gro ma sogs bcur bshad pa'i/ / 'khor lor son slad rtog pa ni/ /
dus kun du ni 'gro la gnas/ / mi phyed la sogs rang bzhin gyis/ /
khams kyi rang bzhin dpa' bo che/ / nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang dag ldan/ /
rang lus dbus son rtsa rnams ni/ / dpa' mo yin na gal te 'dir/ /
ji ltar rmongs shing 'khrul par gyur/ / pul+lI ra sogs gnas rigs na/ /
phyi rol yongs su dor 'gyur te/ / sgom pa de ltar 'khrul pa yin/ /
nang gi rnal 'byor ldan pa las/ / rnal 'byor pa rnams thar pa 'thob/ /

sanskrit: iti vasantatilakāyāṁ niṣpannakramasādhanopāyikāyāṁ rahasyadīpikāyāṁ ṭīkāyāṁ saptamanirdeśe vistaravyākhyā ||7||
parallel: zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/ rgyas par bstan pa bdun pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /

sanskrit: athānyatamasya tathāgatakāyasya maṇḍalahomayoga japabhāvanādividhikriyāṁ sabāhyādhyātmarūpeṇa saṁpravakṣyāmi ||1||
parallel: da ni phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor dang / mchod sbyin dang / bzlas pa dang / sbyin sreg la sogs pa nang du gzhag pa de rnams rab tu gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ de nas gang yang rung zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/
'di rnams kyang sngar brjod pa nyid kyi phyir go sla'o/ /
de la lus kho na dkyil 'khor du rtogs par bya ste/
lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya bar 'brel lo/ /
ji lta bu zhe na/

sanskrit: idānīṁ bāhyamaṇḍalayogajāpahomādīnadhyātmanyavasthitān prakaṭayitumathānya-tamasyetyādinā''ha | etacca subodham, prāyuktatvāt | tatra śarīrameva maṇḍalaṁ pratipādyate | dehamaṇḍalamiti saṁbandhaḥ ||1||
parallel: byang chub che zhes bya ba la sogs pa ste/

sanskrit: kīdṛśam ? saptatriṁśadityādi | saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣikadharmaviśuddhayā vyavasthitā yā etā nāḍyastadrūpeṇaiva jñānacittavākkāyasamayacakrasthā ḍākinyādayo'vasthitā ityādheyamaṇḍalaviśuddhimāha | tat kasya hetoḥ ? iha nirvikalpanirālambanirāvaraṇasvabhāvā ḍākinya ityucyante,
parallel: byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rnam par dag pa rnam par gzhag pa'i rtsa gang yin pa 'di rnams ni rnam pa de nyid kyis ye shes dang / thugs dang gsung dang sku dang dam tshig gi 'khor lor gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rnams su rnam par gzhag go zhes brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par dag pa gsungs pa yin no/ / de su'i rgyu yin zhe na/ 'di ni rnam par rtog pa med cing dmigs pa med pa sgrib pa med pa'i rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i yin no zhes brjod par bya ste/

sanskrit: ḍe ḍai) vaihāyasi gaga(ma)ne buddho dhātuḥ prakalpitaḥ |
parallel: DI ni nam mkhar 'gro ba ste/ sangs rgyas dbyings su rab tu brtags/ /
nam mkha' kun rgyu'i dngos grub rnams/ / mkha' 'gro ma zhes brjod par bya/ /

sanskrit: iti vacanāt | pañcajñānamahānabhasi carantyaśca nāḍyastasmāttā eva ḍākinya ityucyante, tatsparśādubhayoravikalpatattvodayāt ||2||
parallel: ye shes lnga'i nam mkha' chen po la rgyu ba ni rtsa rnams te/ de'i phyir de nyid ni mkha' 'gro ma zhes brjod par bya ste/ de la reg pa las gnyis ka la rnam par mi rtog pa'i de kho na nyid 'char ba'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: ādheyamuktvā''dhāramaṇḍalamāha - śarīraṁ maṇḍalamityādinā | tatra śarīrameva maṇḍalam, cittavākkāyamaṇḍalanāḍīdhāturūpāṇāṁ yoginīvīrāṇāmāśrayatvāt | ata eva
parallel: brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs nas/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba la sogs pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsungs te/ de la lus kho na dkyil 'khor te/

de nyid kyi phyir nyams dga' ba ste/ phyi rol gyi rdul tshon la sogs pa la ltos pa med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor la sgo bzhi yod pa ji lta ba bzhin du nang du yang yin no zhes bstan pa'i phyir bshad pa/
mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dag dang / khar brjod pa rnams so/ / yang na ji skad gsungs pa'i zhes pa/ sngar gsungs pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi sgo gsum po rnams kyi cha shas las bzhir 'gyur te/
g.yon dang g.yas kyi rtsa ni thugs kyi sgo ste dang po'o/ /
ji ltar phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa yin pa de bzhin du mnyam pa'i dngos pos lus kyi dkyil 'khor yang gru bzhir shes par bya'o/ / gang las she na/
'di ni lus 'di ji lta ba bzhin te/
rkang pa'i 'og nas gtsug tor gyi mthar tshad dang ldan pa de bzhin du lag pa brkyang pa na yang tshad de kho na'o/ /

sanskrit: ramyam, bāhyarajoraṅgādyanapekṣaṇāt | bāhyamaṇḍalaṁ caturdvāraṁ yathā''dhyātmamapīti darśayannāha | tatra dehamaṇḍale catvāri dvārāṇi netraśrotranāsikāmukhākhyāni, athavā yathoditamiti yathā prāguktāni tāni dvārāṇi vibhāgena catvāri bhavanti | vāmadakṣiṇanāḍyāṁ cittadvāraṁ prathamam | ātmapīṭhādīni catvāri dvitīyaṁ vāgdvāram | navātmakaṁ kāyadvāramadhaūrdhvabhedād dvidhā | evaṁ caturvāram | pratidvidvistambhayuktatvādaṣṭastambham | adhyātmani cakṣurādināḍīstambhairyuktam | bāhyamaṇḍalaṁ yathā caturasraṁ tathā samabhāvena dehamaṇḍalamapi caturasraṁ jñeyam | kutaḥ samatvamasya ? yathāyaṁ kāyaḥ pādādhastāduṣṇīṣāntaṁ pramāṇavāṁstathā prasāritabāhurapi tatpramāṇa eva | bāhyamaṇḍalaṁ cittavākkāyamaṇḍalātmakaṁ tricakraṁ caturviśatparam, tathā'dhyātmanyapi cittavākkāyanāḍyādhārabhūta-śiraādijānuparyantacaturviṁśatipīṭhādhyātmikacakratrayopetam ||3-4||
parallel: phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor ni thugs dang gsung dang sku'i bdag nyid can gyi 'khor lo gsum la nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste gzhan no/ / de bzhin du nang du yang thugs dang gsung dang sku'i rtsa rnams kyi rten du gyur pa spyi bo la sogs pa nas phyin pa'i mthar thug pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi 'khor lo gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /

sanskrit: girimastakakiñjalka ityādinoddeśaḥ | sa ca vāyvādimaṇḍalacatuṣṭayoparisthita-sumeruśikharārūḍhaviśvapadmākhyayā pratipādyamānaḥ | tathaivādhyātmanyapi dehamaṇḍalamaṇḍalāṅkitaṁ gurūdeśādadhigantavyam ||5||
parallel: mgo bo'i ri bo'i ze'u 'bru la/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni mdor bstan pa ste/ de yang rlung la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po'i steng du gnas pa'i ri rab kyi rtse mo la gnas pa'i sna tshogs pad+mar bshad cing khong du chud par bya bzhin pa de kho na bzhin du nang du yang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan ma ni/

sanskrit: nirdeśamāha - sthitaḥ pādatale vāyurityārabhya vyaktamavyaktarūpata ityantena maṇḍalāṅkitatvamucyate | pādatale pādādhastādvāyuḥ sthitaḥ | dhanurākāratvādviśiṣṭārambhatvāt sa eva vairambhaḥ | svārthe'ṇ | vaikṛtavat pādaviharaṇātmikā ca kriyā vairambha
parallel: der rlung gnas pa ste gzhu'i rnam pa nyid kyis khyad par du 'phags pa las brtsams pa nyid kyi phyir de nyid bai ram+b+ha'o/ / rang gi don la an te bai kri ta lta bu'o/ / rkang pa'i gnas kyi bdag nyid can gyi bya ba ni be ram+b+ha zhes brjod par bya ste/

der bud med dang skyes pa dag gi/ rak+ta dang nor bu grol ba nyid las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa'i rang bzhin gyis 'bar ba rnam par gnas so/ / de'i steng du sngags kyi phreng ba zlum po zhu zhing sbyor ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor te/
lto ba'i phyogs su rang bzhin gyis gnas so/ / de'i steng du snying gar gru bzhi pa gser lta bu'i sa'i dkyil 'khor yod de/ de'i steng gang yin pa mgrin pa'i cha ni/
rnam grangs gzhan du na sgal tshigs te/ de nyid ni ri rab tu shes par bya ste/

mig la sogs pa'i rtse mo brgyad dang ldan zhing / de'i 'dab ma bzhi po rin po che'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ / ri rab gang yin pa 'di las mgo bo'i dbus der mi phyed ma la sogs pa'i rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis po de nyid ni sna tshogs pad+mar te/

bcom ldan 'das kyi gdan du shes par bya'o/ / de'i nang du A li dang kA li dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi bdag nyid can byang chub kyi sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi gong bu klad pa nyid ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/
bcom ldan 'das kyi khyad par gyi gdan no/ /
gdan rnams rang bzhin gyis grub pa ni bye brag gi rgyud kha cig tu ma gsungs par rtogs par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: tasya madhye tu haṁkāro bindurūpo hyanāhataḥ ||10||
parallel: rnam par dag pa'i de kho na nyid ni thams cad kyi tshe smra bar bya ba ma yin pa'i de kho na nyid yin pa'i phyir/

sanskrit: ityucyate | etena vāyumaṇḍalasya kāritraṁ sanniveśaścoktaḥ | tadupari yo'yaṁ trikaṭipradeśaḥ kaṭibhāgastatra strīpuṁsayoragnimaṇḍalaṁ trikoṇaṁ svabhāvato raktamaṇiyuktatvādujjvalaṁ vyavasthitam | tadupari vartulamantrāvalīdravatāyogādvāruṇamaṇḍalamudaradeśe svabhāvato vyavasthitam | tadupari hṛdaye cakṣuṣi(vakṣasi) caturasraṁ phala(kana) kasadṛśaṁ pṛthivīmaṇḍalamāste | ya eṣa tadupari grīvābhāgaḥ kaṅkālāparaparyāyaḥ sa eva merurjñātavyaḥ, cakṣurādyaṣṭaśṛṅgopetaḥ, taddalacatuṣṭayaratnamayatvāt | tasya meroryadetacchirastanmadhye yā abhedyādyā dvātriṁśannāḍayasta(stā) eva viśvapadmaṁ bhagavata āsanaṁ vijñeyam | tadantarālikālisvaravyañjanātmadvātriṁśadbodhicittapiṇḍitamustuluṅgameva candramaṇḍalaṁ bhagavato viśeṣāsanam | nahyāsanānāṁ svabhāvasiddhaḥ kaścidviśeṣastantreṣu pratipādyate, viśuddhitattvasya sarvadā'vivakṣitatvāt | pudgalādhimuktivasā(śā)t prabheda āsanānām | ata eva tricakrasthavīrayoginīnāṁ kvaciccandramaṇḍalāsanāni, kvacit sūryāsanānīti pratipādayanti ||6-9 1/2||
parallel: gang zag gi mos pa'i dbang las gdan rnams su rab tu phye ba yin no/ / de nyid kyi phyir 'khor lo gsum du gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la kha cig tu zla ba'i gdan dang / kha cig tu nyi ma'i gdan no zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ / de yi dbus su zhes pa la sogs pa la/ /
de yi ste klad pa'i dbus su gzhom du med cing 'gyur ba med pa haM gi yi ge ste/

de ni brtan pa dang / g.yo ba'i bdag nyid dngos po thams cad du 'gyur ba nyid kyi phyir rdzogs shing rab tu gnas pa'i gnas rnams kyi de nyid sa bon gyi gzugs kyis gsal zhing / don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi gzugs kyis ni mi gsal ba'o/ / de nyid kyi phyir/
lus can rnams kyi lus ni/ dang po de kho na las skyes pa yin te/
bdud rtsi kho na zhu bzhin pa rnam par gnas pa yin no/ /
de nyid ni bcom ldan 'das he ru ka'i rang bzhin te/

sanskrit: sampūrṇaṁ maṇḍalaṁ tena bhavatyeva na saṁśayaḥ ||13||
parallel: chos nyid yin pa nyid kyis chos rnams la khyab pa na/

sanskrit: tasya madhya ityādi | tasya mastiṣkasya madhye'nāhatākṣaro haṁkāraḥ sravadamṛta-prasaratvād bindurvedanaśīlo bindurityucyate | sa sarveṣāṁ sthiracalātmanāṁ bhāvānāṁ kāraṇabhūtatvāt pūrṇapratiṣṭhāsthānam | ata eva bījarūpeṇa vyaktam, pāramārthikabodhicittarūpeṇāvyaktam | tata eva sarveṣāmapadaikapadadvipadacatuṣpada bahupadānāmaṇḍajasvedaja-jarāyujopapādukānāṁ tiryakpretanārakadevāsuramanuṣyāṇāṁ dehināṁ deha ādita evotpanno mātṛ pitṛsamāpattivaśādanyadāsyāmṛtameva sravannavasthitam | sa bhagavato herukasya svarūpam, dharmatayaiva sarvadharmāṇāṁ vyāpteḥ, buddhotpādānutpāde'pi tasyā[sya] sthitatvāt, ādyanutpannatvāt sarvadharmāṇāṁ pratītyotpannatvādutpādābhāvād ata eva nirodhāsiddheḥ |
parallel: sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba na yang de gnas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / chos thams cad ni/ gdod ma nas ma skyes pa nyid kyi phyir rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin pa nyid kyis/
'byung ba'i dngos po 'di rnams nyid kyis 'gog pa grub pa yin te/ 'dir ni 'ga' yang skye ba med/ / 'ga' yang 'chi ba yod min te/ /
sems kyi rang bzhin rnam pa ni/ / 'khor bar gnas par shes par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: iti vacanāt | utpādanirodhavikalpe'pi vastubhāve nirālambaḥ | pratibhāsamānālambe'pi tasya māyopamatvāt sarvameva vastujātamavācyamaniruddhamanutpādaṁ vijñeyamiti ||10-12||
parallel: skye ba dang 'gag pa'i rnam par rtog pa yang dngos po nyid la dmigs pa ma yin la/ snang ba la dmigs pa yang sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa nyid kyi phyir/ dngos po thams cad ni skyes par smra bar mi bya ste/

sanskrit: prajñopāyasamāpattimāha- tenaiva mahāsukhacakrasthena svadehe maṇḍalārūḍhe vā maṇḍalīsvarūpajñānavahnisantoṣakāriṇā nādo nirmāṇacakrakarṇikāsthitā kārā[d]
parallel: ma skyes shing ma 'gag par shes par bya'o/ / thabs dang shes rab snyoms par 'jug pa gsungs pa/ de nyid kyis te bde ba chen po'i 'khor los rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du'am/
dkyil 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gyi ye shes kyi me dga' bar byed pas na'o/ /

sanskrit: tad gṛhṇāti lātīti śarīraṁ maṇḍalaṁ matam ||14||
parallel: nA da ni sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i ze'u 'brur gnas pa'i a yig ste/ /

sanskrit: bhidyate | svasthānāccālyasvarūpagatasudhāta[ra]ṅgapāśa(na)lampaṭatayā daṇḍabhaṅgaṁ kārayitvonmūlyata ityarthaḥ | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung ba la sred pa nyid kyi phyir 'khyog por byas nas rtsa ba nas 'byin par byed do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / yang smras pa/ 'byed par byed pa ni rang gi gnas las g.yo ba'i rang bzhin nyid kyis song ste/
nA da yi ge kun gyi ste/ /
byed pa gcig nyid thob pa na/ / gang phyir ngag tshig rab dbye bas/ / lte ba'i phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /
rlung dang nye rlung 'khor lo yi/ / ldang sogs bya ba la brten nas/ /
rengs pa la sogs rang bzhin gyis/ / 'jug cing gzhan pa nyid la brten/ /
dbu ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa bcu'i/ / de nyid brten par brjod par bya/ /
bsrub bya srub byed sbyor ba las/ / de ni bde chen byed pa'o/ /
gyen du 'bar ba'i rnal 'byor gyis/ / phung sogs dbang po sreg par byed/ /
bskal pa'i me gzugs nyid 'di ni/ / kun gyi sdud dang byed po yin/ /
zla ba thig le'i rang bzhin gyis/ / 'gro ba dga' bar byed pa po/ /
bde chen 'khor lo chen por ni/ / gzhom med yi ge'i gzugs 'chang ba/ /
kha ba'i 'od dang mtshungs pa yi/ / byang chub sems las byung ba'i 'od/ /
spros te rin chen 'khor lo'i mthar/ / 'dzag par byed cing rnam par gnas/ /

sanskrit: sa eva prāṇināṁ prāṇaḥ sa eva paramākṣaraḥ |
parallel: de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog / de nyid mchog gi yi ge ste/ /
de nyid kun la khyab ste 'di/ / lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /
'dis ni nA da 'phel byed de/ / dga' ba'i gnas kyi cha ru 'gyur/ /
de nyid dpyid kyi thig le yi/ / rnal 'byor du ni brjod par bya/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: tasmāttenaiva maṇḍalaṁ catuṣpīṭhātmakaṁ vā nirmāṇādimaṇḍalaṁ sampūrṇamākhyāyitaṁ bhavati | bahirapi maṇḍalādhipatinā svasvābhena maṇḍalaṁ paripūrṇaṁ bhavati, nānyathā ||13||
parallel: sprul pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs par bshad par gyur pa yin te/ phyi rol du yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rang 'dra dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba yin gyi/ gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /
de nyid dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba la sogs pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nges pa'i tshig gsungs te/

snying po ste rtsa dang khams dang dpyid dang thig le'i rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' bo dang dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'i rang bzhin yang dag par 'dzin pa'i phyir na/ lus kho na dkyil 'khor du brjod par bya'o/ / maN+Da ni nye ba'i tshig ste/
len pa'i don las/
la ti la Da'i rkyen byas pa las so/ /
rtsa chen sum cu rtsa bdun zhes bya ba la sogs pas nang gi bdag nyid kyi rnam par dag pa gsungs te/
byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun po gang yin pa 'di rnams ni rig pa dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin te/

sanskrit: ādhāramaṇḍalaniruktimāha - tadeva maṇḍalamityādinā | sārasya nāḍīdhātu-vasantatilakāsvabhāvaḍākinīvīraśrīherukavajravārāhīmayasyādheyamaṇḍalasya saṁgrahāt śarīrameva maṇḍalamucyate | maṇḍāya yadā (maṇḍopapadād) dānārthāllāte(teḥ) pratyayavidhānāt ||14||
parallel: de rnam par dag pa las/ sngar gsungs pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo kho na dkyil 'khor ro/ /

sanskrit: ādhyātmikaviśuddhimāha - saptatriṁśadityādinā | ya ete saptatriṁśadbodhipākṣikā dharmāḥ saṁvidrūpāstadviśuddhayā prāguktanāḍīcakrameva maṇḍalam | vīraviśuddhimāha - bodhicittamityādinā | caturviṁśatiryāni bodhicittaspandanāni dhāturūpāṇi tadevānarghatvānmaṇḍasya devīcakrasya maṇḍalaṁ tatsāragrāhakaṁ vīramaṇḍalaṁ [ca] jñeyam ||15||
parallel: byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba la sogs pas dpa' bo'i rnam par dag pa gsungs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa'i khams kyi rang bzhin nyi shu rtsa bzhi po de nyid ni rin thang med pa nyid kyi phyir/ rin po che ste lha mo'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /

sanskrit: nirmitamaṇḍalaṁ dvidhā-bāhyaṁ caturasrādi, ābhyantaraṁ garbhamaṇḍalaṁ tricakrādi | iha tu bāhyaṁ śiraādi jālandharādi, ābhyantaraṁ nāḍīdhātumayam | ata eva na mamaikasyaitanmaṇḍalamapi tu viśvasyāsya pañcagatikasyāpyetanmaṇḍalaṁ jñeyam | ata āha-vyāpya viśvaṁ vyāvasthitam | api ca, bāhyamaṇḍale rūpaśabdādibhiḥ pūjābhirabhyantaramaṇḍalaṁ pūjyate | abhyantaratu kalaśakapālodare pañcāmṛtāni sukhapūjārthaṁ vidyante | iha tu bāhye rūpādibhiḥ pañcakāmaguṇairindriyadvārāṇi pūjyante | āntare siddhāni svabhāvasiddhāni dravyāni(ṇi) pañcavyomabhūtāni dravyāni(ṇi) sthitāni | tadarthamāha - bāhyaṁ tu rūpaśabdādi ityādi | bāhyaṁ sthūlasūkṣmasamayadānāya śiṣyebhyo darśyate | iha tu sthūlasūkṣma -
parallel: phyi rol du ni gru bzhi pa la sogs pa yin la/ / nang du snying ga'i dkyil 'khor ni 'khor lo gsum la sogs pa'o/ / 'dir phyi rol du spyi bo la sogs pa ni dzA lan+d+ha ra la sogs pa yin la/
nang du ni rtsa dang khams kyi rang bzhin no/ /
dkyil 'khor 'di rnams kyang 'di nyid gcig pu'i ma yin gyi/
sna tshogs pa'i 'gro ba lnga po 'di rnams kyang de'i dkyil 'khor du shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: śrāvakāṇāṁ ca buddhānāṁ pratyekānāṁ tathaiva ca ||19||
parallel: de gsungs pa ni/
sna tshogs khyab cing rnam par gnas/ / zhes pa'o/ / yang na phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor du gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa rnams kyis te mchod pa de rnams kyis nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod par bya'o/ /

nang du bum pa ni ka pA la'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga rnams bde ba'i mchod pa'i slad du rig par bya'o/ / 'dir phyi rol du gzugs la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis dbang po'i sgo rnams mchod par bya la/

sanskrit: prabhedabhinnena bodhicittena vajradhareṇa sarvajagad buddhatvasādhakena buddhatvaṁ bodhisattvatvaṁ ca samayaṁ dātumuditena hetunā tasmādeva maṇḍalāt tatpadaṁ prāpyate ||16-17||
parallel: 'dir ni sbom po dang phra mo'i dbye bas tha dad pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje 'dzin pas/ 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas nyid du sgrub par byed pas na/ sangs rgyas nyid dang byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyang dam tshig ste sbyin zhing shar ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkyil 'khor 'di kho na las go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /

sanskrit: tadarthamāha - sthūlasūkṣma prabhedenetyāha(di) | tatra sthūlāścaturviṁśatidhātavaḥ | sūkṣmaṁ bodhicittam | athavā sthūlā navadvāranirgatā malā dra(drā)vyāḥ, sūkṣmaṁ bodhihṛdayaṁ drāvakaḥ (kam) | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: don 'di ni sbom po dang phra ba la brten nas gsungs pa yin te/ de la sbom po ni khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi rnams dang / phra ba ni byang chub kyi sems so/ / yang na sbom po ni sgo las byung ba'i dri ma'i rdzas rnams dang / phra mo ni byang chub kyi snying po zhu bar byed pa'o/ /
yang gsung ba/ sbom dang phra ba'i rab dbye bas/ / dngos por rtogs pa rnam pa gnyis/ /
rags pa'i rdzas ni rnam dgu ste/ / phra mo'i tshil bu grub pa'i rdzas/ /
gzhan pa zhu byed rdzas dbye bas/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: bāhyamaṇḍalamadhyanāyakaḥ śrāvakapratyekabuddhasamyaksaṁbuddhabrahmādinirmāṇaṁ karoti sattvārtham | āntare tu śravantīti śrāvakā navadvārāṇi | cakṣurādivijñānāni pratyekabuddhāḥ, asaṁskṛtatvāt | ānandādayaḥ samyaksaṁbuddhāḥ | kāyavākcittāni brahmādayaḥ | ete sarva etasmādeva maṇḍalānniṣpadyanta iti maṇḍalanirṇayaḥ ||18-19 1/2||
parallel: phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos sems can gyi don du nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa sprul par byed la/ nang du ni 'dzag par byed do zhes pas sgo dgu po rnams ni/ nyan thos dang mig la sogs pa'i sgo rnams ni rang sangs rgyas te/

sanskrit: bāhyādhyātmikā(kaṁ) homamāha - ābhyantaraistu śukrādyairityādi | iha bāhye tilāhutibhirācāryaiḥ samayāgnimukhena jñānāgnistarpyate, tathaiva rūpādiviṣayaiḥ pratyāhāradhyānābhyāṁ śukrādyaiśca samāpattijanitaiḥ pañcaskandhādibuddhatatsutamaṇḍalaṁ tarpyate | prajñāgnau caṇḍālījvalana tīkṣṇatvād dāhojjvale homo'sau vijñeyaḥ ||20-20 1/2||
parallel: 'dus ma byas pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /

sanskrit: havibhiḥ kriyate homaḥ prajñāgnau tu mahojjvale |
parallel: dga' ba la sogs pa rnams ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin la/
lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni tshangs pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /
'di rnams thams cad dkyil 'khor de nyid las rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes pa dkyil 'khor gyi nges pa'o/ / nang gi khu ba la sogs dang / /

sanskrit: yoga[ḥ] pūjā samākhyātā tena te pūjitā yataḥ ||22||
parallel: zhes bya ba la sogs pas phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can gyi sbyin sreg gsungs te/
'dir phyi
shes rab kyi me ni gtum mo ste/
'bar zhing rno ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /
bsreg cing 'bar ba'i phyir 'di ni sbyin sreg tu shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: pūjāmāha - ṣaḍāyatanadhātūnāmityādi | iha prāguktena nyāyena pañcaskandhāḥ pañcaḍākāḥ ṣaḍāyatanāni ṣaṭcakravartinaḥ khaṇḍakapālādyāḥ | dhātavaścatasro jñānadevyaḥ | ḍākinyaḥ ṣaṭtriṁśannāḍyaḥ | evameṣāṁ devatādirūpiṇāṁ prajñopāyādvayayogena yo yogaḥ, sā pūjā vijñeyā | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: de ltar lha la sogs pa'i gzugs can 'di rnams kyi shes rab dang thabs gnyis po sbyor ba las mchod sbyin gang yin pa de ni mchod par shes par bya'o/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pas mchod pa gsungs te/ 'dir sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis phung po la rnams ni mkha' 'gro lnga dang / skye mched drug ni 'khor los sgyur ba drug dang / khams rnams ni thod pa'i dum bu la sogs pa bzhi rnams dang / rtsa sum cu rtsa drug rnams ni ye shes kyi lha mo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams so/ /
yang gsungs pa/ rang bzhin med pa'i gnas bsgoms pas/ / lha yi gzugs su bsgom de ni/ /

sanskrit: sā matā mahatī pūjā sarvabuddhaprasādhanī || iti |
parallel: mchod pa chen po'i mchod pa ste/ / sangs rgyas kun gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: eta evāja - tena te pūjitā yata iti ||21-22||
parallel: 'di nyid ni/ de yis de rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ / zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: prāguktāhomasyāṅgānyāha - śiraḥkapālametattu ityādi | yadetacchiraḥ kapālaṁ mūrdhni kapālam, tadeva candrājyahaviṣa ādhārabhūtatvāddhavirbhājanaṁ nānyat | tathā vāmadakṣiṇage lalanārasane adhodravyavāhitvādyathākramaṁ sruksruvau jñeuau | nirmāṇacakre nābhimaṇḍalaṁ vahnikuṇḍam, tatr haviṣaḥ pātāt | manthamanthānasaṁyogāt karmaṇo yatra tadbhūto brahmāgnistattvamayo jvalanaḥ sa trikaṭe tadadho guhye trikoṇe jvalannāste, svabhāveneti vākyaśeṣaḥ | bahirapi brahmāgniḥ śāntike śasyate | sa cāraṇinirmathanādudbhavatīti ||23-24||
parallel: zhes bya ba la sogs pas sngar bshad pa'i sbyin sreg gi yan lag rnams gsungs te/ spyi bo'i thod pa gang yin pa 'di rnams ni mgo bo'i thod pa ste/ de nyid zla ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams kyi gzhir gyur pa nyid kyi phyir bsreg rdzas kyi snod yin gyi gzhan ni ma yin no/ /

sanskrit: nādaṁ tu (dastu) mantra ityukto jāpa mā(ā)vartanaṁ bhavet |
parallel: sbyin sreg brjod nas/ nA da sngags zhes brjod par bya/ /
zhes bya ba la sogs pas bzlas pa gsungs te/
gang 'di ni sngar gsungs pa'i lte ba'i gnas las 'thon pa'i phyir srog gi rlung ste/

sanskrit: homamabhidhāya jāpamāha - nādasta mantra ityukta ityādi | yo'yaṁ prāgukto nābhideśāduccāraṇāt prāṇavāyuḥ, sa eva sarva mantrahetutvānmantra ityucyate | tasyaiva praveśādikrameṇa yadāvartanaṁ sa jāpa ucyate | etena prakṛtijāpo'yaṁ sarvalokasādhāraṇa uktaḥ |
parallel: de nyid kyi phyir rang bzhin gyis bzlas pa 'di ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi thun mong bar gsungs so/ / de nyid ni sngags thams cad kyi rgyu yin pa nyid kyi phyir sngags zhes brjod par bya'o/ / de nyid kyi 'jug pa la sogs pa'i rim pa gang gi tshe 'khor mor yin pa de ni bzlas pa zhes brjod par bya ste/
yang gsungs pa/ / gang yang khams gsum sems can rnams/ srog dang rtsol ba la brten nas/ /
gsang sngags rgyal po zlos bzhin du/ / mi shes bsam gtan bsam bya spangs/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: jāpamuktvā bhāvanāmāha - bhāvanāpratibhāsastvityādi | bāhye kāyavākcittānyālambya yogināṁ pratibhāsate | adhyātmani nirmāṇādicaturmaṇḍaleṣu mudrānikāyādipratibhāsa eva bhāvanā | niḥsvabhāvatālambanaṁ vā maṇḍalādvayayogaḥ, saiva bhāvanā |
parallel: phyi rol du ni sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams la dmigs nas rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi so sor snang ba ste nang du ni/ sprul pa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhir phyag rgya'i tshogs la sogs pa so sor snang ba de nyid bsgom pa ste/ rang bzhin med pa'i phyir dmigs pa med pa'am/

sanskrit: abhāve bhāvanā bhāvo bhāvanā naiva bhāvanā |
parallel: yang gsungs pa/ dngos po med la bsgom pa'i dngos/ / bsgom pa bsgom pa min pa nyid/ /

sanskrit: iti bhāvo na bhāvaḥ syād bhāvanāto na labhyate ||25||
parallel: de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ / bsgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: upasaṁhāramāha - sahajarūpametattu jinānāṁ maṇḍalādi miti | jinānāṁ sarvasattvānāmetanmaṇḍalādikaṁ maṇḍalahoma yāgajāpabhāvanākhyaṁ sahajarūpaṁ svabhāvasthitaṁ na tu kṛtrimam | kṛtrimaṁ tu sahajapravṛttyarthameva deśitamiti sarvasattvā vajradharā eveti | eṣāṁ maṇḍalānāṁ bāhyā ācāryādhiṣṭhitā, adhyātmani tu ka ityāśaṅkayāha - ācāryaścittarājastu maṇḍalādhyakṣarūpata iti | yo'yaṁ cittavajradharaḥ svasaṁvedyasvarūpatvena
parallel: bcos ma ni lhan cig skyes pa la bzhugs pa'i don kho na bstan pa yin te/ sems can thams cad ni rdo rje 'chang nyid do zhes pa'o/ / dkyil 'khor 'di rnams phyi rol du slob dpon gyis byin gyis brlabs pa yin na nang du su zhig gis zhes dogs pa la/
dkyil 'khor dbang po'i gzugs kyis ni/ / sems kyi rgyal po slob dpon no/ / zhes bya ba gsungs te/
de nyid ni slob dpon no/ / rang rig pa'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir/ sems kyi rdo rje 'chang gang yin pa de ni sngar gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / mi phyed pa las khong du chud par bya ste/
'di nyid/ dkyil 'khor dbang po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /
zhes bya bas gsungs pa yin te/

sanskrit: prāguktamaṇḍalānyabhedena budhyate sa evācāryaḥ | tat savidve(śe)ṣācaraṇādācārya ityucyate | ata evāha - maṇḍalādhyakṣarūpata iti | atrādiśabdo lupto draṣṭavyaḥ | atideśamāha - sarvamatraiva boddhavyaṁ maṇḍalādi yathoditamiti | yadihānuktamaṇḍalādīni maṇḍalopa -
parallel: 'dir la sogs pa'i sgra phyis par blta bar bya'o/ / shin tu bstan pa gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa ji skad du gsungs pa thams cad ni 'di nyid du khong du chud par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: karaṇāni | sūtrarā(ra)jobhūparigrahāvāhanasthāpanavisarjanamaṇḍalasādhanābhiṣekasnāna-baliprabhṛtayastatraiva dehamaṇḍale boddhavyāḥ, jñātavyā iti yāvat | tathāhi - madhyanāḍī sūtreṇa(tram), raktaśukraviṇmūtrādīni maṇḍalarajāṁsi, catuviṁśatipīṭhasaṁgrāhidaśanāḍyo bhūmayaḥ, tāsāṁ layādikrameṇa paribhrama(graha)ṇaṁ bhūparigrahaḥ, praveśādikrameṇāvāhanādīni, jñānolyā maṇḍalasādhanam, vajramaṇikalaśāt padmāsanasthadevīdevatācakrasya dhārāsāreṇābhiṣekamatra, iyaṁ(yan)niṣyandānā(nāṁ) rasanāsvādo baliriti ||26||
parallel: gal te 'dir gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnams ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi yo byad rnams dang / thig dang / rdul tshon dang / sa yongs su gzung ba dang / spyan drangs pa dang / bzhugs su gsol ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba dang / dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang / mngon par dbang bskur ba dang / khrus dang / gtor ma la sogs pa rnams te/ de rnams nyid ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor du khong du chud par bya zhing /
shes par bya zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /
zhes rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las rgyas par bstan pa brgyad pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / /
gang gong du sngags bzlas par gsungs pa'i sngags 'di ni ci zhig ce na/ de lta bu khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyas par bstan pa dgu pa gsungs te/
gang yang rung zhes bya ba ni/
gang zhig su yang rung ba'i sems can gyis rang bzhin gyis grub ba'i sngags ni btu ba ste/
de las sngags thams cad rab tu skye'o zhes khong du chud par bya'o/ /
de'i dbus kyi lte ba la a yig go/ / de la phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa bris te/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ri mo byas nas/

'dab ma rnams la brgyad brgyad kyi dbye bas A li dang kA li bkod pa'i bzhi pa dang / lnga pa la sogs pa'i rim gyis lnga pa'i lnga pa la sogs pa'i spros pas rtsa ba'i sngags btu bar bya'o/ / nang du ni gru gsum pa gang yin pa 'di rnams ni/

sanskrit: yaḥ prāgukto mantrajāpaḥ, ko'sau mantra iti, tamu(du)ddhāraṁ pratipādayitumathetyādinā navamaṁ nirdeśamāha - anyatamasyeti | yasya kasyacit sattvasya svabhāvasiddho yo mantrastasyoddhāraṁ tataḥ sarvamantrāṇāṁ prabhava iti pratipādyate ||1||
parallel: rtsa ba'i dbus kyi rtsa ba brgyad po A li dang kA li dang bcas pa'i dbus su gnas pa'i a yig ni bcom ldan 'das yi ge dang tshig dang ngag ma lus pa dang ngag chen po'i gzugs kyis rnam par gnas pa de nyid las yi ge rnams gsal bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyang tshig skyes par byed pa yin la/

sanskrit: tatra bāhye trikoṇaṁ maṇḍalaṁ likhitvā tada(na?)ntareṣvaṣṭadalaṁ kamalaṁ citrayitvā tanmadhyakarṇikāyāmakāraṁ daleṣvaṣṭāṣṭabhedenālikālī vinyasya "caturthasya tu pañcamam" ityādinā krameṇa "pañcamasya tu pañcamam" ityādinā ca prapañcena mūlamantrādīnuddhārayet | adhyātmani tu yadetattrikoṇaṁ mūlapīṭhamadhyanāḍyaṣṭakasahitam, tatra vargāṣṭakasahitāli-kālimadhyavartī bhagavānakāro niḥśeṣavarṇapadavākyamahāvākyādirūpeṇāvasthitaḥ, tata evaite varṇāḥ prādurbhavanti | te ca padāni janayanti, tānyapi vākyāni, tanyapi mahāvākyāni yāvallaukikabhāṁvabhedamanantaṁ caturaśītidharmaskandhasahasrāṇīti sarvo'yaṁ varṇādyaprabhava iti | sa ca nābhiguhyayorādhārādheyabhāvasya vivakṣitatvānnirmāṇacakrameva mantrādhāra ityuktaḥ ||2-3||
parallel: 'di thams cad ni yi ge las rab tu skye ba gang yin pa'o/ / de yang lte ba dang gsang ba dag ni rten dang brten pa'i dngos por brjod pa de nyid kyi phyir/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo kho na sngags kyi rten yin no zhes brjod do/ /

sanskrit: evamakārānvayā akāraprabhavā mantrā anurūpeṇa śāntikādikarmasaṁghātaṁ kurvanti pravartayanti, nānyathāparijñātatattvā mantrā iti |
parallel: de ltar na a yig ni ris med pa ste/ a yig las rab tu byung ba'i sngags rnams ni/ mthun pa'i gzugs kyis zhi ba las gos pa'i las kyi tshogs byed cing rab tu 'jug pa yin gyi rnam pa gzhan du ni ma yin te/
yongs su shes pa'i de kho na nyid ni sngags so/ /
yang gsungs pa/
mchog tu mi 'gyur gcig pu pa'i/ / ngo bo nyid kyi sngags kyi ste/ /
de yongs shes pa tsam gyis ni/ / sngags rnams 'dir ni las byed do/ /
zhes pa dang / de bzhin du/

sanskrit: ata eva hi necchāmo mantrān varṇasvarūpiṇaḥ |
parallel: de nyid phyir na sngags rnams ni/ / yi ge'i rang gzugs su mi 'dod/ /
gang phyir rtsa yang 'khyog por ni/ / byed pa tsam du mi nus so/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: ata āha - kurvanti karmasaṁghātaṁ mantrarūpeṇa dehināmiti | pañcāśadakṣarāṇītyādinā saṁkhyāmāha | ālīnāṁ prajñopāyarūpeṇa dvitvāccatuḥṣaṣṭiḥ saṁpadyante | tatrālivargaṁ dvidhā kṛtvā varṇā dvātriṁśat saṁbhavanti | rakṣayorūrdhvādho nyāsāt kālayo dvātriṁśadeva | mūlatastu sākṣāt pañcāśadvarṇāḥ | tairvarṇairvedānīti caturdaśavidyāsthānāni paranikāyaprasiddhayā, svanikāyaprasiddhayā tu pañcavidyāsthānānyāśritya vartate'kāraḥ uktaṁ ca -
parallel: yi ge rnams ni lnga bcu nyid/ / ces bya ba la sogs pas ni gnyis pa gsungs te/ A li rnams thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin gyis gnyis nyid kyi phyir dang / de la A li'i sde tshan dor bar byas pa'i yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis te/
yang gsungs pa/ dang po gcig ni dgu dbus na/ / bcu yis ma bcings gang yin pa/ /

sanskrit: tamabaddhaṁ vijānīyāt sa vetti paramaṁ padam ||
parallel: de ni bcings med shes bya gang / / de nyid mchog gi go 'phang rig /
dbyangs gsal yi ge rnams kyang ni/ / grangs bcu'i rjes su 'jug pa'o/ /

sanskrit: abaddhānyonyasaṁyogād yo vetti sa jagadguruḥ || iti |
parallel: phan tshun sbyor phyir as bcings par/ / gang gis shes te 'gro ba'i bla/ / zhes so/ /
spyod pa'i rig byed yan lag bzhir/ / de yi bkod pa rgyas par te/ /
