rnying pa'i chos kyi bstan bcos su/ / rig pa bcu bzhi 'di rnams so/ /
sgra dang gtan tshigs rig pa dang / /
de bzhin kho nar nad dang ni/ /
gso ba dang ni bzo rig gnyis/ / rig pa'i gnas ni lnga po'o/ /

sanskrit: etāni sarvānya(ṇya)kārādevodidhrayanta iti sarvamantreśvaraṁ taṁ vinā teṣāmuccāro na vidyate | ata āha - vedādisaṁsthitāni vā iti ||4||
parallel: 'di rnams thams cad ni a yig las 'byin par byed do zhes pas yi ge thams cad kyi dbang phyug ste/ de dor nas de rnams 'don pa ni yod pa ma yin no/ / 'di ni/

zhi ba dang drag po dang gnyis ka'i rang bzhin gyi sngags dang / phyir bzlog pa la sogs pa dang / / srung ba'i 'khor lo dang / / phyi rol gyi bstan bcos dang / sngar bshad pa'i rig pa'i gnas rnams te/
gzhan du cung zad yod ma yin/ / zhes bya bas gsungs pa yin no/ / sngags 'di ni ci zhig /

sanskrit: a ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śavargairetāni pañcāśadapi samāni matāni |
parallel: gnas ni gang du yin/ grangs ni ji tsam zhes dogs pa la/ a ka tsa Ta ta pa ya sha/ /
dbus su son pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung gsungs te/

sanskrit: eṣāṁ madhye tu kiñjalke vidyate parameśvaraḥ |
parallel: sde pa so so las yi ge dang po blangs pa ste/
A li kA li gang yin pa ni ngag ma lus pa'i rang bzhin te rgyu yin la/ sde tshan ni brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /

sanskrit: śāntaraudro bhayasvabhāvānāṁ mantrāṇāṁ pratyaṅgirādīnāṁ ca rakṣācakrāṇāṁ bāhyaśāstrāṇāṁ ca prāguktavidyāsthānānāmetānyeva varṇāni kāraṇatāṁ prayānti | nānyadatrāsti kiñcaneti boddhavyam | ata eṣa mantroddhāro nirvikalpaḥ sarvatra yoginītantrādau boddhavyaḥ | tadarthamāha - nānyadanyo'sti kiñcaneti ||5||
parallel: de nyid ni yi ge lnga bcu ste/

sanskrit: ko'sau mantraḥ, kiṁparivāraḥ, kutra sthitaḥ, kiṁsaṁkhyāka ityāśaṅkyāha - a ka ca ṭa ta pa ya śa madhyagatānītyādinā granthena | prativargādādyakṣaramādāyālikālī sakalavāṅmayahetū aṣṭau vargā bhavanti | ta eva pañcāśadvarṇā ālikālyoḥ samīkaraṇāccatuḥ- ṣaṣṭiḥ sampadyante, pratināḍīmekaikavarṇānudhyānāt | ata eva nirmāṇacakre pañcāśadakṣarāṇi svabhāvasiddhāni aṣṭāṣṭakabhedabhinnaśrīcakrasaṁvaramaṇḍalacatu ṣaṣṭidevatāmayānyaṣṭasu digvidikṣu vyavasthitāni jñātavyāni ||6||
parallel: A li kA li rnams mnyam du byas pa las ni drug cu rtsa bzhir yang dag par rtogs par bya ste/ rtsa so so la yi ge re re bsams pa las sprul pa'i 'khor lo la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yi ge lnga bcu po 'di rnams nyid brgyad pa brgyad kyis dbye bas tha dad pa'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin yin te/ phyogs dang phyogs bral brgyad rnams su rnam par gnas par shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: madhyanāyakamāha - tāsāṁ madhya ityādinā | tāsāmālikālimayīnāṁ nāḍīnāṁ madhye, parameśvaraḥ paramavīrayoginīsvabhāvā varṇāsteṣāmīśvaraścakravartī | tathāhi napuṁsakabījacatuṣṭayaparihāreṇākārādayo dvādaśavarṇā bhagavān dvādaśabhujaḥ | dagdhabījāni catvāri ḍākinī-lāmā-khaṇḍarohā-rūpiṇyaḥ (kā?) | kādayo hāntā makārabindu-lāñchitāstricakravīravīriṇyaḥ | yādayo hāntāḥ kākāsyādyāḥ | kṣakāraḥ kṣayaḍākaḥ | madhye'kāro vajravārāhīti | ata etairaṣṭabhirvargairveṣṭito'sau paramākṣaro'kāra eva samastamantraheturiti | tata etena mantrā uddhriyanta iti ||7||
parallel: de rnams dbus kyi zhes bya ba la sogs pas dbus kyi gtso bo gsungs te/ A li kA li'i rang bzhin can gyi rtsa de rnams kyi dbus su mchog gi dbang phyug ste mchog gi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor pa'i rang bzhin gyi yi ge de rnams kyi dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba'o/ / de bzhin du ma ning gi sa bon bzhi po yongs su dor nas/

ka yig la sogs pa ha yig gi mthar thug pa/ ma yig thig les mtshan pa ni 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams so/ / sa la sogs pa ha yig gi mthar thug pa rnams ni khwa gdong ma la sogs pa rnams te/
de'i phyir 'di ni sde tshan brgyad po 'di rnams kyis bskor ba yin la/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i a yig kho na sngags thams cad kyi rgyu ste/ des na 'dis sngags 'byin par byed pa yin no/ /
a yig ces bya ba la sogs pas de'i phan yon gsungs te/
gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid gsal por byed pa'i phyir don chen no/ /
de rnams de kho nas byed pa nyid kyi phyir/
sde tshan rnams kyi gtso bo'o/ / lus can te/

sanskrit: tasyānuśaṁsāmāha - akāra ityādi | mahārtha iti, ādyanutpannatattvasūcakatvāt | varganāyaka iti, tenaiva teṣāṁ prāṇitatvāt | ye ca dehināṁ sādhakā[nāṁ] vā ye mantrā vākyāni praṇavādīni vā tata eva jātā utpannāḥ | evaṁ sarvaṁ eva sattvā mantraparāyaṇā[ḥ] svabhāveneti sthitam ||8||
parallel: gang zhig sngags kyi tshig tshad mar smra ba rnams kyang de nyid las skyes shing byung ba yin no/ / de ltar na rang bzhin gyis sems can gyi sngags thams cad kho na'i dpung gnyen no zhes bya bar gnas so/ / sgrub pa po rnams sam/

sanskrit: karmaprasarasiddhayaścaitatparijñānādeva nānyasmādapīti vaktumāha - yā khaṅgāñjanetyādi | khaṅgacakra ratnavajrapadmavidyādharasiddhayaḥ pañca, khaṅgasyopalakṣaṇatvāt | yayā naṣṭacchāyo bhavati sā'ñjanasiddhirdvitīyā | yayā kṣaṇamātreṇa yojanaśatasahasrāṇyākrāmati sā pādalepasiddhistṛtīyā | yayā bhūgatanidhānāni paśyati, biladvāraṁ praviśyāsurakanyakā ākarṣayati vā, sā pātālasiddhiścaturthī | yayā manorama taravapuṣo yakṣiṇīrbhuṅkte sā yakṣāṅganāsiddhiḥ pañcamī | yayā mukhakṣiptayā sarvabuddhakṣetrāṇyaṭitvā buddhebhyo dharmaṁ śṛṇoti sā guli(ṭi)kāsiddhiḥ ṣaṣṭhī | yayā śāntyādīnyaṣṭau karmāṇi sādhayati sā trailokyodaravartinī siddhiḥ saptamī | yayā pāṣāṇatāmrādīn suvarṇa(rṇī)karoti sā sūtakasiddhiraṣṭamītyaṣṭau mahāsiddhayaḥ | anyā api divyacakṣurādilakṣaṇā aṇimādayo vā kāryaiśvaryādayo vā laukikalokottarāḥ siddhayaḥ, tāḥ sarvā vargāṣṭaka -
parallel: zhes bya ba la sogs pas las rab 'byams kyis dngos grub rnams kyis 'di yongs su shes pa kho na las yin gyi gzhan las ni ma yin no zhes gsungs te/ ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang rin po che dang rdo rje dang pad+ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub lnga po rnams ral gris nye bar mtshon pa nyid las so/ / gang gis grib ma nyams par gyur pa de ni mig sman gyi dngos grub ste gnyis pa'o/ /
gang gis sa la gnas pa'i gter mthong ba'am/

sanskrit: sa sarvo mantrarūpo hi tasmādeva prajāyate ||10||
parallel: gang gis shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i gnod sbyin mo la longs spyod pa de ni/

sanskrit: nādo hi mantra ityuktaḥ sarveṣāṁ tu śarīriṇām |
parallel: gnod sbyin gyi lus can ma'i dngos grub ste lnga pa'o/ /
gang zhig khar bcug pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'phur nas sangs rgyas rnams las chos nyan par byed pa de ni ri lu'i dngos grub ste drug pa'o/ /
gang gis zhi ba la sogs pa'i las brgyad po sgrub par byed pa ni/
'jig rten gsum gyi khongs su rgyu ba'i dngos grub ste bdun pa'o/ /
gang gis rdo dang zangs la sogs pa gser du byed pa de ni dngul chu'i dngos grub ste brgyad pa'o zhes pa grub chen brgyad po rnams so/ /
gzhan yang lha'i spyan la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /

sanskrit: bhūṣitāḥ(tāt) prathamasvarādevodbhavantīti na pṛthak prapañcena tatsādhanāya yatnaḥ karaṇīya ityuktaṁ bhavati ||9||
parallel: phra ba la sogs pa'am/ sku'i dbang phyug la sogs pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams te/ sde tshan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i dngos grub ste de rnams ni dbyangs dang po kho na las byung ba yin gyi so so'i spros pas de sgrub pa'i 'bad pa byed pa ni ma yin no zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /

sanskrit: sarvasattvāntargatatvena tasya vyāptiṁ pradarśayannāha - yaḥ kaścidityādinā | dehināmapadādīnāṁ yo vākprasaro vyaktāvyaktobhayātmaka utpadyate, sa sarvo mantrarūpa eva, tadutpattibhūtasyāntargatatvāt ||10||
parallel: gang zhig cung zad ces bya ba la sogs pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi mthar thug par son pa nyid kyis na khyab pa por bstan pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin te/ lus can rnams kyi ni rkang med la sogs pa rnams kyi ste tshig dang dbyangs gsal ba dang mi gsal ba dang gnyis ka'i bdag nyid can skyed par byed pa de ni sngags thams cad kyi gzugs kho na ste/

sanskrit: nābhideśāduccaran mahāsukhadhvaniritaro vā nāda eva mantraḥ, manastrāṇanād guptabhāṣaṇāt | samāpattau sarvo'yaṁ strīpuṁsavargastameva bhāṣate, tenaiva ca pramodyate, daṇḍabhedena mūrcchati, tenaiva bindubhedo'pyāpyata ityevamādikarmasaṁghātakṛtasarvadehināṁ viśvagranthimahāsthānānnirmāṇacakrāddharmāralli[ḥ] sarvavarṇapadavākyamahāvākyādeścaturaśotidharma-skandhārallivyāpakaḥ | viniścaret prabhavati |
parallel: de las skyes par gyur cing nang du son pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ / lte ba'i phyogs las 'thon pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgra'am/ gzhan du na nA da nyid sngags te/
gsang ba'i skad kyis snyoms par 'jug pa na 'di thams cad de/ / bud med dang skyes pa'i tshogs de nyid ni/ skad de kho nas rab tu dga' bar byed do/ /
sngon du gzung ba gang zhig smra/ / gsal dang mi gsal rang bzhin te/ / nA da 'di ni sngags su bshad/ /

sanskrit: harṣe kope prasāde ca svapne mūrcchākṣaṇe mṛtau |
parallel: dga' dang khro dang rmi lam dang / / brgyal dang 'chi ba'i skad cig dang / /

sanskrit: prabodhe ratikāle ca sa evāśrūyate dhvaniḥ ||11||
parallel: sad dang dga' ba'i dus su ni/ / sgra de nyid ni thos par 'gyur/ / nye bar bsdu ba gsungs pa/

sanskrit: upasaṁhāramāha - mantrasiddhau prāguktāyāṁ na kaścinniyato vidyate mantrasya(mantraḥ), yenāsau karmasiddhimabhini[rva]rtayati, bhāvanāyāṁ sāti śayenātiśayatvād ayamevātiśayo yo dharmatākṣareṇa vyāptiḥ, tasyāṁ styāṁ te vividhavicitrakarmakāriṇo bhavantīti | tadarthamāha - anutpannasvabhāvo hi mantro vargeśvaraḥ para iti | ādyanutpannasarvabhāva-svabhāvasūcako'yamakāraḥ | taddṛṣṭayaivai tairma(te ma)ntrā svakarmaṇi prayuktāḥ saphalā bhavantīti | ata eva vargeśvara iti teṣāmādhipatyakṛt, na tu te tadadhipataya iti ||12||
parallel: sngags kyi sde tshan dbang phyug mchog / ces bya bas gsungs te/ gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin mtshon bar byed pa a yig 'di ni de'i dpe nyid kyis sngags de rnams rang gi las dang rab tu sbyor te/

sanskrit: iti vasantatilakāyāṁ niṣpannakramasādhanopāyikāyāṁ rahasyadīpikāyāṁ ṭīkāyāṁ navamanirdeśavistaravyākhyā ||9||
parallel: rgyas par bstan pa dgu pa'i rgyas par bshad pa'o/ / / / zhes pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga dpyid kyi thig le'i rgya cher 'grel pa gsang ba chen po'i sgron ma las/
de nas zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyas par bstan pa bcu pa gsungs te/ de nas zhes pa ni rgyas par bstan pa dgu pa la ltos nas bar med pa'i don to/ / gang yang rung ni/
sku gsum gyi rnam pas so/ / bde ba chen po'i ye shes ni lhan cig skyes pa ste/ lhan cig skyes pa rab tu bshad par bya'o zhes pa ni mdor bstan pa'o/ /
sems can thams cad cad ni sku gsum ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin gsum dang ldan pa kho na'o zhes bya ba 'di gsungs pa yin no/ / spyi bo lte bar gnas 'khor lo/ /

sanskrit: hṛtkaṇṭhaṁ ca gataṁ cakraṁ vaṁkārasadṛśaṁ matam ||2||
parallel: steng du spyi gtsug gi pad+ma'i lte ba la yang gru gsum gyi rnam pa'i chos 'byung gi rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir de ni e'i rnam pa'o/ / de bzhin du snying ga dang mgrin par gnas pa'i 'khor lo gnyis kyang baM yig gi rnam pa ste/ baM yig lugs las bzlog pa'i rnam pa las kyang gru gsum nyid do/ /

sanskrit: idānīṁ dharmādikāyatrayasvabhāvacatuścakravasantatilakāniruktimantrādyoni(dyauli)-catuṣṭayapañcasvarādisvarūpāvācyasahajapratipādanārthaṁ daśamanirdeśamathetyādinā''ha | atheti nirdeśāpekṣayā''nantaryārthaḥ | yasya kasyacidanyatamasya | dharmādirūpeṇeti kāyatrayarūpeṇa | mahāsukhajñānamiti sahajaṁ pravakṣyāmītyuddeśaḥ | etaduktaṁ bhavati - sarva eva sattvāstrikāyasahajamayaṁ(yāḥ), triyuktatvāt ||1||
parallel: 'di skad du gsungs pa yin te/

sanskrit: teṣāṁ sthānamāha - śironābhigataṁ cakramityādinā | yadetacchironābhyo[ra]ntare sthitaṁ cakradvayaṁ tadekārākṛtīti, adho dharmodayasamatvāt pṛthivīsādharmā(rmyā)cca | ūrdhvamuṣṇīṣakamalakarṇikāpi trikoṇākṛti[ḥ], dharmodayasvabhāvatvāt | tathā hṛtkaṇṭhagatamapi cakradvayaṁ vaṁkārākṛti | va(vaṁ)kārasya vilomasanniveśādapi trikoṇameva | etaduktaṁ bhavati - nirmāṇamahāsukhacakrayoḥ prajñopāyasvabhāve'pi, ubhayoḥ prajñārūpatvāt | tathaivopāyaprajñāsvabhāvayorapi hṛtkaṇṭhacakrayorapi prajñārūpatā, sarveṣāmavadhūtyā vyāpyatvāt ||2||
parallel: sprul pa dang bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo gnyis ka shes rab kyi rang bzhin yin pa nyid las shes rab dang thabs kyi rang bzhin yang yin la/ de kho na bzhin du snying ga dang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo dag kyang shes rab kyi rang bzhin nyid thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin yang yin te/ a wa d+hU tIs thams cad la khyab pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /
lte ba'i dbus zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad du brjod/ / ces bya ba'i mthar thug pas ni/

sanskrit: dvātriṁśattu dalaṁ padmaṁ mūrdhni madhye vyavasthitam ||3||
parallel: sprul pa'i sku la sogs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi la/

sanskrit: kaṇṭhamadhye gataṁ cāpi padmaṁ tu ṣoḍaśacchadam |
parallel: bzhin du 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / / sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / bcu drug dang / brgyad rnams te/
dbyu gu dang / chu tshod dang / 'pho ba dang / thun tshod kyi rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir ro/ /
ji ltar phyi rol du nyid ma rab tu rgyu bas dbyu gu la sogs par rnam par 'byed pa de kho na bzhin du nang du srog rab tu rgyu bas/
de 'khor lo la brten pa kho na ste/
'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/
kun nas rnam par gnas pa'o/ / zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pas ni/

sanskrit: nābhimadhya ityārabhya padmamaṣṭadalaṁ smṛtamityantena nirmāṇādicakrāṇi catvāri yathākramaṁ catuḥṣaṣṭidvātriṁśatṣoḍaśāṣṭadalāni, daṇḍanāḍīsaṁkrāntiprahara(ṇa?)svarūpatvāt | yathā bahiḥ sūryapracāreṇa daṇḍādivibhāgastathaivādhyātmani prāṇapracāreṇa | sa cakrāśrita eveti kālacakrāṇyetānīti pratipāditaṁ bhavati ||3-4||
parallel: shes rab dang thabs 'ba' zhig gi dus kyi khyad par bzhi po re zhig sprul pa'i sku la sogs pa'i rang bzhin rnams su yang 'gyur ro zhes rtogs par bya ste/ de la lte ba'i 'khor lo la sprul pa'i sku ste/ sems can thams cad kyi phung po dang skye mched kyi rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams skyed par byed do/ /

sanskrit: catuḥṣaṣṭidalamityārabhya samantāt saṁvyavasthitamityantena na kevalaṁ prajñopāya-kālaviśeṣasvabhāvāni catvāri, yāvannirmāṇa kāyādisvabhāvānyapi bhavantīti pratipādyate | tatra nābhicakraṁ nirmāṇakāyaḥ, buddhabodhisattvarūpāṇāṁ skandhāyatanasvabhāvasarva-sattvānāmutpatteḥ | hṛccakraṁ dharmakāyaḥ, hūkārādirūpaskandhadhātūpasaṁhārakatvāt | kaṇṭhacakraṁ saṁbhogakāyaḥ, apyeṣāṁ dharmāmṛtaparibhogadānātyanu raśvādācca | śiraścakraṁ mahājñānaṁ svabhāvakāyaḥ, pāramārthikabodhicittasvarūpatvāt | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: snying ga'i 'khor lo la chos kyi sku ste/ hUM yig la sogs pa'i rnam pa phung po dang khams nye bar sdud pa'i gzugs nyid kyi phyir ro/ / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yang ste/
sku gsum lus kyi dbus su ni/ / 'khor lo'i rnam pas yang dag gnas/ /

sanskrit: trikāyasya parijñānaṁ cakraṁ mahāsukha(khaṁ) smṛta[m] || iti |
parallel: sku gsum yongs su shes pa ni/ / bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor brjod/ / ces bya ba dang / de bzhin du/
zhi ba rdo rje 'chang slad brten par bgyi/ / zhes bya ba'o/ / sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /
zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/
haM gi yi ge 'bar bar byed/ / ces bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i gzhung ni/ / sems can thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i brten pa sngags kyi sku khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir gsungs pa yin te/
de la sprul pa'i 'khor lo thob pa na/ /
tshul gang gis dbus su a yig dang / 'dab ma rnams la A li kA li rnams so/ / chos su hUM gi yi ge mkha' 'gro lnga'i sa bon ma ning bzhi dang bcas pa rnams so/ / mgrin par ni oM yig ring po bzhi 'am/ /
dbyangs bcu drug gis bskor ba'i tshangs pa'o/ /

spyi bor kha 'og tu phyogs pa'i haM gi yi ge A li nyis 'gyur gyis bskor ba rnams bzhin du dkyil 'khor chen po dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang / snyoms par zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sha'i mtha' dang sha'i dbus kyi rtsa bzhi ni he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin gyi 'khor lo 'di rnams rtogs par byas pa yin no/ / de bzhin du/

sanskrit: candrasūryau tu vikhyātau pārśve tu vāmadakṣiṇe ||10||
parallel: zla ba nyi mar rnam grags pa/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pas 'khor lo la brten par gyur pa'i rtsa gnyis po gsungs te/ 'khor lo rnams kyi g.yon dang g.yas dag tu zla ba dang nyi ma dag ste/
srog dang thur sel las steng dang 'og tu khu ba dang khrag gi khams rab tu 'bab pa dag ni/
la la nA dang / /
ra sa nA la gnas pa shes par bya ste/
'dis ni phyi rol du zla ba dang nyi mar snang ba ni nang dang 'brel ba kho na'o zhes brjod pa yin no/ /
rdzas de dag gi 'bab pa'i sgo'i rnam pa snang bar bya ba'i phyir/

sanskrit: cakrādheyamantramūrtitvaṁ sarvasattvānāṁ pratipādayitumāha - nirmāṇacakramadhye tvityārabhya haṁkāro dīpaka ityantena granthena | tatra nirmāṇacakre prāpte[pro]ktena nyāyena madhye'kāro daleṣvālikālī | hūkārāḥ pañcaḍākabījāni sanapuṁsakāni dharme | caturdīrghapraṇavāḥ ṣoḍaśasvaravṛto brahmā vā kaṇṭhe | dviguṇāliveṣṭito'dhyā (dho)mukho hakāraḥ śirasi | yathākramaṁ mahāmaṇḍala samāpannā jñānamaṇḍalā(la) samāpannajñānamaṇḍalaśāntaśā(sā)ntaracaturnāḍīherukamaṇḍalarūpāṇi cakrāṇyetānīti pratipāditaṁ bhavati ||7-9 1/2||
parallel: mgrin pa nas brtsams zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs te/

sanskrit: evaṁ cakrāṇāmāśrayabhūtaṁ nāḍīdvayamāha - candrasūryau tu vikhyātāvityādi | vāmadakṣiṇayoścakrāṇāṁ candrasūryau prāṇāpānādūrdhvamadhaḥ śukraraktadhātū pravahantyau lalanārasane sthite jñeye | etena bahiścandrasūryaprakāśa ādhyātmika eveti kathitaṁ bhavati ||10||
parallel: gang 'dir g.yon logs su la la nAr bshad pa'i rtsa de ni/
'og gi gdong can mgrin pa nas brtsams nas lte ba'i dbus ji srid par myos byed 'bab pa dang / de bzhin du gang 'dir g.yas logs su ra sa nAr bshad pa'i rtsa gang yin pa ni/
zla ba dang khu ba dang thur sel gyi rlung ngo / /

sanskrit: nābherūrdhva tu yā nāḍī vahatyūrdhvamukhī tathā |
parallel: de la thag ni nyi ma dang srog gi rlung ste/
kha dog dang byed las las so zhes pa tshig gi lhag ma'o/ /

sanskrit: madaścandra iti khyāto rakta[ḥ] sūrya iti smṛtaḥ |
parallel: zla ba dang nyi ma 'di dag ni sems kyi sgo'i dbye ba gnyis te/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi lam gyi rang bzhin la brten nas steng dang 'og tu rab tu 'dzag cing rgyu bas rab tu 'bab pa dag ni 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / nam mkha'i snying po'i rang bzhin dang / 'od dpag med dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin du shes par bya ste/ dpag med rdo rje'i nyi ma dag /
'khor ba sgrub pa'i rtsa ba gnyis/ /

phyi rol du yang gang gi tshe nub pa'i ri la nyi ma 'og tu 'gro ba de'i tshe 'char ba'i phyir na zla ba steng du 'gro ste/ bzlog pa las kyang ngo / / sems kyi sgo la brten pa'i zla ba dang nyi ma gang yin pa 'di dag ste/

de nyid ni dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi 'gro ba dang 'ong pa rab tu 'jug pa'i rgyun du shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams ni dpa' bo rnams te/ de rnams ni zla ba rgyu ba rnams so/ /

sanskrit: tayordravyavāhitvaṁ dvāraṁ sanniveśaṁ ca prakāśayitumāha - kaṇṭhādārabhyetyādinā | yeyaṁ vāmapārśve lalanākhyā nāḍī, sā'dhomukhī kaṇṭhādārabhya nābhimadhyaṁ yāvanmadaṁ vahati | tathā yeyaṁ dakṣiṇapārśva rasanākhyā nāḍī, [sā] ūrdhvamukhī nābherārabhya kaṇṭhaṁ yāvadraktaṁ vahati || 11-12 ||
parallel: 'char ba dang ni nub byed pa/ / zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de la gang gi tshe srog gi rlung g.yas pa'i sna bug la shar ba de'i tshe thur sel gyi rlung g.yon pa'i sna bug nas nub cing 'gro'o/ /

sanskrit: madaraktayoḥ paryāyamāha - madaścandra iti khyāta ityādinā | yo madaścandraḥ śukramapānavāyuśca, taduktam - "sa sūryaḥ prāṇavāyuśca" [iti] | varṇataḥ kṛtyataśceti vākyaśeṣaḥ | etau candrākauṁ cittadvāraṁ dviprabhedadakṣiṇottarāyaṇarūpamāśrityordhvādhaḥpravāha-vṛttyā pravahantau lokeśākāśagarbhasvabhāvā amitābharatnasaṁbhavarūpiṇau jñeyau, "vajrasūryāmitābhau dvau mūlaṁ saṁsārasādhane" iti vacanāt | bahirapi yadastācalāt sūryo'dho gacchati, tadodayāccandra ūrdhvaṁ gacchati | viparyayenā(ṇā)pi | yāvetau cittadvāramāśritau candrākauṁ tāveva vīraḍākinīnāṁ gatyāgatipravṛttinibandhanau vijñeyau | tathā vīrāścatuviṁśatidhātavaste candracaraṇāḥ | evaṁ nikhile yāḥ sarvasattvānāmiti jñeyāḥ ||13-14 ||
parallel: de ltar nyin dang mtshan mor zla ba dang nyi ma rab tu rgyu ba ni sems can thams cad kyi gnas nyid de/ gnyid log pa dang sad pa yang de kho na bzhin du shes par bya'o/ / de bzhin du gnyid log pa la yang zla ba'i cha dang nyi ma'i cha'o/ /

de bzhin du gnyid log dang sad pa'i gnas skabs ni zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin 'od dpag med dang rin chen 'byung ldan du shes par bya'o/ / dbus kyi ka ba ni dus su 'chi ba yang slu bar khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos zhes bya ba nas brtsams te/
zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i gzhung gsungs pa yin te/ g.yon dang g.yas kyi rtsa la ma ning gi sa bon spangs pa'i dbyangs bcu gnyis rnams te/

bzhin du 'og dang steng gi gdong pa rnams ka la sogs pa'i gsal byed nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thig le dang bcas pa 'og dang steng gi gdong rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba rnams ni/ ngo bo nyid kho nas rtsa nA da'i rnam par gnas pa'o/ /
'di nyid ni/
dbus su byas nas nges par bya/ / zhes bya bas gsungs pa yin no/ / 'og tu thur sel gyi lam du thur sel srung bar byed pa k+Sha yig ste/
dung gi phyag rgyal gnas pa de'i steng du ni re pha'o/ /

sanskrit: tathā bahirudayā stamamāvadhyāndana (manau mādhyandina) eva pravṛttā iti darśayutumāha - astamanodayārthāvityādinā | tatra yadā prāṇavāyurdakṣiṇanāsāpuṭenodeti tadā'pānavāyurvāmanāsāpuṭenāstameti | evamahorātreṇa candrasūryapracāraḥ sarvasattvānāṁ sthita eva | svapnaprabodhāvapi tathaiva vijñeyau | svāpaścandrāṁśaḥ, [prabodhaḥ] sūryāṁśaḥ | evaṁ svāpaprabodhāvastha candrārkasvarūpāmitābharatnasaṁbhavarūpatā jñātavyā ||14 1/2||
parallel: chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su son pa'i hUM yig gi 'od zer rnams kyis/ /

sanskrit: abhyāntarastūpaṁ kālamṛtyuvañcanaṁ ca pratipādayitumāha - vāmadakṣiṇapārśve [tvi]-tyārabhyādhobhāge vyavasthita ityantena granthena | vāmadakṣiṇanāḍyornapuṁsakabījavarjitā dvādaśasvarā yathākramamadhaūrdhvamukhāḥ sabindu[ka]kārādicatuviṁśativyañjanairadhaūrdhvamukhaiḥ parivṛtāḥ svabhāvenaiva nāḍīnādarūpeṇa vyavasthitāḥ | ata evāha - madhyīkṛtya niyojitā iti | adho'pānamārge'pānarakṣakaḥ kṣakāraḥ śaṅkhamudrāyāṁ sthita ūrdhvaṁ tu repha iti | dharmacakramadhyagatahūkāraraśmibhirvāmadakṣiṇasvaravyañjanānyākṛṣya madhye praveśānte tadā kulikāpūjāvaśāt kālamṛtyū vañcayitvā vajradharamahāśvāsaprāpto bhavati yogīti || 15-16 1/2||
parallel: g.yon dang g.yas kyi dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams dkrugs nas dbu mar rab tu 'jug par 'gyur te/ de'i tshe rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i dbang gis dus su 'chi ba slu ba byas nas rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'chang gi sgom pa chen po thob bar 'gyur ro/ /

sanskrit: adhunā bodhicittasya sthānasaṁcāravaśāt kāyatrayarūpatāṁ pratipādayitumāha - yadā kaṇṭha ityādinā | kaṇṭhe yadā ṣoḍaśakalāsvarūpo vā paravaśa(rasa)rūpa ścandramā -
parallel: da ni byang chub kyi sems gnas pa yang dag par rgyu ba'i dbang gis sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/ gang tshe mgrin par zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gang gi tshe mgrin par cha bcu drug gi rang bzhin ro'i rnam pa'i zla ba gnas pa dang / de bzhin du sna rtse ste/
zla ba 'di ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ / de kho na'i khyad par las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ste phung po rnams kyi mchog rang rig pa'i skur shes par bya'o/ /

sanskrit: nāsāgre tu tadā cāsau vajrāgre tu yadā sthitaḥ ||18||
parallel: de nyid gang zhig rdo rje'i rtse mo las zla ba nub par gyur cing b+ha ga'i nang du lhung ba nyungs kar gyi tshad du gnas par gyur cing nyi ma'i dbus su rab tu zhugs pa de'i tshe 'di ni sprul pa'i sku zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /

sanskrit: astaṁgatastu saṁbhogaḥ kāyo'pi ca yadā bhavet |
parallel: de'i phyir zla ba dang nyi ma yang dag par sbyor ba las/
phung po la sogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams spro zhing skyed par byed do/ /

des na 'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste so so'i skye bo lta bu nyid kyi phyir longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nub par gyur pa las sprul pa'i skus sems can gyi don byed do zhes bya bar rnam par gzhag go/ / 'di nyid nyi ma'i dbus su gnas na/ /
yang pad+ma gar gyi rang bzhin du bshad pa la 'jug go zhes rtogs par bya ba'i phyir/
pad+ma gar dbang rgyal po ste/ / zhes bya ba gsungs te/ pad+ma'i gar ni pad+ma gar te/ /
'bar bar gyur pa'i nyi ma dang yang dag par sbyor ba las rgya'i mtshal lta bur snang bar byed pa'i phyir rgyal po'o/ /

sanskrit: stiṣṭhati, tathā nāsāgre hṛnnābhyagravajrāgre ca, tadā paripūrṇasukha tvāccandro'sau saṁbhogakāya ityucyate | tasyaiva(sa eva) viśeṣeṇa buddhānāṁ skandhānāmuttamasvasaṁvedyaḥ kāyo vijñeyaḥ | sa eva yāvadvajrāgrāccandro'staṅgato bhagamadhye patitaḥ sarṣapapramāṇāstaṅgata-sūryamadhyapraviṣṭastadāsau nirmāṇakāya iti saṁkhyāṁ(jñāṁ) gacchati | hetumāha - buddhānāmityādinā | tataścandrasūryasaṁyogāt skandhādirūpāṇāṁ buddhabodhisattvānāṁ spharaṇaṁ jāyate, tato'sau nirmāṇakāyaḥ, pṛthagjanānāmadṛśyatvāt saṁbhogakāyo'staṅgataḥ, nirmāṇakāyaḥ sattvārthaṁ karotīti vyavasthā ||17-20||
parallel: de dang sbyor ba las gcig tu gyur pa yang pad+mar snang ba'i sbyor ba can zla ba zhes brjod par bya'o/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i sku gsungs nas/ sprul pa'i sku yi rang bzhin can/ /

sanskrit: ata eva tasya sūryamadhyasthasyāpi svarūpaṁ padmanarteśvarākhyamavivṛttamiti pratipādayitumāha - (sa eva ?) padmanarteśvaro rājeti | padmanartanaṁ padmanartastatreśvara iva prabhavatīti padmanarteśvaraḥ | rājate sūryasaṁyogāccīna piṣṭavadvirocata iti rājā | tadarthamāha - [padmaprakāśayogavāniti] padma(dme) prakāśate śobhate iti padmaprakāśaḥ svayambhūḥ, tadyogādekībhāvādapi padmakā(pra)kāśayogavāścandra ityucyate ||20 1/2||
parallel: de ru ste/ sprul pa'i sku'i ming can gyi nyi ma dang zla ba nub par gyur pa de la rab tu zhugs te/ snang ba gnyis po ro mnyam pa nyid thob pa yod na/
de'i byang chub sems te/ zla ba dang nyi ma'o/ / gong bur gyur pa dri ma med pa ni/

snang ba gnyis dang ro mnyam pa nyid ni 'khor ba'i lam ste/ de'i rnam par rtog pa gcod pa gang du yin pa de la de skad ces bya'o/ / longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i sku ni spros pa nye bar zhi ba gang du yin pa de'i phyir/
gnyis gnyis med pa'o/ / rang rig pa nyid kyi phyir mchog go/ / nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir dag pa'o/ /
rdo rje ni stong pa nyid yin la/
sems dpa' ni snying rje ste/

sanskrit: rāgaṁ caiva virāgaṁ ca varjayitvā ghuṇaḥ sthitaḥ ||24||
parallel: de'i rten yin pa'i phyir na rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin no/ /

sanskrit: uktau saṁbhoganirmāṇakāyau, dharmakāyamāha - tasminnastaṁgate bhānāvityādinā | tasminnirmāṇakāyasaṁjñake sūrye candrāstaṅgate tatra praviṣṭedvayorvyaktau sāmarasyaṁ prāptayoḥ satyoḥ, tasya bodhicittasyeti candrasya sūryasya ca piṇḍībhūtamanāvila ubhayavikalpakalaṅkāpagataḥ sa dharmakāya iti pareṇa saṁbandhaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ ? vyaktidvayasāmarasyasaṁsāra-mārgasya tadvikalpasya vicchedo yasmiṁstathā prapañcayoḥ saṁbhoganirmāṇakāyayorupaśamo yatra, tataḥ samānādhikaraṇasamāsaḥ | sahajatvācchivaḥ | parasparaviruddhapakṣadvayojjhitatvānnirdvandvaḥ | svasaṁvedyatvāt paramaḥ | niḥkleśatvācchuddhaḥ | vajraṁ śūnyatā, sattvaṁ karuṇā, tanniśritatvādvajrasattvasvarūpastrivimokṣa mukhopāyaṁ prakṛtiprabhāsvaravimokṣa-mukhopeyarūpatvāt śrīherukaḥ | sa eva dharmakāya ityucyate | manastrāṇanāt sa eva mantraḥ | rāgādikleśajālasya palālasyai(sye)va bhakṣaṇāt sa eva ghuṇaḥ ||21-23||
parallel: thabs rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang thabs las byung ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i rnam par thar ba'i sgo'i rang bzhin nyid kyi phyir dpal he ru ka'o/ / de nyid ni chos kyi sku zhes brjod par bya ste/ yid skyob pa'i phyir de nyid sngags so/ /

sanskrit: nanu yogirnātantre ghuṇa eva (eva ghuṇo) nirdiṣṭo na kriyāditantreṣviti kathamavyāpako dharmakāya iti cet; ucyate - hasitetyādi | kriyācaryātantreṣu prajñopāyānāṁ parasparaṁ hāsaḥ, yogatantre tu darśanam, yogacaryobhayatantreṣu pāṇigrahaṇam | upalakṣaṇaṁ caitat | mahāyogatantre āśleṣaḥ, yoginītantreṣu dvandvam | uktaṁ ca -
parallel: 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa'i dra ba rtswa lta bur za
ba'i phyir/ de nyid srin bu'o/ / 'o na rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud du srin bu nyid du bstan mod/
bya ba la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams su ma yin pa'i phyir/

sanskrit: rahasye tvanalākhye tu vāyau sarvātma saṁsthitam |
parallel: ci ltar na chos kyi sku ni khyab par byed pa po zhes bya zhe na/
dgod dang zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod par bya ste/
bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud rnams su thabs dang shes rab rnams phan tshun du dgod pa'o/ /
rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du ni lta ba'o/ / rnal 'byor dang spyod pa gnyis ka'i rgyud rnams su lag pa 'dzin pa ste/
de gsungs pa/ dgod dang lta ba dag gis sam/ / 'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis te/ /
rgyud ni bzhi po rnams kyi yang / / dgongs pa'i skad kyis bstan pa yin/ / zhes so/ /

sanskrit: evaṁ rāgavirāgayā (yos) trayaṁ varjayitvā sarvatraiva tantreṣu ghuṇo vyavasthita iti vyāpakatvaṁ dharmakāyasyeti na doṣaḥ ||24||
parallel: de ltar na 'dod chags dang chags bral te gsum po zos nas rgyud thams cad nyid du srin bur rnam par gzhag pa'i phyir/ chos kyi sku khyab par byed pa po nyid do zhes pas skyon med do/ / chos kyi sku dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/

sanskrit: dharmakāyasya maṇḍalacakrarūpatāṁ darśayitumāha - sarvanāḍītyādinā | sarvābhirnāḍībhiḥ samāyogo yeṣāṁ dhātūnāṁ te sarvanāḍīsamāyogāścaturviṁśativīrāstairupalakṣitā yā etā ḍākinyastāsāṁ jāla samūhastatra saṁvarastattvam, bodhicittarūpa ityarthaḥ | dharmakāyasya sarvākāratāṁ darśaya[n] rahasya ityādyāha | yadetattantrarāje rahasya ityādike(kaṁ) vākyaṁ tat sandhābhāṣayā pṛthivyaptejovāyudhātuṣu bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu catuścakreṣu sarvabuddhātmaśaṁ(saṁ)varaṁ(ro) mahāsukhasvarūpo vyavasthitaḥ, dharmatārūpatvāt ||25-26||
parallel: don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin nyid do zhes bya ba'i don to/ / chos kyi sku ni rnam pa thams cad pa nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ gsang chen zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/

sanskrit: athavetyādinā suviśuddhadharmadhātukamityantena tasyaivādarśādipañcabuddhasvabhāvatāmāha | tathāhi vicitrajñeyacakrapratibimbitatvāt sa evādarśajñānam | apadādīnāmekatama -
parallel: yang zhes bya ba la sogs pas/ de nyid me long lta bu la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin du gsungs te/
de ltar ni/
de nyid me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /
rkang med la sogs pa rnams shin tu gcig pa nyid kyi phyir/
de nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /
so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ / de nyid las 'gro ba'i don rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir/
de nyid bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes so/ /
chos nyid kyi gzugs nyid kyi phyir 'di ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ / yang na rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa 'di nyid sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin nyid du gsungs te/ de ltar ni/
rang rig pa'i rnam pas snang bar mdzad pa'i phyir/

sanskrit: tvāt sa eva samatājñānam | sa eva vivṛtiprati (vi)cayāt pratyavekṣaṇājñānam | jagadarthasya tata eva pravṛtteḥ sa eva kṛtyānuṣṭhānajñānam | dharmatārūpatvāddharmadhātujñānamasāviti || 27-27 1/2||
parallel: 'di las longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa'i rin po che 'byung ba'i phyir/ rin chen 'byung ldan no/ / ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi dpag tu med pa'i 'od gang yin pa 'di ni 'od dpag med do/ /

sanskrit: vairocana ityādinā'syaiva pañcabuddhasvabhāvatāmāha | tathā hi svasaṁvedyarūpeṇa rocanāt sa eva vairocanaḥ | rāgādibhirakṣobhyaḥ sa eva | ratnayoḥ saṁbhoganirmāṇayoḥ saṁbhavo'ta iti ratnasaṁbhavaḥ | jñānamayyo'parimitā bhā[so] yasya so'yamamitābhaḥ | sattvārthakriyāyāṁ sapha(ka)lā siddhiryataḥ so'moghasiddhiḥ | vivṛtirūpamuktvā sāṁvṛtaṁ rūpamāha - pañcāmṛtamayamityādi | rahasyādipañcabhiḥ pañcāmṛtamayamapi piṇḍaṁ bindurūpaṁ pañcavyomamadhye sāma rasyamāpannaṁ saṁvṛtamapi suviśuddhadharmadhātujñānaṁ svadehe sthitaṁ vadanti buddhā iti vākyaśeṣaḥ | tasyaiva viśeṣaṇamāha - vajrasattva iti | prāṅnirṇītaḥ paramasukhasvabhāvo hetupratyayanirapekṣo yaḥ sa dharmakāya ityucyate | etena punarapi vivṛtirūpatvamasya pratipāditaṁ bhavati || 27-30 1/ ||

sanskrit: upasaṁhāramāha - tatra kāyatrayo(yā)liṅgane cakracatuṣṭayakathanena vyaktidvayakathanena tatsāmarasyapratipādanena coktaḥ | nādabindusaṁghaṭṭakathanena herukavajravārāhyorvasantatilakārtha uktaḥ | gatyāgatiśabdena tayoḥ saṁyoga uktaḥ mantratantrajñānaguhyoli kathanam | vāmadakṣiṇaparśveṣu svarā dvādaśa saṁsthitāḥ" (10|15) ityanena bāhyena(vākyena) tathā "asyaiva sahajā prajñā" (10|31) ityārabhya "cakraṁ nirdahya niṣkramet" (10|36) ityantena ca vākyena tathā "dagdhānāṁ caiva buddhānāmānandaṁ janayet punaḥ" (10|37) ityanena ca "nābhimaṇḍala māgamya sthitā bhavati pūrvavat" (10|38) ityanena ca catasra olayo mantratantrajñānaguhyākhyāḥ kathitāḥ | tathā nirmāṇādicakracatuṣṭaye yaḥ pañcasvarādivinyāsa iti saṁkṣepeṇa dviguṇībhūtālikālidvayahūkārādibījapañcakanapuṁsakabījavinyāsa(sā?) - dīrghabrahmavinyāsa-dvātriṁśadālipariveṣṭitānāhatākṣaravinyāsaśca "nirmāṇacakramadhye tu vargāṣṭapariveṣṭitā(taḥ) | varṇānāmagrarūpeṇa akāraḥ paramākṣaraḥ ||" (10|7) ityādinā granthenoktam(ktaḥ) | uddeśāpekṣayā nirdeśaḥ | uddeśo hi saṁkṣepeṇa pratipādanam | nirdeśo vistareṇeti śeṣaḥ | eṣa nirdeśa iti pariccheda ityarthaḥ | yāḥ khaṅgāñjanetyādayo'ṣṭau mahāsiddhayaḥ prāguktāḥ spaṣṭārthāḥ | tāntu(tās)tāḥ prāguktavasanta-tilakasādhanopāyikāvabodhād bhavantīti pratipāditaṁ bhavati |

sanskrit: duḥkhīvāhaṃ tathāpi pratapati dhig aho duṣkṛtaṃ durvidagdham // Tss_3
parallel: de lta mod kyi kye ma bdag smad nyes byas ngan pas brjid cing sdug bsngal ldan pa nyid/ / de lta na yang kho bo sdug pa kye ma'o nyes byas ngan mkhas ngan pa rab tu brjid/ / de ltar yin kyang sdug pa bdag / mi dge las ni ma tshig pas/ / ngan las byas pas bdag ni 'gyod/ /

sanskrit: dhig dhig māṃ mandabhāgyaṃ divasakararucāpy apraṇuṇṇāndhakāraṃ
parallel: skal ba zhan pa bdag smad smad pa zhig ste nyin byed 'od zer gyis kyang mun pa sel/ / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis kyang mun pa rab tu mi bsal ri bo gangs can klung ngogs kyi/ / skal ngan bdag la skal ba med/ / nyi ma shar yang mun pa gnag /

gangs can las byung 'jug ngogs chus dkrigs pa yi dum bu 'khyags shing bsil ba dag tu bsgom/ / shang shong kha ba'i rum grugs dkrigs pas bsil bar dbyar skam rin chen gling gi tshong khang gi / gang+gA'i chu ni shin tu bsil/ / de phyir 'gram du bsdad kyang ni/ / skom yang btung rgyu ma rnyed do/ /

rin chen gling gi lam srang dang ni nor bu'i phug yangs khang pa dag gi nang du dbul/ / nor bu'i phug yangs khang pa'i nang na dbul zhing 'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig bcom ldan 'das/ / yod pa'i gling / / nor rnams kyis gang khang pa la/ / der 'dug kyang ni bdag phongs pas/ /

sanskrit: nāthīkṛtvāpy ānāthaṃ bhagavati bhavatīṃ sarvalokaikadhātrīm // Tss_4
parallel: 'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig ma khyod mgon du byas kyang mgon ma mchis so bcom ldan ma/ / shang shong kha ba'i rum grugs dkrigs pas bsil bar dbyar skam rin chen gling gi tshong khang gi / nor bu'i phug yangs khang pa'i nang na dbul zhing 'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig bcom ldan 'das/ / khyod kyis mgon du bgyis kyang mgon ma mchis pas skal nyams bdag ni smad cing smad pa'i gnas/ / bcom ldan 'das ma khyed la ni/ / mgon 'dod kyang ni mgon med bdag / 'jig rten kun gyi yum gcig ma/ /

sanskrit: mātāpi stanyahetor viruvati bahuśaḥ khedam āyāti putre
parallel: nu ma'i rgyu las lan mang dag tu rnam par ngu ba'i bu la ma yang skyo bar 'gyur/ / ma yang nu ma'i ched du rnam pa mang du ngu ba'i bu la skyo bar 'gyur ba lags/ ma la rtag tu ngus nas ni/ / nu ma'i don du bu slong na/ / de la ma yang skyo bar 'gyur/ /

sanskrit: krodhaṃ dhatte pitāpi pratidivasam asatprārthanāsu prayuktaḥ /
parallel: nyi ma so sor dam pa ma yin don gnyer rnams la rab bskul pha yang khro ba 'dzin/ / nyi ma re re dam pa ma yin don du gnyer la bskos pa'i pha yang khro sel na/ / pha yang bu la khro bar byed/ / mi rnyed nyin re slong gyur na/ /

'jig rten gyi ni re 'dod 'bras bus yangs ldan dpag bsam shing chen 'khri shing mchog ni khyod/ / khyod ni 'jig rten gsum 'dod 'bras bu yangs pa dpag bsam ljon shing yal ga mchog chen te/ / 'jig rten gsum gyis bslangs kyang ni/ / khyed kyis 'bras bu gang bar byas/ / dpag bsam shing gi yal ga mchog /

sanskrit: sarvebhyo 'bhyārcitārthān visṛjasi na ca te vikriyā jātu kācit // Tss_5
parallel: mngon par don gnyer don rnams kun la stsol gyi nam yang rnam gyur de dag ci yang med/ / kun la mngon par 'dod don stsol yang khyod la nam yang rnam 'gyur 'ga' yang yod mi mnga'/ / de ni sgrol ma khyed yin no/ / thams cad la ni ma lus pa/ / sbyin pa khyod kyis khyab par byas/ /

sanskrit: yo yaḥ kleśoghavahnijvalitatanur ahaṃ tāraṇī tasya tasye-
parallel: gang la nyon mongs tshogs kyi me 'bar lus can de dang de yis sgrol ma nga nyid cis/ / gang dang gang zhig sdug bsngal tshogs mes lus bsregs de dang de ni nga yis bsgral lo zhes/ / nyon mongs kun gyi me des ni/ / bdag gi lus 'di rtag tu tshig /

sanskrit: tyātmopajñāṃ pratijñāṃ kuru mayi saphalāṃ duḥkhapātālamagne /
parallel: bdag nyid zhal bzhes dam bcas sdug bsngal 'og tu bying ba bdag la 'bras bu ldan par mdzod/ / nyid kyi dam bca' zhal bzhes sdug bsngal sa 'og bying ba bdag la 'bras bu bcas par mdzod/ / sa 'og sdug bsngal de la ni/ / bdag gi lus 'di nub tsam na/ /

sanskrit: vardhante yāvad ante paruṣaparibhavāḥ prāṇināṃ duḥkhavegāḥ
parallel: srog chags rnams kyi sdug bsngal shugs ni rtsub cing zil gnon 'di dag ji snyed 'phel gyur pa/ / ji srid srog chags rnams kyis zil gnon rtsub ldan sdug bsngal shugs de 'phel ba de srid du/ / sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal ni/ / drag po 'phel bar gyur tsam na/ /

yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas theg par smon lam blo mnga' rnams kyi brtse ba'ang de snyed nyid/ / yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas theg pa'i smon lam blo mnga' rnams la rjes brtse mnga' ba lags/ / rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i smon lam ni/ / bdag gi sems la shar ba'i dus/ / sgrol ma phan 'dogs mdzad par zhu/ /

sanskrit: ity uccair ūrdhvabāhau nadati nutipadavyājam ākrandanādaṃ
parallel: de ltar bstod pa'i tshig gi zol gyis cho nge'i sgra dag gsang mthon sgrogs shing lag bsgreng la/ yum gcig de ltar lag bsgreng bstod pa'i tshig zol cho nge'i nga ro dpangs mthor 'don pa la/ / lag bsgreng bstod pa'i tshig brjod cing / / don du drag por ngus pa yis/ /

sanskrit: nārhaty anyo 'py upekṣāṃ janani janayituṃ kiṃ punar yādṛśī tvam /
parallel: gzhan dag gis kyang btang snyoms bya bar 'os pa min na yum gcig khyod kyis lta yang ci/ / gzhan gyis kyang ni btang snyoms bya bar 'os pa min na khyed 'dras lta zhig blos ci 'tshal/ / khyed lta bu la bdag gis zhus/ / kye ma sgrol ma khyed kyis ni/ / bdag spangs par ni mi gsha'o/ /

gzhan dag rnams kyis mngon 'dod 'byor par 'dod pa khyed las thob pa rnams mthong bzhin/ / khyod las gzhan dag rnams kyis mngon 'dod 'byor pa don gnyer 'dod pa rnyed pa ma khums na/ / khyod kyi spyan gyis gzigs tsam na/ / gang 'dod thams cad rnyed par 'gyur/ /

sanskrit: dahye sahyena bhūyastaram aratibhuvā saṃtatāntarjvareṇa // Tss_7
parallel: mi dge las byung nang gi gdung ba rgyun chags bzod blag med pas shin tu yang yang sreg / nang gi gdung ba rgyun chags mi dga'i sa gzhi sran du med pas shin tu yang yang bsreg/ / mi bde mi bzod sdug bsngal ni/ /

sanskrit: pāpī yady asmi kasmāt tvayi mama mahatī vardhate bhaktir eṣā
parallel: gal te kho bo sdig can lags na khyod la gus pa chen po 'di ni ci phyir 'phel/ / gal te kho bo sdig can lags na kho bo'i khyod gus chen po 'di dag ci phyir 'phel/ / yang 'byung dogs ni mi 'byung ngo / / bdag ni sdig can yin gyur na/ / dad pa shin tu 'phel nas ni/ /

sanskrit: śrutyā smṛtyā ca nāmno 'py apaharasi haṭhāt pāpam ekā tvam eva /
parallel: khyod nyid gcig pu'i mtshan gyis kyang ni thos dang dran pas 'phral la sdig pa sel bar byed/ / bden gsung mtshan tsam khums shing dran pa yis kyang khyod gcig kho nas nan gyis sdig sel ba/ / khyed la dad pa skye mi gsha'/ / ming thos pa'am dran pa yis/ / khyed kyi sdig pa dbang med 'phrog /

sanskrit: tyaktavyāpārabhārā nudasi mayi kathaṃ kathyatāṃ tathyakathye
parallel: de lta na yang bdag gi bya ba'i khur dag dong ba ji ltar lags zhes bden gsungs pa/ / de yi phyir na khyod kyi kho bo'i bgyi ba'i khur bu bor ba ji ltar lags pa gsungs/ / bdag don khyed kyis spangs pa de/ / bden par bdag la gsung bar zhu/ / khyed ni bden par gsung ldan ma/ /

sanskrit: pathyaṃ glāne mariṣyaty api vipulakṛpaḥ kiṃ bhiṣag rorudhīti // Tss_8
parallel: nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur yang sman pa'i snying rje rgya chen phan pa khon par bgyid dam ci/ / nad pa 'chi bar 'gyur na'ang sman pa snying rje rgya chen sman 'phro gcod par bgyid dam ci/ / snying rje che ba'i sman pa yis/ / nad pa ma shi bar du ni/ / sman gyis phan 'dod che ru byed/ /

sgyu mang ser sna nga rgyal phrag dog rang skyon tha chad rnams kyis dus mnyam rim par yang / / gang gi phyir na 'gron gnas rnga mo cha shas du ma'i thun mong ba ltar rgyu dang ni/ / sgyu ma ser sna nga rgyal sogs/ / ngan pa de rnams kyis khyer nas/ / ri mos khyer bas dal skabs med/ /

du ma dag gi thun mong char gyur tshogs khang ja mo bzhin du bskor bar gyur pas na/ / ser sna nga rgyal la sogs rang skyon tha chad rnams kyis rim dang dus gcig bskul bas na/ / gnas pa'i spyi nor rnga mo bzhin/ /

sanskrit: yuṣmatpādābjapūjāṃ kṣaṇam api na labhe yat tadarthaṃ viśeṣād
parallel: khyed kyi zhabs pad mchod pa skad cig tsam yang ma rnyed gang de'i don du khyad par las/ / nyin gcig zhabs kyi pad+ma mchod pa skad cig tsam yang ma rnyed de phyir khyad par du/ / skad cig dal ba med pas ni/ / sgrol ma'i zhabs kyi pad+ma la/ / bdag gis mchod skabs ma rnyed do/ /

phongs pas yi ge dman par tshig 'di bkod do bdag gi 'dod pa don med ma gyur cig / bkren zhing phongs pa'i tshig dang yi ger bkod 'dis bdag la 'dod pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ / des ni yi ge du tshig 'don/ / de bton pas ni phan 'dogs re/ /

dus mtha'i rlung rab 'khrugs pas dkrugs pa'i chu ni g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i rlung 'khor ral pa can/ / lha mo gru chag chur bying snying rje dang bcas ngu ba'i cho nge g.yo med zhan pa rnams/ / dus mtha' rlung gis g.yas su 'khyil/ / des ni gtsubs pa'i chu rlabs 'byung / / g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i rol pas 'khrug /

rab 'khrugs kun du bskyod cing rba rlabs ngos brdabs sgra grag gad rgyangs chen po sgrogs pa las/ / khyod la mngon bstod lhur blangs pa yis 'phral du rgya mtsho dus mtha'i rlung gyen 'tshubs pa'i chu/ / de rgyab dba' rlabs 'gram du ni/ / brdabs pas sgra grag skad gdangs can/ / 'jigs byed rgya mtsho de las ni/ /

gru chag chu ru snying rje ngu ba'i cho nge dang ldan g.yo ba med cing zhan gyur pa/ / gtsubs pa'i chu rlabs g.yo zhing 'gul ba'i rol pas dkrugs pas bteg pa'i rba rlabs 'gram ngogs la/ / snying rje ngu skad drag po bton/ / skad cig dran med bems por gyur/ / gru chag nub pa'i skabs de la/ /

sanskrit: svacchandaṃ devi sadyas tvadabhibhūtiparais tīram uttīryate 'bdheḥ // Tss_10
parallel: lha mo khyod la bstod pa rnams kyis 'phral la chu gter 'gram du rang dga' thar bar 'gyur/ / brdabs pa'i sgra grag gad rgyangs can gyi pha rol 'gram du rang dga'i nyams kyis rgal bar 'gyur/ / lha mo khyod la bstod pa yis/ / bde bar rgya mtsho phar bsgral lo/ /

du ba 'tshubs pa sprin 'dra khong nas rab byung me stag mkha' khyim nang du rnam par rgyu/ / du ba 'khyil ba'i sprin nang 'thon zhing nam mkha'i khyim du 'phro ba'i me stag can gyi me/ / sprin nag bskor zhing du ba'i nang / / de la me stag can gyi me/ /

me dpung me lce 'phro zhing rab 'bar drag po'i khang par mal stan dag la rab 'khod pa/ / me lce 'bar zhing 'phro ba'i shugs kyis nang du zhugs pa'i khyim na mal du nyal ba rnams/ / me lce cher 'bar khyim du ni/ / ngal nas mal du nyal ba'i mis/ /

thal sbyar cod pan ldan pas khyed la btud byas ldab ldib dag tu gsol ba 'debs pa rnams/ / khyod la rab btud thal mo spyi bor sbyar zhing ldab ldib gsol ba btab pas skad cig la/ / khyed la rab btung thal mo sbyar/ /

glog rab 'gyu ba'i rtse dga' rab 'bar chu 'dzin shugs kyis skad cig nyid la sgrib par byed/ / glog rab 'gyu ba'i sgeg pas dmar por gyur pa'i sprin gyi chu rlabs dag gis khebs par 'gyur/ / skad cig gis ni glog byung nas/ / myur bar sprin char gyis ni bskor/ /

myos pa'i chu rgyas 'gram pa gnyis ka'i ngos la babs pas bung ba dag gi phreng ba can/ / 'gram pa'i gdu bu myos pa'i chu yis gang ba gnyis ka la brten bung ba'i phreng ba yi/ / smyo byed glang chen 'gram gnyis la/ / 'dzag pa'i chu la reg nas ni/ / bung ba'i phreng ba bzhin du thal/ /

hUM zhes bya bas bos par gyur pa'i gling chen zla bos zhe sdang me sbar gnyis 'thung gi/ / dar dir sgra yis bab pa'i ban glang zla bos zhe sdang me lce sbar ba'i glang chen gyi/ / de rnams kyis ni hUM sgra sgrogs/ / sgra de thos nas zhe sdang las/ / glang chen 'thab tu byung mno nas/ /

so rtse rab tu mtho ba'i khyogs la blangs pa'i lus can dag gis khyod rjes dran pa na/ / mche ba'i rtse mo 'do li mthon po'i steng du lus po gzhag pa'ang khyod rjes dran pa yis/ / khros nas mche bas mi bteg nas/ / 'do li la ni bsdad pa bzhin/ / khyed dran tsam gyis 'chi ba bzlog /

rtse mo che ldan mgo rtse'i rdzong la 'dug cing rab tu dga' bas 'chi bdag phyir zlog byed/ / ri bo mthon po'i zom rtse'i mkhar la 'dug pa bzhin du dga' zhing 'chi bdag phyir zlog bgyid/ / de steng mkhar du bsdad du phyin/ /

mdung drag pos bsnun bsad mi yi mgo dang gsal shing dag gi 'khri shing dga' ston can/ / mdung bsnun mi med stong pa nags gseb tu/ / shin tu rno ba'i mtshon rnams kyis/ / brgyab nas yod par mi ro'i mgo /

nags tshal stong par chom rkun lag rtses ral gri g.yo zhing brdeg par gzas pas dregs rgyas pa/ / bsad mi yi mgo dang gsal shing can gyi gtor ma'i ston 'gyed 'brog stong du/ / rkun po'i lag rtses bzung bas g.yo ba'i phub dang ral gris dregs pa shas cher 'thon gyur cing / / tri shU la la bsad ro mang / / de 'dra nags gseb phyin tsa na/ / ral gri phub dag bzung nas ni/ /

khro gnyer dang bcas smin 'khyog zur mig gis bltas mig can rnams ni khyed mtshan dpal gyi gzhi/ / mig ni khro gnyer bcas shing smin 'khyog zur mig lta dang ldan rnams bran du sgo byed pa/ / mda' gzhu bkang nas byung ba rnams/ / zur mig lta zhing khros nas byung / / rgol nas brdeg tu byung tsam na/ /

gsal bar 'dri ba'i gnas la bsam pa'i smyu gu skyo med rnams kyis bran du bkol bar byed/ / de ni khyod mtshan dpal gzhi bsam pa'i smyu gus skyo ba med cing gsal bar bris pa lags/ / khyed bsams skyo med smyu gus bris/ / khyed ming gsal por bris ma thag / dpal ldan khyim du bsdad phyin no/ /

rab rno sder mo'i rtse ni rdo rje lta bur bsnun pas glang chen myos pa'i klad 'gems nas/ / rkang pa'i sbar mo rab rno rdo rje lta bus tshabs cher bsnun pas glang chen myos pa'i glad/ / rkang pa'i sor mo rab rno ba/ / rdo rje lta bus rab tu brkos/ /

khrag mang rab tu zags pas bkrus pa'i ral pa gsal po 'jigs rung ya ngas phrag pa khebs/ / bskams nas khrag mang zags pas bkrus pa'i ral pa gsal po 'jigs rung ya ngas gnya' khebs shing / / smyo byed glang chen mgo khrag byung / /

sanskrit: krudhyann āpitsur ārād upari mṛgaripus tīkṣṇadāṃṣṭrotkaṭāsyas
parallel: khros te rgyang nas steng du 'phyong 'dod mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i kha can dgra/ / khros te rgyang nas mgo la 'dzin 'dod mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa'i kha can dgra/ / 'jigs byed seng ge byung tsam na/ /

khyod la 'os pa'i bstod pa don ldan tshig dag bkod pas skrag ste log nas 'gro bar 'gyur/ / khyod kyi 'thad pa'i spyod pa bstod pa'i don tshim mkhas la skrag ste log nas 'gro ba lags/ / khyod bos bstod pa brjod pa yis/ / bred nas seng ge log nas thal/ /

gdengs can rnam 'gyur du ba'i khyim dang mun pa'i dbyibs can gsal bar phud sgra dag gi tshogs/ / du ba 'khyil 'dra mun pa'i gzugs can rnam 'gyur gdengs can phus 'debs grags pa'i 'gram dgang bar/ / du ba 'khyil ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ / 'jigs byed gdengs byed shin tu 'bar/ /

byed pa dang ldan kha gdangs ro 'dzin thag pa gshin rje'i zhags 'dra che zhing g.yo ba dag / bya ba'i ched du kha gdangs 'gyur ba'i lce can thag pa dang 'dra gshin rje'i zhags pa dang / / phug byed kha gdangs pa/ / lce chen ston pa sbrul khro ba/ / gshin rje'i zhags pas bkyigs pa'i mi/ /

sanskrit: pāpāt saṃbhūya bhūyas tava guṇagaṇanā tatparas tvatparātmā
parallel: sdig pa las byung slar yang khyod skyong bdag nyid khyod kyi yon tan bgrang bar lhur len pas/ / sdig dbang gis phrad slar yang khyod kyi yon tan bgrang ba lhur len khyod bdag lhur byed pas/ / sdig pa'i dbang gis de ltar byung / / de dus khyed kyi yon tan bsgrags/ / gus pas dad par khyed la byas/ /

ut+pal phreng ba'i rgyan gyis 'byor pa bung ba myos pa'i phreng bas dkris ltar 'dzin par 'gyur/ / bung ba myos pa'i phreng ba'i gdub can ut+pal phreng ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'chang bar 'gyur/ / sprul de ut+pal phreng bar gyur/ / me tog mchod pa'i mi des thob/ /

rje bo'i smin ma bskyod pas 'jigs pa dag gis rgod cing 'phyag pas drangs la co do gzings/ / rje bos smin bskyod bskul te bkrabs pa rem zhing rtsub pas co to drangs shing gzings gyur pa/ / thag pas bkyigs nas skra nas drud/ / dpon gyis mig mtshams 'gul dogs kyis/ / der bred dmag dpon rim pa yis/ /

g.yo zhing sgra sgrogs bran khol rnams kyis rtsub mor smra byed zhags pa'i mdud pa dam pos bcings/ / go khol bskyod pa'i tshig rtsub kyis spyos 'ching ba'i zhags pa rtsub mos nyer bcing bkres pa dang / / rtsub mos bkal nas khrid tsam na/ / khol po de ni na tsha che/ / ca co smra ba gtong 'dod nas/ /

sanskrit: kṣuttṛṭkṣāmoṣṭhakaṇṭhas tyajati sa sapadi vyāpadaṃ tāṃ durantāṃ
parallel: bkres skom dag gis kha dang mgrin skams gang zhig 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la skyabs 'gro ba/ / skom pas mchu dang mgul ba gang zhing 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs la skyabs 'gro ba/ / nye ba gnyen rnams kyis ni bor/ / ltogs nas skom nas mchu skams pa/ / sdug bsngal mtha' med byung tsam na/ /

de ni byams pa'i gnyen gyis spangs kyang mtha' med rgud pa de dag 'phral du gtong bar 'gyur/ / de ni byams pa'i gnyen gyis spangs kyang ma rungs rgud pa de dag 'phral du spang bar 'gyur/ / gang gis sgrol ma'i zhabs la skyabs/ /

sgyu ma 'phrul pa'i lam gyi rim pas rnam par 'gyur ba du ma dag gis chas byas shing / / srin po sgyu ma sprul pa las tshul gyis byas bden pa ma yin gzugs brtsams cha lugs tshul/ / sgyu ma byas pa'i gzugs mi legs/ / mi ro'i rgyu ma bus pa des/ /

log pa'i gzugs tsam rjes su 'tsham pa'i mtshon cha'i 'od zer tshogs ni rab tu mi bzad ldan/ / rnam 'gyur du ma dag dang rjes su 'tsham pa'i mtshon cha'i 'od zer tshogs kyis mi bzad cing / / phreng ba mang bas ske la btags/ /

mi ro las bton rgyu ma'i thag pa'i tshogs kyi phreng bas rnam par spras pa'i srin po rnams/ / mi ro brgyus pa'i rgyu ma'i tha gu'i tshogs dag phreng bar bkod pa rnams kyang khyod rgyus las/ / sus kyang dgag tu mi nus pa/ / de byung dus su khyod kyi sngags/ / brjod pa tsam gyis sdig pa dag /

khyed rgyud las btus gsang sngags dran pas sdig pa phrogs pa'i srung ma gzhom med byed par 'gyur/ / btus pa'i gsang sngags dran pas sdig bsal bsrung ba pham pa byed par 'gyur/ / srin po'i dran pa med tsam na/ / de rnams kyis ni srung bar byed/ /

glang chen sgra sgrogs char sprin lus can myos byed chu bo'i rgyun dang ldan pas mun gtibs shing / / chem chem sgra sgrogs char sprin lus can ban glang myos 'brug byung ba yi sprin gyi gzugs/ / nga rgyal 'jigs pa rtsang po gsum/ / de ni mun pa gnag pa la/

mtshon cha 'od zer rnams ni glog rab 'gyu ltar rab gsal mda' yi char 'bab g.yul ngo 'gyed pa'i tshe/ / chu'i klung gis rgyun gyi mun gtibs shing / / mtshon cha glog ltar 'gyu ba'i 'od zer dang ldan mda' yi char 'bab g.yul ngo 'gyed pa'i tshe/ / glog bzhin mtshon cha snang ba yis/ / mda' yi char pa byung tsam na/ /

rnam par snang ba'i dgra bo dpung pa'i stobs ni rab mchog ldan pa rnams kyis bkag gyur pa/ / phye mar rlog par byed cing dpung stobs che ba'i rnam par sdang ba rnams kyis bkag pa yang / / 'thab pa'i dus su bskor nas bkag / shin tu stobs chen dgra rnams kyis/ / khro zhing brdeg tu byung tsam na/ /

sanskrit: tvaddattotsāhapuṣṭiḥ prasabham arimahīm ekavīraḥ pinaṣṭi // Tss_18
parallel: khyod kyi dgra bo gsod pa'i dpa' bo gcig gis 'phral du dgra yi sa gzhi phye mar rlog / khyod kyi spros pa gsol btab dpa' bo gcig gis dgra bo'i sa gzhi nan gyis 'thag par byed/ / sgrol ma khyed kyis stobs byin pas/ / dpa' bo gcig gis de rnams bcom/ /

sdig spyod dag gi rjes 'brang phol mig chabs can dag las rnag khrag rul pa rab 'dzag cing / / sdig spyod rgyun chags las byung phol mig tshabs chen dag las rnag khrag rul pa zags pa yis/ / sa ris rnams ni rang dbang byas/ / sdig pas gang ba mdze pho'i gzugs/ / lus po skrangs nas khrag rnag dang / /

sha lpags myags pa la chags rtsa yi sgo yi bu gar 'gul ba'i srog chags kyis zos lus zad rnams/ / myags pa'i sha lpags dang 'bral rtsa sgo'i bu gar srog chags 'gul bas zos pas lus zad rnams/ / chu ser de rnams 'dzag pa ni/ / rtsa sha pags pa phug pa nas/ / 'bu rnams kyis ni zos pa na/ /

khyod zhabs nye bar brten pa'i sman mchog ri lu gus shing chags pa yis/ / khyod kyi zhabs la brten pa'i sman mchog ri lu goms par bsten la rab tu dga' ba yis/ / sgrol ma khyed kyi zhabs brten nas/ / rtag tu khyed la mos gus byas/ / mos gus de rang sman du gyur/ /

sa le sbram dang mtshungs pa'i lus dang pad+ma dkar po ltar yangs mig dang ldan par 'gyur/ / sa le sbram dang 'dra ba'i lus dang ldan zhing pad+ma dkar po ltar yangs mig can 'gyur/ / gser gyi kha dog lus gyur nas/ / pad+ma dkar po rgyas pa'i spyan/ /

sanskrit: viśrāntaṃ śrotrapātre gurubhir upahṛtāṃ yāsya nāmnāyaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ
parallel: gang gi rna ba'i snod na bla ma rnams kyis gnang ba'i man ngag slong mo mi gnas shing / / gang gi rna ba'i snod du bla ma rnams kyis nyer sbyar man ngag gleng mo ma lhung zhing / / des ni gzugs bzang lus thob bo/ / slob dpon rnams kyi bka' de la/ / rna ba snod du ma rung bas/ /

sanskrit: vidvadgoṣṭhīṣu yaś ca śrutadhanavirahān mūkatām abhyupaiti /
parallel: thos pa'i nor dang bral bas mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams dag tu lkugs pa nyid du khas len gang / / thos pa'i nor dang bral bas mkhas pa'i tshogs sar lkugs pa nyid du khas len gang yin pa/ / thos pa'i nor ni phongs par 'gyur/ / bshes gnyen gseb tu lkugs pa de/ /

de yang khyed la gus pa'i nus pas rgyan rnams thams cad mdzes byed 'byor par bcas pa yis/ / de yang khyod la gus pa'i nus pas rgyan rnams kun gyis mdzes pa'i 'byor pa dang bcas pa'i/ / khyod la mos gus bstod bgyis pas/ / gsung ldan seng khri 'phrog par byed/ /

sanskrit: so 'pi tvadbhaktiśaktyā harati nṛpasabhe vādisiṃhāsanāni // Tss_20
parallel: ngag gi dbang phyug thob nas mi bdag mdun sar rgol ba'i seng ge'i khri dag 'phrog par byed/ / ngag gi dbang phyug thob nas mi bdag mdun sar rgol ba'i seng ge'i khri dag 'phrog par byed/ / de 'phrogs pa yang rgyal po'i mdun/ / rgyan cha sna tshogs btags nas ni/ / gsung gi dbang phyug seng khri sdod/ /

sa gzhi mal stan rdul gyis lus bsgos skyed ngos ras ral yan lag dag ni rnam par mngon/ / sar nyal rdul gyis lus gos rked ngos mdoms dkris ras ral yan lag rnam par mngon 'gyur zhing / / sa la nyal bas rdul mas khengs/ / lus kyi kha dog du bar gyur/ / dug po gos kyis lus ma khyab/ /

shig gi tshe dag rab gtser gzhan gyi grong khyer mdun du gyo mor zas ni don gnyer ba/ / shig gis tshe dag rab gtser gzhan gyi khyim sgor rdza chag dum bur zas dag slong ba yang / / gzhan gyi mdun du phor gog 'dzin/ / rtag tu slong mo byed pa de/ / rtag tu shig dang sro ma gsod/ /

khyod mnyes bgyid la brtson pas na chung mchog gis bzung ba'i rnga yab 'dzum gyis rab mdzes shing / / khyod mnyes bgyis pas na chung mchog dal rnams kyis g.yabs pa'i rnga yab kyis 'dzum mdzes pa'i sa/ / sgrol ma khyed la skyabs tsam na/ / nges par mdzes ma dgod nas ni/ / rnga yab mdzes pas g.yob par byed/ /

myos pas long ba'i gnyis 'thung sos gtams gdugs gcig gyen du bteg pa'i sa gzhi 'dzin par 'gyur/ / glang chen myos pa'i chu yis gdong pa'i mche ba gtams shing gdugs gcig gyen du bteg pa 'dzin/ / stobs chen glang po che rnams kyis/ / bdag por gyur nas gdugs gcig pa/ /

g.yog dang las mtha' bzo dang dbang po gso ba'i thabs kyi rnam grangs dag gis rab skyo zhing / / skye bo bkren pa rnams kyis yum gcig zhabs 'bring dang ni so tshis bzo yi spyod pa rnams/ / ras ris tsam gyis rgyal por gyur/ / gzhan g.yog las dang yon tan dang / / tshong dang thabs kyis nor tshol ba/ /

skye ba snga mar rab bsgrubs bsod nams bsags pa'i dge 'bras nor ni thob par ma gyur pa'i/ / spong ba'i thabs kyis rnam grangs dag gis dub cing skye ba snga mar nyer blangs bsod nams kyis/ / tshe snga ma yis dge ba'i nor/ / ji ltar byas kyang nor med pa/ / su la bslangs kyang rnyed pa med/ /

sanskrit: daivātikrāmanīṃ tvāṃ kṛpaṇajanajanany artham abhyarthya bhūyo
parallel: nor med rnams kyis skye bo bkres pa'i yum gyur phongs las 'da' bar mdzad pa khyod la don/ / nyer bsags dge 'bras nor ma thob dang nor bral rnams kyis phya las 'da' bar mdzad khyod la/ / kye ma khyed la bslangs tsam na/ /

don du gnyer na slar yang gser gyi tshogs kyi gter dag sa las 'thon pa thob par 'gyur/ / gsol ba btab pas phyi nas nor bu sa las gter ni gser tshogs 'byung ba thob par 'gyur/ / sa gseb tu ni nor rnyed nas/ / mi de phyug por gyur par byung / /
'tsho ba chad las ngo tshar gyur cing gos zad chung ma dag gis rab tu spyo bar byed/ / 'tsho ba chad pas ngo tsha khyim thab gos zad 'tsho ba med pas ngo tsha che/ / gos med pas ni chung mas brgal/ /

bdag nyid gso phyir rang gi skye bo bu dang grogs po gnyen gyis ring du spangs pa yis/ / ma yis spyo bar byed cing bdag nyid ni/ / gso bar byed phyir gnyen 'dab bu dang gnyen bshes rnams kyis rgyang spangs par gyur pa yis/ / phongs pa yin pas gnyen gyis bor/ / ster dgos mno nas thag su/ / kye ma sgrol ma khyed la ni/ /

khyed la rang gi sdug bsngal zhus pas rang gi khyim thab bud med gdu bu'i sil sil sgras/ / khyod la rang gi sdug bsngal zhus pas rang gi khyim thab bud med gdu bu'i sil sil sgras/ / rang gi sdug bsngal bstan tsam na/ / rta rnams rmig pa sa la rko/ / de brkos sa yang khyim bskor nas/ /

gnyid log sad par 'gyur zhing rta rmig rtse mos mtshams brkos khang khyim rnams kyi bdag po byed/ / gnyid log sad par 'gyur zhing rta rmig rtse mos mtshams brkos khang khyim rnams kyi bdag po byed/ / khyim der gnyid ni log pa las/ / mdzes ma rnams kyis lag brgyan grags/ / des ni gnyid log sad pa rnyed/ /

'khor lo phyogs kyi 'khor lo la sbyor bud med mtshan brgyan 'od zer g.yo zhing che ba dang / / gal te khyod kyi bka' drin cha shas tsam zhig mchis na phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'khor lo dang / / phyogs bcur gyur pa'i 'khor lo ni/ / shin tu 'od zer ldan pa dang / / mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bud med dang / /

glang chen gtso bo mche ba drug ldan rta mchog spu kha sngo bsangs rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'tsher/ / bud med mtshan brgyan 'og pag chen po g.yo dang glang chen don po mche ba drug pa dang / / mche ba drug yod glang po che/ / rma bya'i ske yi kha dog ldan/ / de ltar sngo ba rta bzang dang / /

nor bu nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar gsal dri med yon tan mdzod 'dzin mdzod khengs dang / / rta mchog spu kha sngo bsangs rma bya'i mgrin ltar 'tsher dang yon tan dri med nor bu ni/ / rin po che ni nyi ma'i 'od/ / dri ma med pa'i gter gyis bkang / /

sanskrit: senānīr vīrasainyo bhavati bhagavati tvatprasādāṃśaleśāt // Tss_24
parallel: dmag dpon dpal sde ldan par bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyi bka' drin cha shas phra las 'gyur/ / nyi ltar mdangs ldan 'od can khyim bdag mdzod khengs blon po rtul phod dmag ldan 'byung bar 'gyur/ / dmag gi dpa' bo mang ba dang / / sgrol ma khyed kyi bka' drin gyis/ / 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur/ /

tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo la mdzes mas dus btab rtse dga' la chags pas/ / khyod kyis rig pa'i grub pa thob pas tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo steng du/ / nor bu rin po che yi rdo/ / de la tsan+dan la sogs bskus/ / lha mo rnams kyang 'tshog sa byas/ /

tsan+dan chu yis dri zhim nor bu'i rdo la mdzes mas dus btab rtse dga' la chags pas/ / sdu gu ma yi bde ba'i nyer spyad mgron du bya ba mngon par gsang ba rab bsgrubs shing / / sdu gu ma yis dus 'debs sdug pa dang rol rjes su chags pas bde ba'i nyer spyad gsar/ / 'gron sar mchod pa byas pa bzhin/ / shin tu chags nas rtsed mo rtses/ /

sdu gu ma yi bde ba'i nyer spyad mgron du bya ba mngon par gsang ba rab bsgrubs shing / / ral gri 'od zer gyis sngo spom mtho dpung pa gtun shing dang 'dra dpung rgyan rol pa can/ / gus par sbyar zhing lag sbom mthon po ral gri'i 'od zer sngon pos dpung rgyan g.yo ba yis/ / sgrol ma khyed kyi rig pa grub/ / rig pa 'dzin pa'i lha dbang po'i/ /

ral gri 'od zer gyis sngo spom mtho dpung pa gtun shing dang 'dra dpung rgyan rol pa can/ / khyod kyi rigs drug rig 'dzin dbang po ma la ya yi me tog tshal du rang dgar 'gro/ / rig 'dzin dbang po rang dgar gyur te mA la ya yi me tog skyed mos tshal du 'gro/ / ral gri 'od zer ljang gus ni/ / lag de la phrog pa de/ / yang nas yang du gsor byed pa/ /

ral gri 'od zer gyis sngo spom mtho dpung pa gtun shing dang 'dra dpung rgyan rol pa can/ / nu ma'i thon 'khor do shal gyis brgyan mig dkyus ring po rna ba'i ut+pal la 'gran cing / / nu ma'i thon kor do shal gyis mnan mig dkyus ring pos rna ba'i ut+pal la 'gran cing / / rna bar ut+pal btags pa de/ / mu tig phreng bas mdzes par btags/ / de btags nu ma'i bar du byung / /

khyod kyi rigs drug rig 'dzin dbang po ma la ya yi me tog tshal du rang dgar 'gro/ / lha mo yid 'ong man+da ra ba dang ldan ze 'bru gsar pa'i dris myos bung ba can/ / skra bskyil man+da ra bas brgyangs pa'i ze 'bru sar pa'i dri yis myos pa'i bung ba dang ldan pa'i/ / mig dang gang bzang 'gran pa 'dra/ / thor tshugs man+da ra ba btags/ / dri zhim bung bas bor ma nus/ /

nu ma'i thon 'khor do shal gyis brgyan mig dkyus ring po rna ba'i ut+pal la 'gran cing / / dril chung sgra yis rjes 'brel rab tu gsal bar rkang gdub yid 'ong sgra snyan sgrogs par byed/ / lha yi bu mo rkang gdub rags pa'i sil snyan 'og pag sgra yi rgyun gyis shin tu dpangs/ / sil sil sgra dang g.yer kha btags/ /

sanskrit: tvannāthaṃ prārthayante smaramadamuditāḥ sādarā devakanyāḥ // Tss_26
parallel: lha mo yid 'ong man+da ra ba dang ldan ze 'bru gsar pa'i dris myos bung ba can/ / 'dod pas myos dga' gzhon nu ma rnams gus dang bcas par khyed mgon ldan pa don du gnyer/ / bskyed pa'i 'dod dran dregs dga' khyod mgon ldan pa dag la gus dang bcas pas gsol ba 'debs/ / sgrol ma khyed la brlab tsam na/ / 'dod pa'i lha la dga' ba tsam/ / de phrad lha mo bsnyen bkur byed/ /

lha mo yid 'ong man+da ra ba dang ldan ze 'bru gsar pa'i dris myos bung ba can/ / rdzing bu'i nang logs rin po ches spras gser gyi pad ldan ze'u 'bru rdo rje phreng ba can/ / rdzing bu'i nang logs rin po ches spras gser gyi pad mtsho ze 'bru rdo rje'i tshogs ldan zhing / / rdzing 'gram rin po che yis bskor/ / gser gyi pad+ma de la ni/ / ge sar rdo rje pha lam 'bar/ /

yongs 'du'i ljon pa las 'phro dri bzang dang ldan me tog rdul gyi bla re mthor bres te/ / lha mo yid 'ong man+da ra ba dang ldan ze 'bru gsar pa'i dris myos bung ba can/ / yongs 'du'i ljon shing skye zhing me tog ze 'bru dri zhim rdul gyi bla re mthor bres te/ / pa ra dzA ga'i shing de ni/ / cung zad bkug pa dri zhim dmar/ / de nas bla re bzhin du khyab/ /

pi wang gling bu sgrogs mkhas lha yi grong gi dga' ba rnams kyis snyan par rab bsgrags pa'i/ / dril chung sgra yis rjes 'brel rab tu gsal bar rkang gdub yid 'ong sgra snyan sgrogs par byed/ / lha yi grong khyer rangs bgyid lha mo pi wang gling bu sgrogs pa mkhas pas sil snyan ni/ / tam bu ra dang rnga la sogs/ / lha rnams kyis ni snyan par bsgrags/ / sgrol ma khyod kyi bka' drin gyis/ /

dga' ba'i skyed tshal bgrod pa khyod la mchod pa bgyid pas yun ring nyams su myong bar 'gyur/ / snyan par bsgrags pa'i dga' tshal lha mo khyod la mchod pa bgyid pas yun myong bar 'gyur/ / lha yi ldum rar yun rtses/ / bde ba shin tu nyams su myong / /

nang gi byed pa khyod la gtad pa'i bsod nams mthu ni rab 'bar yongs su smin pa yis/ / ga pur e la li shi shun pa a ka ru dang na la da phye'i dri ldan chu/ / sems rgyud khyod la gtad pas bsod nams mthu 'bar rnams ni mdzes ma dag dang lhan cig tu/ / ga pur e la li shi shing tsha a ka ru dang spang spos phye ma'i dri chu can/ / ga bur dang ni ka ko la/ / a ka ru dang spos dang dri/ / de rnams btags nas chur bsres pas/ /

'dod pa'i dregs pas rab 'bur bud med nu ma'i skyibs su rba rlabs 'khyil gnas dal 'bab pa/ / glong 'khor rba rlabs bud med sdu gu'i nu ma 'dod pa'i dregs pas 'bur ba'i skyibs 'khyil ba/ / dri zhim chu rnams kyis ni brdeg / lha mo'i nu ma gnyis kyi bar/ /

sman min chu yi zer ma dang ldan chu rtsed mdzes ma dag dang lhan cig rtse bar 'gyur/ / dal 'bab gang gA'i chu la chu rtsed chu ni drag tu 'thor bas rtsed mo byed par 'gyur/ / lha yi gtsang po chu mgyogs des/ / phar rdeg tshur rdeg rtsed mo byed/ / lha mo mdzes pa de rnams dang / /

tshig mtha'i gtso bo dul ba'i khur gyis cod pan dud pa rnams kyis bka' la phyag byas shing / / khyod kyi spyan ras mang du phog pas dag pa'i bka' la lha gtso dul ba'i khur bu yis/ / khyod kyi bka' drin bsod nams kyis/ / lha yul du ni rtsed mo myong / /

tshig mtha'i gtso bo dul ba'i khur gyis cod pan dud pa rnams kyis bka' la phyag byas shing / / cod pan 'dud pa rnams kyis phyag byas mtho ris steng na lha yi glang chen thal gong ni/ / mtho ris gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ / gus pas bka' ni spyi bos len/ / de lan phyag ni byas nas su/ /

mtho ris steng du lha yis glang chen khrol khrol rgyan gyis spud pa'i lus can la zhon te/ / cod pan 'dud pa rnams kyis phyag byas mtho ris steng na lha yi glang chen thal gong ni/ / glang po che la zhon pa la/ / rgyan cha btags pa'i glang rdzi des/ / lag pa gnyis la gdu bu btags/ /

spu lang rab rgyas lus can bde sogs lag pa'i thag pa khyogs kyis rgyun du bskyil gyur pa/ / khrol khrol rgyan gyis spud pa la zhon lus kyi ba spu shas cher langs pa'i bde sogs kyi/ / des ni 'do le bsgyings tsam na/ / bkag mi nus pa ba spu ldang / /

sanskrit: pūtas tvaddṛṣṭipātair avati suramahīṃ hīrabhinnaprakoṣṭhaḥ // Tss_29
parallel: khyed kyi spyan ras phog pas dag byas lag pa rdo rje ldan pa'i lhas skyong byed/ / lag 'do li bar med bskyil cing 'chang ba rdo rje dang 'brel lha yi yul las skyong / / rdo rje pha lam lag rgyan btags/ / khyed kyi spyan gyis gzigs tsam na/ / lha yi dbang po brgya byin thob/ /

gtsug gi rin chen rgyan gyis mnan bzhugs bde bar gshegs pa nam mkha'i dpal 'byor bla re can/ / khyod sku gtsug gi rin chen rgyan gyi gdan bzhugs bde bar gshegs 'od mkha' khyab bla re can/ / lha yi ris kyis srung bar byed/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa de la ni/ / rin chen me tog spyi bor gnas/ /

nyi ma 'char ka bye ba lta bur rab gsal 'od zer rgyas pas 'jig rten gsum 'gengs shing / / nyi ma shar ka bye ba lta bur ches gsal 'od zer dag gis 'jig rten gsum 'gengs shing / / nam mkha' dpal gyi bla res khyab/ / nyi ma shar ka'i 'od 'dra ba/ / des ni 'jig rten gsum po bkang / /

brtan par g.yas brkyang zhabs gcig gis mnan khur gyis tshangs dbang drag po khyab 'jug rnams 'dud pa'i/ / zhabs gcig g.yas brkyang gom stabs chen po'i brjid la tshangs dbang khyab 'jug drag po rnams 'dud pa/ / g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang zhabs gcig gis/ / de mnan bkug pa tshangs pa dang / / dbang phyug chen po khyab 'jug go/ /

sanskrit: tvadrūpaṃ bhāvyamānaṃ bhavati bhavabhayocchittaye janmabhājām // Tss_30
parallel: khyed sku bsgoms pa skye ba la brten rnams kyis srid pa'i 'jigs pa gcod pa'i slad du 'gyur/ / bsgoms pas skye ba la brten rnams kyis srid pa'i 'jigs pa rgyun ni gcod par bgyid par 'gyur/ / khyed kyi sku ni bsgom bgyis pas/ / srid pa'i 'jigs pa phyis mi 'byung / / skye ba len pa chad nas yod/ /

khro bo dang bcas mtshon cha'i 'od zer rab 'bar phyag dbyig cha yis nam mkha'i khongs dag khyab/ / la la khro ba dang bcas phyag tshogs phyag cha rnams kyi 'od zer dag dang 'brel pa yis/ / nags tshal phyag gi mtshon chas bzung / / shin tu 'jigs pa stobs po che/ / kha cig gis ni 'di ltar mthong / /

gdu bu'i gdengs can dag gi gdengs ka mi bzad mi 'phrogs spyod ldan sdang rnams skrag mdzad bzhad/ / nam mkha'i khongs khyab sprul gyi gdu bu'i gdengs ka dag gis spyod pa mi 'phrogs mi bzad pa'i/ / nam mkha' khyab par lag gdu bu/ / de rnams 'jigs che sbrul du mthong / / kye ma'o khros nas skrag par byed/ /

cang te'u drag po tshabs cher brdungs pa'i tshe na ro langs rnams ni drag por pheg rdob cing / / sdang rnams skrag mdzad gad mo'i cang te'u drag po brdungs pas brlang bskyed tshe na ro langs ni/ / dgod pa'i sgra ni shin tu 'jigs/ / ma rungs pa yi spyod pa byed/ / ro langs ting ting shag ni brdung / /

bag med rgyas pas ca co chen po sgrogs par byed pa'i drag mor la la dag gis mthong / / thal mo'i sgra chen sgrogs pas bsgyings shing bsnyems pa'i rol pa chen po'i ca co drags par khums/ / 'jigs chen rtsed mo sgra chen bsgrags/ /

la las ba spu re re las byung nam mkha'i khyon gnas sa dang sa 'og dag na gnas/ / la las ba spu'i khung re nas byung nam mkha' khyab pa'i sar gnas sa 'og mtho ris gnas/ / kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ / sgrol ma'i ba spu re re las/ / 'jig rten pa de 'tsho bar byed/ /

mtho ris la gnas tshangs dbang drag po la sogs mi dang lha dang grub pa'i dri za klu/ / tshangs pa dbang po la sogs lha dang klu dang dri za mi dang grub pa rnams gnas shing / / dbang phyug chen po klu la sogs/ / lha dang mi dang grub thob dang / / dri za gnod sbyin sbrul rnams dang / /

phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'od zer la bzhugs bde gshegs brgya phrag sprul pa mtha' yas dag gi sku/ / phyogs tshogs khyab pa'i 'od zer la bzhugs bde gshegs brgya phrag sprul pa mtha' yas kyis bkra dang / / phyogs su rgyu ba'i 'khor lo yang / / tha med bde gshegs khyim der gnas/ / kye ma rab tu rdzu 'phrul che/ /

ngo mtshar 'jig rten gsum gyi phyag 'os brtan g.yo bkod pa'i dngos po ma lus ngo bor ro/ / ngo mtshar khams gsum phyag 'os brtan dang g.yo bar gnas pa'i dngos po ma lus ngo bor khums/ / 'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa/ / kye ma 'gul mi 'gul gnas pa/ / sna tshogs lhag med dngos po ni/ /

la las rgya skyegs li khri'i tshon dang nyi zhon dmar ba nyid ltar shin tu dmar ba dang / / la las rgya skyegs li khri'i tshon 'dra nyi ma gzhon nu ches dmar lta bur dmar bar khums/ / kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ / rgya skyegs dang ni sin+d+hu ra/ / dkar dmar kha dog nyi ma ltar/ /

de bzhin gzhan gyis snum zhing 'od ldan mthon mthing rdo bcag btags pa'i phye ma ltar sdo dang / / de bzhin gzhan gyi dpal ldan an+da rnyil du btags pa'i phye ma 'thul 'drar sngon por khums/ / dpal ldan in+d+ra nI la 'dra/ /

la las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bsrubs pa'i 'od ltar ches lhag dkar dang gser 'od lta bu ste/ / la las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkrugs dang zho bas ches lhag dkar dang gser 'od ltar khums te/ / kha cig gis ni mthong ba la/ / 'o ma'i rgya mtsho drubs dkar 'dra/ / kha cig gis ni gser 'dra mdog /

sanskrit: tvadrūpaṃ viśvarūpaṃ sphaṭikavad upadhāyuktibhedād vibhinnam // Tss_33
parallel: khyed sku sna tshogs ngo bo nye bar bzhag pa dang 'brel dbye bas tha dad shel bzhin no/ / khyod sku sna tshogs ngo bor shes bzhin nye bar gzhag pa dang 'brel dbye bas tha dad 'gyur/ / khyod kyi gzugs ni sna tshogs mthong / / shel dang 'dra bar gang 'dod gzugs/ /

kun mkhyen ye shes sgron mas shes bya mtha' dag gsal byas de nyid dag gi dbang gcig pu/ / khyod kyi yon tan tshogs kyi grangs ni kun mkhyen ye shes sgron mes rab tu gsal ba yi/ / ye shes mar me thams cad mkhyen/ / des ni thams cad gsal bar mthong / / de nyid mkhyen pa dbang po gcig /

sanskrit: sākṣād vetti tvadīyaṃ guṇagaṇagaṇanāṃ sarvavit tatsuto vā /
